https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 随着韩国药房成为“K-beauty”旅游路线上的新一站，此类场景正变得越来越常见。南大门市场一家药房的经营者朴俊善告诉《韩国时报》：“外国游客目前占我们销售额的40%至50%。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: In Seoul's bustling Namdaemun Market, a group of American tourists stepped out of a pharmacy and opened their shopping bags to show their haul: a box of Bacchus energy drinks and three packages of polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN) skin care products. Inside, other foreign shoppers queued at the counters with acne treatments, scar gels and cosmetics in hand. Pharmacists in white coats scanned their purchases at the registers. Scenes like this are becoming increasingly common as Korean pharmacies emerge as a new stop on the K-beauty tourism route. Foreign visitors are seeking both over-the-counter (OTC) dermatological drugs available only at pharmacies and pharmacy-sold cosmetics promoted through social media. “Foreign tourists now account for 40 to 50 percent of our sales,” Park Jun-sun, who runs one of the pharmacies in Namdaemun Market, told The Korea Times. “There weren’t that many when I opened two years ago, but the number suddenly started rising about a year ago.” Even at larger pharmacies that cater mainly to Korean customers, foreign shoppers have become more visible. Staff at one store estimated that they now make up about one in 10 customers, a notable share at a pharmacy with four to six pharmacists working behind the counters. “The number has increased recently. They mostly buy skin care products,” a pharmacist said, an observation echoed by others in the area. According to Korea Tourism Organization data, pharmacies accounted for 13.88 percent of foreign visitors’ medical-related spending in September, totaling 31.8 billion won ($24 million). That share was up by 5.6 percentage points from December 2025, when it was around 8.3 percent. The main reason behind the trend is the availability of products that foreign visitors cannot buy at ordinary cosmetics retailers. Park pointed to Noscana Gel and Acnon Cream, Dong-A Pharmaceutical products used for scars and acne, respectively, as some of the most frequently requested items at his store. Under Korea’s Pharmaceutical Affairs Act, both are classified as OTC drugs that must be sold through pharmacies. They are distinct from pharmacy-sold cosmetics such as PDRN skin care products, which are not medicines but have also become popular among foreign visitors. Social media has helped drive interest in both categories. Foreign tourists increasingly arrive with lists of products they have seen recommended on Instagram and other platforms, often seeking treatments and cosmetics that are less familiar or less accessible in their home countries. “Customers come in asking for products they saw on Instagram,” said a pharmacist who runs a store in the market. “We Koreans also visit local pharmacies when traveling abroad, especially in countries like France. I see this as a similar trend.” For pharmacies, growing interest in pharmacy-exclusive products offers a business opportunity by also stocking cosmetics that are not classified as medicines. “Pharmacies are already operating on very thin margins, with fierce competition driving drug prices as low as they can go. Neighborhood pharmacies are closing down,” Park said. “But beauty products targeting foreign tourists give us more flexibility in pricing.” A short walk away in Myeong-dong, the trend has gone a step further. Some pharmacies no longer simply serve foreign tourists who happen to stop by, and increasingly position themselves as beauty-shopping destinations in their own right, competing for the same customers who flock to cosmetics stores in the neighborhood. In one of Korea’s best-known K-beauty hubs, where Olive Young’s bright green shopping bags are seen everywhere, pharmacy signs bearing white crosses now stand out among the beauty retailers. Inside, some pharmacies operate much like conventional cosmetics stores. Staff greet customers at the entrance and guide them to shelves stocked with popular products, while pharmacists in white coats move through the aisles offering advice. “We came to a pharmacy because we think it is more reliable than Olive Young,” said a German couple who bought a skin-firming cream. “In Germany, pharmacies and cosmetics stores are separate. We thought pharmacists would know what they were doing.” Some pharmacies have already built reputations overseas. A Taiwanese visitor shopping at a Myeong-dong pharmacy said it had been widely recommended back home. “Lists of must-buy items are shared on Instagram,” the tourist said. “Personally, I believe the ingredients in products sold at pharmacies are better than those in products sold at beauty retailers.” That perception of greater expertise and reliability is becoming part of pharmacies’ appeal to foreign beauty shoppers, helping make them a new stop on the K-beauty trail
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 药店成为外国游客体验K-beauty的新打卡地
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 在首尔热闹 bustling 的南大门市场，一群美国游客走出药店，打开购物袋展示他们买到的商品：一箱 Bacchus 能量饮料和 3 盒多聚脱氧核糖核苷酸（PDRN）护肤品。店内，其他外国顾客手里拿着痤疮治疗产品、祛疤凝胶和化妆品，在柜台前排队。身穿白大褂的药剂师在收银台扫描他们购买的商品。随着韩国药店成为 K-beauty 旅游路线上的新一站，这样的场景正变得越来越常见。外国游客既在寻找只有药店才能买到的非处方（OTC）皮肤科药物，也在使用社交媒体推广的药店销售化妆品。南大门市场一家药店的经营者 Park Jun-sun 告诉《韩国时报》：“外国游客目前占我们销售额的 40% 至 50%。”“两年前我刚开店时，外国游客没有这么多，但大约从一年前开始，人数突然开始上升。”即使在主要面向韩国顾客的大型药店里，外国顾客也越来越常见。某店员工估计，外国顾客如今约占顾客总数的十分之一；对于一家柜台后有 4 至 6 名药剂师工作的药店来说，这一比例相当可观。一名药剂师说：“最近人数增加了。他们大多购买护肤品。”该地区的其他药剂师也表达了同样的看法。据韩国观光公社的数据，9 月，药店占外国游客医疗相关支出的 13.88%，总额为 318 亿韩元（2400 万美元）。这一占比较 2025 年 12 月上升了 5.6 个百分点，当时约为 8.3%。这一趋势背后的主要原因是，外国游客可以买到普通化妆品零售店无法购买的产品。Park 指出，东亚制药用于祛疤和痤疮的 Noscana Gel 和 Acnon Cream，是其店里最常被顾客询问的商品之一。根据韩国《药品管理法》，两者均被归类为必须通过药店销售的 OTC 药品。它们不同于 PDRN 护肤品等药店销售的化妆品；后者并非药品，但也在外国游客中越来越受欢迎。社交媒体推动了顾客对这两类产品的兴趣。外国游客到店时往往带着一份清单，上面都是在 Instagram 和其他平台上看到推荐的产品，他们通常会寻找在本国不太熟悉或不容易买到的治疗药物和化妆品。市场内一家药店的药剂师说：“顾客进店会询问他们在 Instagram 上看到的产品。”“我们韩国人出国旅行时也会光顾当地药店，尤其是在法国等国家。我认为这是一种类似的趋势。”对药店而言，药店专售产品日益受到关注，也带来了商机，因为药店可以同时销售不被归类为药品的化妆品。Park 说：“药店的利润空间本来就很薄，激烈竞争把药价压到了最低水平。社区药店正在倒闭。”“但面向外国游客的美容产品让我们在定价上有了更大的灵活空间。”步行不远就是明洞，这一趋势进一步发展。一些药店不再只是接待偶然路过的外国游客，而是越来越多地将自己定位为专门的美容购物目的地，与周边涌向化妆品店的顾客争夺同一批客源。在韩国最知名的 K-beauty 中心之一，Olive Young 鲜绿色购物袋随处可见，带有白色十字标志的药店招牌如今在众多美妆零售商之间格外醒目。店内，一些药店的运营方式很像传统化妆品店。员工在入口处迎接顾客，并引导他们来到摆满热门产品的货架前；身穿白大褂的药剂师则在过道中穿行，为顾客提供建议。一对购买紧致肌肤霜的德国夫妇说：“我们来药店，是因为我们觉得这里比 Olive Young 更可靠。”“在德国，药店和化妆品店是分开的。我们以为药剂师更懂得该怎么做。”一些药店已经在海外建立了声誉。一名在明洞药店购物的台湾游客说，这家店在台湾广受推荐。该游客说：“必买商品清单会在 Instagram 上分享。”“就我个人而言，我认为药店销售产品的成分比美妆零售商销售产品的成分更好。”外国美容顾客正是这种对专业性和可靠性的更高认可，逐渐成为药店吸引顾客的原因之一，帮助药店成为 K-beauty 旅游路线上的新一站。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: North Korea's diversifying missile arsenal complicates South's defense
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The expanding arsenal gives North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s military more options to approach targets from different directions and coordinate strikes, placing greater demands on South Korean and U.S. defenses even as questions remain over Pyongyang's technological claims. Asked how much North Korea’s missiles have advanced and how serious a threat they pose, experts said combat data from Russia’s war against Ukraine has helped Pyongyang improve their accuracy and ability to pinpoint targets in South Korea.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 不断扩充的武器库为朝鲜领导人金正恩的军队提供了更多选择，使其能够从不同方向接近目标并协调打击；尽管平壤方面对其技术水平的说法仍存疑问，但这也给韩国和美国的防御提出了更高要求。专家在被问及朝鲜导弹取得了多大进展、构成何种严重威胁时表示，俄罗斯对乌克兰战争中积累的实战数据，已帮助平壤提高导弹的精确度以及锁定韩国境内目标的能力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The frequency of missile tests has also increased, with 16 ballistic missile launches recorded through Oct. 12, which exceeds the six recorded in all of 2025 and 12 in 2024. But what's more threatening than the frequency of ballistic missiles is diversification, with cruise missile tests added on seven occasions through Oct. 14, involving land-based launchers, destroyers and, purportedly, a submarine. The expanding arsenal gives North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s military more options to approach targets from different directions and coordinate strikes, placing greater demands on South Korean and U.S. defenses even as questions remain over Pyongyang's technological claims. This year's ballistic launches began near Pyongyang on Jan. 4 with suspected Hwasong-11 Ma hypersonic missiles. North Korea then fired large-caliber rockets on Jan. 27 and 600-millimeter super-large rockets, known as KN-25, from Sunan on March 14. Testing intensified in April — a suspected ballistic missile’s track disappeared shortly after launch on April 7, followed by two separate firings the next day, including what the North claimed was a Hwasong-11 Ga, or KN-23, cluster-warhead test. Hwasong-11 Ra missiles were then fired on April 19. North Korea went on to test close-range ballistic missiles on May 26 and tactical ballistic missiles with special-purpose warheads on June 25. August brought further firings of ballistic missiles on Aug. 6 and 12, followed by suspected KN-25 rockets on Aug. 20. Ballistic missiles also featured in a combined exercise on Sept. 12, before a claimed Hwasong-11 Ma-1 hypersonic test on Sept. 20. The sequence continued with a claimed hypersonic intermediate-range missile launch on Oct. 3 and launches of different ballistic missile types on Oct. 12. Separately, the destroyer Choe Hyon fired strategic cruise missiles on March 4 and 10. A mobile short-range anti-aircraft missile system was tested during the April 6–8 weapons-testing series, followed by strategic cruise and anti-ship missile launches from Choe Hyon on April 12. Tactical cruise missiles with claimed artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted guidance were tested alongside guided artillery rockets on May 26. The destroyer Kang Kon tested a strategic cruise missile on July 3, while tactical cruise missiles joined rockets and attack drones in the Sept. 12 exercise. On Oct. 14, Pyongyang tested two cruise missile types purportedly launched from a submarine. The precise underwater launch platform remain unconfirmed. Asked how much North Korea’s missiles have advanced and how serious a threat they pose, experts said combat data from Russia’s war against Ukraine has helped Pyongyang improve their accuracy and ability to pinpoint targets in South Korea. North Korea has deployed troops to fight alongside Russian forces and also supplied ballistic missiles. “North Korea has significantly improved their accuracy using data obtained from the war in Ukraine. This year’s launches can be seen as drawing on those accumulated findings,” said Yang Uk, a research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies. “Years of development have made the Pyongyang’s missiles more reliable, with recent efforts focused on hitting targets more precisely,” he added. “Greater missile accuracy inevitably increases North Korea’s ability to strike targets in South Korea precisely,” said the analyst, who asked not to be named. Specific launches also suggest Pyongyang is developing weapons that can carry heavier warheads and evade interception, according to other experts. Shin Jong-woo, secretary-general of the Korea Defense and Security Forum, identified one missile tested on Oct. 12 as the Hwasong-11 Da-2.5, assessing that it carried a 2.5-metric-ton warhead. “They demonstrated they could fire such a powerful warhead nearly 1,000 kilometers,” Shin said. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, pointed to the Sept. 20 and Oct. 3 hypersonic missile tests as signs of efforts to evade interception at different ranges. “It goes beyond showcasing individual weapons to demonstrating an entire family of systems,” Hong said. Warheads that scatter smaller explosives or mines could also cause damage over wider areas and disrupt roads or airfields, a threat highlighted by the April 19 Hwasong-11 Ra test. Pyongyang claimed five missiles struck an area of 12.5 to 13 hectares, although the damage area was not independently verified. Despite those advances, experts remained skeptical that North Korea had secured a reliable capability to strike the U.S. mainland, a central goal of its missile program. “It is still nowhere near being able to consistently strike the U.S. mainland. That is not an easy capability to acquire,” Yang said. Kwak Jin-o, a research professor at Pai Chai University, cautioned against overstating the gains from the Ukraine war. “Expecting North Korea to perfect its missiles through experience in a single war is asking too much,” he said. The extent of North Korea’s progress in maneuvering also remains unverified. For instance, Pyongyang claimed the missile launched on Oct. 3 flew approximately 1,000 kilometers, compared with South Korea’s assessment of more than 700 kilometers and Japan’s estimate of about 680 kilometers. The North Korean leader’s powerful sister, Kim Yo-jong, also claimed AI-assisted low-altitude maneuvering. "Those claims and differing flight-distance estimates do not establish whether the weapons achieved their stated maneuvering capabilities," Kwak said. South Korea’s Defense Intelligence Agency assessed that stable hypersonic gliding technology remained insufficient despite technical progress. Meanwhile, South Korea conducted its first domestically developed hypersonic glide vehicle test on Oct. 8. The Joint Chiefs of Staff assessed that existing South Korean and U.S. defenses could detect and intercept the North’s recently launched missiles. Hong called for stronger low-altitude surveillance, closer real-time information sharing among Seoul, Washington and Tokyo, and improvements to multilayer defenses
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 朝鲜扩充导弹武库，给韩国防御增加复杂性
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh:
导弹试验频率也有所增加。截至10月12日，共记录到16次弹道导弹发射，超过2025年全年的6次和2024年的12次。但比弹道导弹发射频率更具威胁的是发射类型的多元化。截至10月14日，巡航导弹试验又举行了7次，涉及陆基发射器、驱逐舰以及据称由潜艇发射的导弹。不断扩大的武库让朝鲜领导人金正恩的军队有了更多选择，可以从不同方向接近目标并协调打击，从而对韩国和美国的防御体系提出更高要求，尽管平壤方面的技术能力宣称仍存疑。

今年的弹道导弹发射始于1月4日，地点靠近平壤，导弹为疑似“火星-11”Ma高超音速导弹。朝鲜随后于1月27日发射大口径火箭，并于3月14日从祥恩发射被称为KN-25的600毫米超大型火箭。4月，试验力度加大——4月7日，一枚疑似弹道导弹发射后不久便失去弹道；次日又进行了两次独立发射，其中包括朝鲜所称“火星-11”Ga，即KN-23 Cluster的分集战斗部试验。4月19日，朝鲜又发射了“火星-11”Ra导弹。

朝鲜继续于5月26日试验近程弹道导弹，并于6月25日试验了配备专用战斗部的战术弹道导弹。8月6日和12日又进行了弹道导弹发射，8月20日则发射了疑似KN-25火箭。9月12日的联合演习中也出现了弹道导弹，此前朝鲜于9月20日进行了所称“火星-11”Ma-1高超音速导弹试验。之后，10月3日又进行了一次所称高超音速中程导弹发射，10月12日则发射了不同类型的弹道导弹。

另外，“崔贤”号驱逐舰于3月4日和10日发射了战略巡航导弹。在4月6日至8日的武器试验系列中，朝鲜测试了一套机动式近程防空导弹系统，随后于4月12日从“崔贤”号发射了战略巡航导弹和反舰导弹。5月26日，朝鲜试验了据称采用人工智能辅助制导的战术巡航导弹，并同时试射了制导火箭弹。7月3日，“康宽”号驱逐舰试验了一枚战略巡航导弹；9月12日的演习中，战术巡航导弹与火箭弹和攻击无人机共同参演。10月14日，平壤试验了两种据称由潜艇发射的巡航导弹。具体的水下发射平台尚未得到确认。

当被问及朝鲜导弹取得多大进展、构成何种程度的威胁时，专家表示，俄罗斯对乌克兰战争中产生的作战数据帮助平壤提高了导弹精度以及定位韩国境内目标的能力。朝鲜已派兵与俄罗斯军队并肩作战，还向俄方提供了弹道导弹。

“朝鲜利用从乌克兰战争中获得的数据，显著提高了导弹精度。今年的发射可以看作是在利用这些积累成果。”亚洲政策研究所研究员杨宇说。“多年研发使平壤的导弹更加可靠，近期的工作重点则放在更精准地打击目标上。”他补充道。

“导弹精度提高，必然会增强朝鲜精确打击韩国境内目标的能力。”一名要求匿名的分析人士说。

其他专家表示，具体发射情况还表明，平壤正在研发能够携带更重战斗部并躲避拦截的武器。韩国防务与安全论坛秘书长申钟宇将10月12日试验的一枚导弹认定为“火星-11”Da-2.5，并评估其携带了2.5公吨的弹头。申钟宇说：“他们展示了近1,000公里的射程内发射如此强大战斗部的能力。”韩国统一研究院高级研究员洪敏则指出，9月20日和10月3日的高超音速导弹试验，表明朝鲜正努力在不同射程上避开拦截。

“这已不只是展示单件武器，而是在展示一个完整的武器系统系列。”洪敏说。

能够散播小型爆炸物或地雷的战斗部还可能扩大破坏范围，并阻断道路或机场，4月19日“火星-11”Ra试验所展示的正是这种威胁。平壤称，5枚导弹命中了12.5至13公顷的区域，但受破坏面积没有得到独立核实。

尽管取得了这些进展，专家仍怀疑朝鲜是否已经具备可靠打击美国本土的能力，而这是其导弹计划的核心目标。杨宇表示：“朝鲜仍远未具备持续打击美国本土的能力。这不是一种容易获得的能力。”

培材大学研究教授郭振 Oh提醒，不应夸大朝鲜从乌克兰战争中获得的收益。

“指望朝鲜仅凭一场战争的经验就使导弹臻于完善，要求过高。”他说。

朝鲜在机动飞行方面的进展程度也仍未得到核实。例如，平壤称10月3日发射的导弹飞行了约1,000公里，而韩国评估其射程超过700公里，日本估计约为680公里。朝鲜领导人 powerful 的妹妹金正恩还宣称，朝鲜已实现人工智能辅助的低空机动。

“这些宣称以及彼此不同的射程估计，并不能证明相关武器实现了其所宣称的机动能力。”郭振 Oh说。

韩国国防情报机构评估称，尽管取得技术进展，稳定的高超音速滑翔技术仍不够成熟。与此同时，韩国于10月8日进行了首次国产高超音速滑翔飞行器试验。韩国联合参谋本部评估认为，现有的韩国和美国防御体系能够探测并拦截朝鲜近期发射的导弹。洪敏呼吁加强低空监视，改善首尔、华盛顿和东京之间更紧密的实时信息共享，并提升多层防御体系。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.title: 5 creepy Korean creatures, both famed and obscure
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.summary: For readers who would like to celebrate the spooky season, second-guess the shapes in the shadows of their room or want a novel idea for a costume to wear to a party, here are five Korean ghosts that might keep you up at night. The "gumiho," or the nine-tailed fox, is one of the better-known Korean spirits, especially following its inclusion in the hit video game League of Legends. The gumiho also appears frequently in Korean dramas and webtoons, often taking the form of a beautiful woman and a romantic interest.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.summary_zh: 对于想庆祝万圣节、想重新审视房间阴影中轮廓，或是需要为聚会 costume 寻找新点子的读者，这里介绍了五种可能让你彻夜难眠的韩国幽灵。“狐妖”或“九尾狐”是较为人熟知的韩国灵异生物之一，尤其是在被纳入热门电子游戏《英雄联盟》之后。狐妖也经常出现在韩国电视剧和网络漫画中，通常会化身为美丽女子，成为故事中的恋爱对象。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.body: Halloween is just around the corner, and even though Korea does not traditionally celebrate with jack-o’-lanterns and trick-or-treating, the familiar prickle on the back of the neck at night and the whispering autumn breeze seem to be anticipating the time when the veil between our world and the world of spirits is thin. For readers who would like to celebrate the spooky season, second-guess the shapes in the shadows of their room or want a novel idea for a costume to wear to a party, here are five Korean ghosts that might keep you up at night. The "gumiho," or the nine-tailed fox, is one of the better-known Korean spirits, especially following its inclusion in the hit video game League of Legends. One of the game's most celebrated characters is Ahri, a bewitching and seductive fox lady who drains the souls of others. The gumiho also appears frequently in Korean dramas and webtoons, often taking the form of a beautiful woman and a romantic interest. In the original folklore, however, gumiho are characterized as malevolent and ancient fox spirits, defined by an animalistic hunger and unending cruelty. The folk tale "Yeou-nui" (Fox Sister) best showcases the wickedness of the gumiho. In the story, a family that wishes for a daughter finds a baby — actually an old fox in disguise — delivered to their doorstep. As the child grows up, however, livestock begin dying mysteriously, followed by people, as the fox sister pulls their livers out in their sleep and eats them whole. The story ends with the family's son being banished for accusing the fox sister of the murder of the livestock. Later, he returns to the ruins of their once-prosperous house to finally slay the fox sister once and for all. "Dokkaebi" are Korean spirits often characterized as tall, strong, horned men carrying around magical clubs that can grant wishes. Dokkaebi appear across many Korean folk tales, usually depicted as capricious and sometimes spiteful entities. The first written mention of dokkaebi dates back to 1447, in the Buddhist text "Seokbosangjeol." However, the etymology and origins remain undetermined. Stories about dokkaebi often start with a traveler who encounters the spirit in the night. The traveler is then challenged to a wrestling game against the inhumanly strong being, only for the creature to turn into a broom at the break of dawn. In other tales, a dokkaebi is tricked into removing a man’s wart in an attempt to gain his singing voice, or mistakes the sound of a traveler eating hazelnuts for thunder. Inanimate objects are said to gain a soul over time and turn into dokkaebi, especially old brooms. This has turned into a superstition where some people avoid keeping brooms when they get worn out and avoid storing them standing upright. While often not as scary as other entries, the dokkaebi is a spirit that has existed in Korea folktales for generations, and is a friendly — if slightly menacing — face to many. A "changgwi" is the ghost of a person who has been killed by a tiger. After death, the ghost is forced to serve the tiger and lure in other people for the animal to hunt. Changgwi are best known from Joseon-era scholar Park Ji-won’s satirical novel "Hojil," where it is described as a spirit that helps trick and lure humans to be eaten by tigers, and becomes more powerful with every human the tiger devours. While "Hojil" is a work of political satire criticizing the hypocrisy of the ruling aristocratic yangban class, its depiction of tigers and changgwi reflects a time when the apex predators still roamed free in Korea's mountains, revered as "sangun" — the lord of the mountain. In order to prevent people becoming changgwi, special funerals were held for those killed by tigers. These rites included immediate cremation and burial at the location of death, with the specially made graves being marked off-limits. Changgwi have seen a resurgence in popularity in recent years, thanks to its modern characterization as a vocal mimic in horror media, co-opting elements from more recent urban legends such as the "Jangsan-beom" — a white tiger-like mimic rumored to live on Mount Jang in Busan. "Mangtae halabeom"— roughly translating to "old man with a woven basket" — is Korea’s version of the boogeyman, a humanoid monster existing independent of context or folklore that is invoked to prevent children from misbehaving. In many tellings, mangtae halabeom is said to be a tall and lanky old man with a large woven basket on his back who snatches loud or rude children from their homes. He shoves the children into his basket, takes them back to his lair and prepares to eat them. This writer's grandmother would often talk about a friend who was captured by the mangtae halabeom but managed to escape, describing a basket that was wider inside than it was outside, dark and full of crying children. While its historical origins remain uncertain, mangtae halabeom still offers an interesting example of an archetype of a monstrous old person who kidnaps children — perhaps to teach children about the potential danger posed by strangers. "Eoduksini," or "spirit of darkness," combines elements of a traditional ghost and the modern horror trope of a cognitohazard — something that causes harm when perceived. Unlike other Korean spirits, eoduksini manifests as a formless mass of darkness that feeds on fear. It is said to grow taller and larger as the unfortunate viewer gazes at it and grows more scared, eventually swallowing them whole. However, eoduksini is said to have no power over travelers who actively ignore the spirit or do not fear it. Eoduksini stands out among traditional ghosts as a representation of human fear itself — ballooning in size but dissipating into nothing when challenged or ignored. Spreading stories of folk entities helps keep their spirit alive, as well as the culture that led to their formation. That being said, if you want to scare small children into behaving or are looking for a quirky costume for Halloween, just be advised: Ghosts are drawn to stories of themselves. Make sure to sprinkle a little salt at your doorstep to keep them away
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.title_zh: 韩国5种令人毛骨悚然的生物，既有鼎鼎大名，也有鲜为人知
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.body_zh:
万圣节即将来临。尽管韩国传统上并不以南瓜灯和“不给糖就捣蛋”的方式庆祝万圣节，但夜晚后颈上那种熟悉的寒意，以及低声细语的秋风，似乎都在预示着我们所在世界与灵魂世界之间的帷幕即将变得透明。对于想庆祝这个鬼魅季节、想再次端详自己房间阴影中的轮廓，或想为聚会寻找新奇服装造型的读者，以下五种韩国鬼怪或许会让你们彻夜难眠。

“狐妖”或“九尾狐”是较为人熟知的韩国灵异生物之一，尤其是在热门电子游戏《英雄联盟》收录这一形象之后。游戏中最受好评的角色之一是阿狸，她是一位施魅惑术、充满诱惑力的狐女，能够吸取他人的灵魂。狐妖也频繁出现在韩国电视剧和网络漫画中，通常化身为美丽女子或故事主角的恋人。然而在最初的神话传说中，狐妖被描绘成邪恶而古老的狐狸精，具有野兽般的饥饿感和无尽的残忍。民间故事《狐女》最充分地展现了狐妖的邪恶。故事中，一户人家盼望生下女儿，结果在自己家门口发现了一个婴儿——实际上，那是一只乔装成婴儿的老狐狸。然而随着孩子长大，牲畜开始神秘死亡，随后人们也接连遇害，因为这位狐女会在他们熟睡时将他们的肝脏掏出并整个吞食。故事结尾，这家的儿子因指控狐女杀害牲畜而被逐出家门。后来，他回到曾经繁荣的家族宅邸废墟，终于彻底杀死了狐女。

“独脚鬼”是韩国的一种鬼怪，通常被描绘成高大强壮、长着犄角的男人，随身携带能够实现愿望的魔法棍棒。独脚鬼出现在许多韩国民间故事中，通常被刻画为反复无常、有时还怀有恶意的存在。关于独脚鬼的首次书面记载可追溯至1447年的佛教文献《释 bosangjeol》。不过，其词源和起源至今仍未确定。关于独脚鬼的故事往往以一名旅人在夜间遇见这种鬼怪开场。旅人随后会受邀与这个拥有非人般力量的存在摔跤，不料天亮时，那东西却变成了一把扫帚。在其他故事中，独脚鬼为夺取一名男子的歌喉而诱使他割除自己的 wart，或把旅人吃榛子的声音误听成雷声。据说无生命的物件随着时间推移会获得灵魂并变成独脚鬼，尤其是旧扫帚。这逐渐形成了一种迷信：有些人在扫帚磨损后不再保留它们，也不把扫帚直立存放。尽管独脚鬼通常没有其他条目那么可怕，但它作为在韩国民间故事中延续了数代的鬼怪，对许多人而言仍是一张友善—— albeit 略带威胁——的面孔。

“장귀”是被老虎杀害之人的鬼魂。死后，其鬼魂被迫侍奉老虎，并为老虎引诱其他人作为猎物。最为人所知的“장귀”形象出自朝鲜时代学者朴趾源的政治讽刺小说《虎记》，书中将其描述为帮助欺骗和引诱人类，使其成为老虎食物的鬼怪，而且每逢老虎吞食一个人，它就会变得更加强大。《虎记》虽然是一部批评统治贵族“兩班”阶层虚伪性的政治讽刺作品，但它对老虎和“장귀”的描绘，反映的是顶级捕食者仍在韩国群山自由出没的年代；当时，人们敬畏山中之王，称其为“山君”。为防止人们变成“장귀”，凡被老虎杀死者都会举行特殊葬礼。这些仪式包括立即火化并就地安葬，专用坟墓也由专人守护，不得擅入。近些年来，“장귀”重新流行起来，这得益于现代恐怖媒体将其塑造成善于模仿声音的存在，并借用了较新的都市传说元素，例如“长산범”——据传居住在釜山山上的白虎状模仿者。

“盲袋老人”大致可译为“背着编织篮子的老人”，是韩国版本的“床下怪物”。这是一种脱离具体背景或民间传说、仿佛独立存在的类人怪物，人们常借它来吓阻孩子调皮。在许多说法中，盲袋老人被描述为高大瘦削的老人，背着一个巨大的编织篮子，会从家中抓走吵闹或无礼的孩子。他把孩子塞进篮子，带回自己的藏身处，准备吃掉他们。本文作者的外祖母常常讲起一位被盲袋老人抓走、却成功逃脱的朋友，并描述那个篮子里面比外面宽敞，里面一片黑暗，挤满了哭泣的孩子。尽管其历史起源仍不确定，盲袋老人依然是“绑架孩子的怪物老人”这一原型的一个有趣范例——也许最初是为了告诫儿童提防陌生人带来的潜在危险。

“黑暗之灵”或“eoduksini”融合了传统鬼怪与现代恐怖作品中的“认知危害”元素，也就是某种在被感知时会造成伤害的东西。与其他韩国鬼怪不同，eoduksini显现为一团没有固定形态的黑暗，以恐惧为食。据说，不幸的观察者越是凝视它、越是害怕，它就会变得越高越大，最终将观察者整个吞没。然而，据说主动无视或并不惧怕它的旅人不会受到它的伤害。在传统鬼怪之中，eoduksini格外突出，因为它体现了人类恐惧本身——会在恐惧中不断膨胀，却在受到挑战或遭到忽视时消散无踪。

传播民间怪物的故事，既能让它们的精神长存，也能让孕育这些故事的文化延续下去。不过，如果你想吓唬小孩子让他们守规矩，或是在寻找一套奇特的万圣节服装，不妨听个忠告：鬼怪会被关于它们自己的故事吸引。请务必在自家门口撒上一点盐，好让它们远离。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Spring comes earlier, autumn foliage later as climate change alters forests
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The peak autumn foliage season is forecast to arrive later than usual. As temperatures rise, spring is arriving increasingly early while autumn is shifting later, a pattern that researchers have consistently observed in Korea's forests. “This shows that the seasonal clock of forests is changing, with spring arriving earlier and autumn coming later,” said Jung Soo-jong, a professor at Seoul National University’s Graduate School of Environmental Studies.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 预计秋叶最佳观赏期将比通常来得更晚。随着气温上升，春季日益提早到来，而秋季逐渐推迟，研究人员一直在韩国森林中持续观察到这一现象。首尔大学环境研究生院教授Jung Soo-jong表示：“这表明森林的季节时钟正在发生变化，春季提前到来，秋季则推迟到来。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: If you are planning a fall foliage trip this year, you may need to set off a little later than expected. The peak autumn foliage season is forecast to arrive later than usual. According to the Korea Forest Service, fall colors will spread gradually from the central to southern regions, starting with Mount Seorak on Oct. 20. Foliage is expected to reach its peak nationwide only in late October, with peak dates forecast for Oct. 28 at Mount Songni, Nov. 4 at Mount Naejang and Nov. 6 at Mount Halla. The average peak date for maples and oaks nationwide is expected to be Oct. 31, about 0.8 days later than the average peak date over the past five years. The delayed foliage season is not an isolated development this year. As temperatures rise, spring is arriving increasingly early while autumn is shifting later, a pattern that researchers have consistently observed in Korea's forests. The seasonal clock that we have long taken for granted is changing. A 2021 study by researchers at the Korea National Arboretum and Seoul National University’s Graduate School of Environmental Studies tracked 25 native plant species in Korea over a decade. It found that the timing of leaf emergence in broadleaf trees had advanced by 13 days over the 10-year period, while the onset of autumn foliage had been delayed by 3.7 days. The researchers estimated that a 1-degree Celsius rise in average spring temperatures advanced leaf emergence by 3.6 days, while a 1-degree increase in average autumn temperatures delayed fall foliage by 1.5 days. Extending the observation period has made the changes even more apparent. A study titled “Long-Term Changes in Plant Phenology in Korea (2009-2024),” published last year in the Korean Meteorological Society’s journal Atmosphere, analyzed seasonal changes in 20 deciduous broadleaf tree species observed at 10 arboretums nationwide. From 2009 to 2024, leaf buds burst an average of 0.94 days earlier each year, flowering began 0.83 days earlier and leaves unfolded 0.79 days earlier. In other words, spring plant development advanced by roughly 13 to 15 days over the 16-year period. By contrast, the peak autumn foliage period — when 90 percent to 100 percent of leaves have changed color — was delayed by an average of 0.33 days each year, shifting approximately five days later over the same period. As a result, the growing season for trees — the period from when leaves emerge in spring until they change color in autumn — lengthened by more than 17 days on average. “This shows that the seasonal clock of forests is changing, with spring arriving earlier and autumn coming later,” said Jung Soo-jong, a professor at Seoul National University’s Graduate School of Environmental Studies. Is a longer growing season good for forests? With leaves remaining active for longer, trees have more time to photosynthesize and potentially absorb carbon. However, a forest's capacity to absorb and store carbon cannot be assessed solely by how long trees photosynthesize. Soil also stores substantial amounts of carbon, and rising temperatures can stimulate microbial activity in the soil, potentially increasing carbon dioxide emissions. The amount of carbon absorbed through photosynthesis also depends on temperature and water availability, not just the length of the growing season. “Carbon absorption capacity is determined by the balance between plant photosynthesis and carbon emissions from the soil, as well as factors such as drought and extreme weather events,” said Noh Nam-jin, a professor in the Department of Forest Resources at Kangwon National University. “When leaves emerge earlier in spring, the canopy of taller trees may become dense before understory plants — small plants growing on the forest floor — that bloom briefly in early spring have had enough time to complete their life cycles,” said Park Pil-sun, a professor in the Department of Forest Sciences at Seoul National University. The leaves of taller trees block sunlight, potentially preventing understory plants from producing fruit properly, she explained. A later autumn is not necessarily beneficial, either. After completing their growth, trees begin preparing for winter. If they do not have enough time for this process, they may become more vulnerable to severe cold. “In a country like Korea, where the four seasons are distinct, a shorter period of preparation for winter weakens trees’ tolerance to low temperatures,” said Kim Hyun-jun, a professor in the Department of Forest Resources at Chonnam National University. This is one reason why a simplistic response, such as indiscriminately introducing subtropical tree species, is not viable. Subtropical climates are generally defined by having an average temperature of 18 degrees Celsius or below in the coldest month and at least eight months with average monthly temperatures of 10 degrees or higher. The problem is that researchers still do not fully understand how these changes will affect forests. A delay of several days in peak foliage is not simply a matter of adjusting the dates of autumn trips. The growth cycles of plants and their preparations for winter are changing as well. The effects of climate change are also not driven by rising temperatures alone. Multiple factors, including droughts, torrential rain and strong winds, interact in complex ways, making it difficult to assess the overall impact through short-term observations. Researchers have recently warned that “the climate is changing faster than we can monitor it,” Kim said. That makes it all the more important to collect and maintain long-term data across multiple indicators. Noh emphasized the need to monitor soil carbon emissions, air temperature, precipitation, soil temperature and soil moisture together over extended periods. The accumulated data should also be used to guide forest management. “Rather than applying a uniform management approach nationwide, we need to closely monitor seasonal changes by tree species and region,” Jung said, adding that stable, long-term observations are essential to strengthening forests’ resilience to climate change. This article from the Hankook Ilbo, the sister publication of The Korea Times, is translated by a generative AI system and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 气候变化改变森林，春季提前到来，秋季树叶变色的时间推迟
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 如果你今年计划观赏秋叶，可能需要比预期稍晚出发。韩国森林厅预测，今年秋叶观赏旺季将比 usual 更晚到来。韩国森林厅表示，秋季色彩将从韩国中部逐渐蔓延至南部，其中10月20日从雪岳山开始。预计直到10月下旬，全国秋叶才会达到鼎盛期；各主要景点的预计最佳观赏日期分别为10月28日的俗离山、11月4日的内藏山和11月6日的汉拿山。全国枫树和栎树的平均最佳观赏日期预计为10月31日，比过去5年的平均日期晚约0.8天。秋叶季推迟并非今年才出现的孤立现象。随着气温上升，春天越来越早到来，而秋天逐渐推迟，研究人员一直在韩国森林中持续观察到这一规律。我们长久以来习以为常的季节时钟正在改变。韩国国立树木园和首尔国立大学环境研究生院研究人员于2021年开展的一项研究，对韩国本土25种植物进行了为期10年的追踪。研究发现，在10年间，阔叶树展叶时间提前了13天，而秋季开始变色的时间推迟了3.7天。研究人员估计，春季平均气温每上升1摄氏度，展叶时间就会提前3.6天；秋季平均气温每上升1摄氏度，秋叶变色时间就会推迟1.5天。延长观察期后，这些变化显得更加明显。韩国气象学会期刊Atmosphere去年刊登的《韩国植物物候的长期变化（2009—2024）》一文，分析了全国10座树木园观测的20种落叶阔叶树的季节性变化。从2009年至2024年，叶芽平均每年提前0.94天萌发，开花平均每年提前0.83天，展叶平均每年提前0.79天。换言之，在16年间，植物的春季生长进程大致提前了13至15天。相比之下，秋季变色鼎盛期，即90%至100%的树叶完成变色的时期，平均每年推迟0.33天，在同一时期整体后移约5天。因此，树木的生长季，即从春季展叶到秋季树叶变色的时段，平均延长了17天以上。首尔国立大学环境研究生院教授郑树钟表示：“这表明森林的季节时钟正在改变，春天更早到来，秋天则来得更晚。”树木生长季延长对森林有利吗？由于叶片保持活跃状态的时间更长，树木有更多时间进行光合作用，并可能吸收更多碳。不过，森林吸收和储存碳的能力，不能仅凭树木进行光合作用的时间长短来评估。土壤也储存着大量碳，气温上升会刺激土壤中的微生物活动，可能增加二氧化碳排放。通过光合作用吸收的碳量还取决于温度和水分供应状况，而非仅仅取决于生长季长度。江原国立大学森林资源学科教授鲁南镇表示：“森林吸收碳的能力取决于植物光合作用与土壤碳排放之间的平衡，以及干旱和极端天气事件等因素。”首尔国立大学森林科学学科教授朴pil-sun表示：“当树叶在春季更早萌发时，高大树木的树冠可能会在林下植物——即生长在森林地面、于早春短暂开花的矮小植物——有足够时间完成生命周期之前就变得茂密。”她解释说，高大树木的叶片会遮挡阳光，可能导致林下植物无法正常结出果实。秋季推迟也未必有利。树木完成生长后，便开始为过冬做准备。如果留给这一过程的时间不足，树木可能更容易受到严寒侵害。全南国立大学森林资源学科教授金贤俊表示：“在韩国这样四季分明的国家，缩短树木为冬季做准备的时间，会削弱树木抵御低温的能力。”这也是为何不能简单采取不加区别地引进亚热带树种等应对方式的原因之一。亚热带气候通常定义为最冷月份平均气温不高于18摄氏度，并且至少有8个月的月平均气温不低于10摄氏度。问题在于，研究人员仍未充分了解这些变化将如何影响森林。秋叶观赏高峰推迟数天，绝不只是调整秋季出游日期的问题。植物的生长周期及其越冬准备也正在改变。气候变化的影响同样不只由气温上升驱动。干旱、暴雨和强风等多种因素以复杂方式相互作用，因此很难通过短期观测评估其总体影响。金教授说，研究人员最近警告称，“气候变化的速度超出了我们的监测能力。”这使得收集并维护涵盖多个指标的长期数据显得更加重要。鲁南镇强调，需要在较长时期内同步监测土壤碳排放、气温、降水、土壤温度和土壤湿度。积累的数据还应被用于指导森林管理。郑树钟说：“我们不应在全国范围内采取统一的管理方式，而需要密切监测不同树种和地区的季节变化。”他补充称，稳定、长期的观测对于增强森林应对气候变化的韧性至关重要。本文来自《韩国时报》的姊妹报《韩民族日报》，由生成式人工智能系统翻译并经《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Birdwatching takes off among young Koreans
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Birdwatching, or birding, is emerging as a new hobby among Korea’s millennials and Gen Z. Taking off during COVID-19, with smartphones lowering the barrier to entry Birdwatching is also gaining popularity among younger people overseas. What explains the enthusiasm for birdwatching among young people across cultures?
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 观鸟又称赏鸟，正在韩国千禧一代和Z世代中成为一项新爱好。观鸟活动在新冠疫情期间兴起，智能手机降低了参与门槛；在海外，赏鸟也越来越受到年轻人的欢迎。是什么解释了不同文化背景下年轻人对观鸟的热情？
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: As you stroll among the trees, you hear a rustle and stop to listen. You raise your binoculars and quietly scan the spot where the sound came from. After waiting patiently, you may finally catch a glimpse of something rarely encountered in everyday life: a small, precious bird. Birdwatching, or birding, is emerging as a new hobby among Korea’s millennials and Gen Z. Until recently, it was largely seen as a pastime for middle-aged and older people, requiring expensive equipment and specialized knowledge. But smartphones have made the activity accessible to almost anyone. With celebrities, including actress Kim Tae-ri, author Chung Se-rang and model Lee So-ra, sharing their interest in birdwatching, it has even gained a reputation as a trendy hobby. Taking off during COVID-19, with smartphones lowering the barrier to entry Birdwatching is also gaining popularity among younger people overseas. In May, the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) in the U.K. reported that approximately 750,000 people in the country’s GenZ population, aged 16 to 29, regularly enjoyed watching birds. That figure represents an increase of more than tenfold, or 1,088 percent, since 2018. By comparison, the overall birdwatching population grew by 47 percent over the same period, highlighting the particularly rapid growth among younger people. What explains the enthusiasm for birdwatching among young people across cultures? One factor is that smartphones have dramatically lowered the barrier to entry. People no longer need to carry expensive cameras or bulky field guides to get started. Smartphone cameras are often sufficient to capture bird photos, while various apps can help identify species using even subtle clues, such as birdsong or feather patterns. Amid the flood of stimulating digital content, quietly observing birds in nature can bring comfort and peace. The fact that birdwatching began spreading rapidly among younger generations around the world during the COVID-19 pandemic further supports this view. In Korea, many birdwatching groups meet in urban settings, including apartment complexes and public parks. This trend may also reflect a growing desire to reconnect with nature in response to the often harsh and impersonal rhythms of city life. “I think people are drawn to birds because birdwatching offers a pleasure they can enjoy without having to venture far from their everyday lives,” she added. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 观鸟活动在韩国年轻人中兴起
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 当你在树林间漫步时，听见一阵窸窣声，于是停下脚步倾听。你举起双筒望远镜，静静扫视声音传来的方向。耐心等待片刻后，你或许终于能瞥见一种日常生活中难得一见的小巧珍贵鸟类。观鸟，也称赏鸟，正在韩国的千禧一代和Z世代中兴起为一种新爱好。不久前，它还被视为中年及老年人的消遣，需要昂贵设备和专业知识。然而，智能手机让几乎任何人都能参与这项活动。包括演员Kim Tae-ri、作家Chung Se-rang和模特Lee So-ra在内的名人分享了自己对观鸟的兴趣后，这项爱好甚至成了时髦爱好的象征。观鸟在COVID-19期间开始流行起来，智能手机降低了参与门槛，观鸟在海外年轻人中同样日益受到欢迎。5月，英国皇家鸟类保护协会（RSPB）报告称，该国16至29岁的Z世代人口中，约有75万人经常以观鸟为乐。这一数字较2018年增长了十倍以上，增幅达1,088%。相比之下，同期整体观鸟人口增长了47%，凸显出年轻群体中观鸟活动增长得尤为迅速。为什么不同文化背景下的年轻人都对观鸟充满热情？其中一个因素是智能手机大幅降低了参与门槛。人们开始观鸟时，不再需要携带昂贵的相机或笨重的野外指南。智能手机的相机通常足以拍摄鸟类照片，各种应用程序还可以借助鸟鸣或羽毛纹理等细微线索帮助辨认物种。展示观鸟魅力的社交媒体内容广泛传播，也改善了人们对这项活动的印象。最重要的是，观鸟提供了一种数字排毒和情感缓冲方式。在令人应接不暇的刺激性数字内容洪流中，静观大自然中的鸟类能带来慰藉与平静。新冠疫情期间，观鸟在全球年轻一代中迅速普及，这也进一步印证了这一观点。在韩国，许多观鸟团体会在城市环境中聚会，地点包括住宅小区和公共公园。这一趋势或许也反映出，面对城市生活往往快节奏、冷漠且缺乏人情味的节奏，人们正越来越渴望与大自然重新建立联系。她补充道：“我认为，人们之所以被鸟类吸引，是因为观鸟带来一种无需远离日常生活便能享受的乐趣。”本文来自《The Korea Times》的姊妹报《Hankook Ilbo》，由生成式AI系统翻译，并经《The Korea Times》编辑。

伊朗驻印度大使馆周六宣布，由于“不可预见的情况”，伊朗议会议长穆罕默德·巴盖尔·卡利巴夫将不参加在新德里举行的第12届金砖国家领导人论坛。

大使馆表示，伊朗伊斯兰协商会议议长卡利巴夫将无法出席金砖国家成员国议会领导人会议。大使馆澄清，伊朗议会代表团将参加此次会议。

大使馆在声明中表示：“作为金砖国家成员国之一，伊朗重申致力于在金砖国家峰会及会议上最高层次开展积极有效的参与。”

伊朗还对印度政府的热情接待以及为此次会议所作的安排表示感谢。大使馆祝愿议会论坛取得成功。

声明称：“伊朗伊斯兰共和国大使馆也对印度共和国政府的盛情接待以及为此次会议所作的安排表示诚挚感谢。大使馆祝愿金砖国家成员国议会领导人会议圆满成功，并希望此次会议取得建设性成果，推动成员国加强合作与交往。”

Unlock these with Subscription Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 26% year-on-year (YoY) increase in net profit to ₹5,645.38 crore for the quarter ended September, beating analysts’ estimates based on LSEG data but falling short of domestic brokerages’ projections of 27-32% growth. The lender’s total income rose 18% YoY to ₹29,426.88 crore. Other income increased nearly 25% to ₹9,571.01 crore. However, sequentially, total income and other income declined 2.1% and 18.3%, respectively. Net interest income (NII) grew 16% YoY to ₹8,459 crore. Net interest margin (NIM), however, contracted to 4.31% from 4.54% in the preceding quarter. The bank attributed the decline to deposits mobilised under the Reserve Bank of India’s special window for foreign currency non-resident bank (FCNR-B) accounts, through which it raised ₹55,344 crore. Asset quality improved, with gross non-performing assets (GNPA) declining to 1.04% from 1.39% a year earlier. Net NPA fell to 0.24% from 0.32%. Provisions declined 15% YoY to ₹803 crore. Operating expenses rose 14% YoY to ₹5,271 crore, partly offsetting the gains from higher income and lower provisions. For the first half of FY27, net profit stood at ₹11,125.84 crore. As of September 30, net advances grew 25% YoY to ₹5,77,295 crore, while deposits increased 23% to ₹6,51,491 crore. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. Unlock these with Subscription Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on Sunday (October 25, 2026), during which he will witness the Air Force Day aerial display in Varanasi and inaugurate an RBI data centre and cyber security training institute in Bhubaneswar. In Varanasi, the Prime Minister will also inaugurate Arvind Limited's new garment manufacturing facility, which marks an important step towards strengthening India's textile and apparel manufacturing ecosystem and promoting industrial growth in the region, an official statement said. Focusing on modern manufacturing practices, the facility will create meaningful employment opportunities, particularly for women, and contribute to the region's economic progress, it said. The inauguration also highlights Uttar Pradesh's growing role as a destination for industrial investment and manufacturing-led growth, it added. With a global customer base, it is a testament to how products manufactured in Varanasi will reach across the world, the statement said. Being a predominantly women-led initiative, it is a powerful symbol of women-led development, it added. Mr. Modi will also witness the Air Force Day Aerial Display-2026 at Namo Ghat in Varanasi, which will commemorate the 94th anniversary of the Indian Air Force. It will be held under the theme "Wings over Ganges". The aerial display will feature aircraft including the Tejas, Light Combat Helicopter (LCH) Prachand, SU-30MKI and Rafale, along with transport aircraft. Aircraft from the Indian Navy and the Indian Army will also participate, showcasing jointness in operations. The IAF's premier display teams, including the Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team and the Sarang Helicopter Display Team, will also participate in the event. In Bhubaneswar, the Prime Minister will inaugurate the Reserve Bank of India's newly established Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute, marking a significant milestone in strengthening the technological foundations of India's financial system, the statement said. They have been designed to meet the bank's computing requirements and to provide a secure, resilient, scalable and future-ready computing ecosystem for the bank and the broader financial sector. Four state-of-the-art data centres will host mission-critical payment and settlement systems, along with other flagship initiatives, the statement said. The facility has been certified to Uptime Institute Tier IV standard - the global benchmark for data centre infrastructure - placing it in the highest tier of operational resilience. It is among the largest Tier IV certified facilities in the banking, financial services, and insurance sector worldwide. The cyber security training institute will boost capability building, providing a dedicated institutional platform for cybersecurity and enterprise-technology training, research, and sector-wide capability development, the statement said. Unlock these with Subscription India and Uzbekistan discussed key issues on their bilateral agenda and stressed on the need for timely implementation of agreements reached at the highest level during a meeting between External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and his Uzbek counterpart Bakhtiyor Saidov in Azerbaijan’s Baku. Mr. Jaishankar was in Azerbaijan on Friday (October 23, 2026) for a day-long visit to review bilateral ties. He met President Ilham Aliyev and held talks with Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov on trade, investment, energy, tourism and connectivity. Mr. Saidov arrived in Baku on Friday (October 23, 2026) from Georgia after attending the first joint meeting of the Foreign Ministers of Georgia and five Central Asian countries — Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan. “Discussed key issues on the bilateral agenda and emphasised the importance of the timely and effective implementation of agreements reached at the highest level,” Mr. Saidov posted on X. . Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred Uzbekistan's highest honour for foreign leaders, the Oliy Darajali Do'stlik Order, during a visit to the country in August. During Modi's two-day visit, New Delhi and Tashkent upgraded their ties to a comprehensive strategic partnership and set a target of $5 billion in bilateral trade. The two sides also signed 11 agreements to boost cooperation in key sectors, including mining and tourism, and agreed to establish a framework for the long-term supply of uranium from Uzbekistan to India. Earlier on Friday (October 23, 2026), Mr. Jaishankar also visited the historic Ateshgah fire temple near Baku. In a post on X, he described it as a “symbol of the historical and cultural connect between our two peoples”. The pentagonal, castle-like complex was largely built and used in the 17th and 18th centuries by Hindu and Sikh merchants from the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent. Its walls bear inscriptions in Sanskrit and Gurmukhi script, including some Hindu invocations and a Sikh verse. During the meeting with his Azerbaijani counterpart, Mr. Jaishankar described the discussions as “very productive” and said they had helped chart a way forward for bilateral ties. The two sides discussed expanding economic cooperation, including trade, investment and energy, and agreed to coordinate more closely on connectivity. Both countries are invested in the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC), a multi-modal freight network of about 7,200 km linking India with Iran, the Caspian region, Russia, Central Asia and Europe. Mr. Jaishankar said closer coordination on the project was important in a globalised economy. The two sides discussed air connectivity, tourism and people-to-people exchanges among other things. Mr. Jaishankar also thanked Azerbaijan for assisting in the evacuation of Indian nationals, particularly students, from Iran during the regional conflict earlier this year. 印度与乌兹别克斯坦讨论了双边议程中的关键问题，并强调需要及时落实双方在 External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar 与乌兹别克斯坦外长 Bakhtiyor Saidov 于阿塞拜疆巴库举行会晤期间达成的最高层级协议。Jaishankar 先生于2026年10月23日星期五访问阿塞拜疆，进行为期一天的访问，以审视两国关系。他会见了总统 Ilham Aliyev，并与外长 Jeyhun Bayramov 就能源、贸易、投资、旅游和互联互通等议题举行会谈。Saidov 先生于2026年10月23日星期五从格鲁吉亚抵达巴库，此前他参加了格鲁吉亚与哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、塔吉克斯坦、土库曼斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦五个中亚国家外长的首次联合会议。

Saidov 先生在 X 上发帖称：“双方讨论了双边议程中的关键问题，并强调及时有效落实最高层级达成的协议的重要性。”

今年8月，印度总理 Narendra Modi 访问乌兹别克斯坦期间，获颁乌兹别克斯坦授予外国领导人的最高荣誉——Oliy Darajali Do'stlik Order。Modi 访乌两天期间，新德里与塔什干将两国关系提升为全面战略伙伴关系，并设定了双边贸易额50亿美元的目标。双方还签署了11项协议，以加强采矿、旅游等重点领域的合作，并同意建立从乌兹别克斯坦向印度长期供应铀的框架。

2026年10月23日星期五早些时候，Jaishankar 先生还参观了巴库附近历史悠久的 Ateshgah 火神庙。他在 X 上发帖称，这座神庙是“两国人民之间历史文化联系的象征”。这座五边形、城堡式建筑群主要由17和18世纪来自印度次大陆西北部的印度教和锡克教商人修建并使用。墙上刻有梵文和古木基文，其中包括一些印度教祈祷文和锡克教诗句。

Jaishankar 先生在与阿塞拜疆外长会晤时称，讨论“非常富有成果”，并表示双方通过讨论为双边关系规划了前进道路。双方讨论扩大经济合作，包括贸易、投资和能源合作，并同意在互联互通方面加强协调。

两国都致力于 International North-South Transport Corridor（INSTC）。这是一条全长约7,200公里的多式联运货运网络，连接印度与伊朗、里海地区、俄罗斯、中亚和欧洲。Jaishankar 先生表示，在全球化经济中，加强该项目的协调十分重要。

双方还讨论了航空互联互通、旅游和民间交流等议题。Jaishankar 先生还感谢阿塞拜疆在今年早些时候地区冲突期间协助撤离印度公民，尤其是学生。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-schoo.summary: The Convener of the Network for Women's Rights in Ghana (NETRIGHT), Professor Akosua Darkwah, has called on the Ghana Education Service (GES) to establish an offenders’ register and publish annual reports detailing sexual abuse cases reported in schools and how they were handled.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-schoo.summary_zh: 加纳妇女权利网络（NETRIGHT）召集人阿科苏阿·达尔瓦教授呼吁加纳教育局（GES）建立违法者登记册，并发布年度报告，详细说明学校报告的性侵案件及其处理情况。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-schoo.body: The Convener of the Network for Women's Rights in Ghana (NETRIGHT), Professor Akosua Darkwah, has called on the Ghana Education Service (GES) to establish an offenders’ register and publish annual reports detailing sexual abuse cases reported in schools and how they were handled. Speaking on JoyNews’ Newsfile on Saturday, October 24, Prof. Darkwah said the sexual abuse allegations involving the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School should serve as a turning point for the GES to review its child protection policies and strengthen enforcement. She expressed concern that Ghana has numerous laws intended to protect children, but their implementation remains a major challenge. "I would like to end on the GES and to ask that they use this as a reflection point and go back to their policies and enforcement because Ghana, we don't have trouble with passing laws," she stated. Prof. Darkwah referenced Ghana's child protection legislation, arguing that the country's willingness to adopt laws has not always translated into effective measures to safeguard children. "We sign nicely, then we go to sleep. I would like to see this be the point from which we begin to see some real changes," she said. She particularly questioned the GES's policy of transferring teachers, urging the Service to reconsider whether such arrangements adequately address cases involving allegations of sexual misconduct. "Are we going to continue to transfer teachers? So they need to go back and think about their transfer policies, whether it makes sense," she stressed. The NETRIGHT Convener further demanded greater transparency in the handling of sexual abuse complaints, proposing that the GES publish annual statistics on reported cases and the actions taken. "We would like to have a report annually. How many sexual abuse cases did the GES get, and how did they resolve them, so that when you are taking your daughter to school, you will know comfortably that she is protected," she stated. According to her, such accountability measures would help reassure parents that schools have effective systems to protect children from sexual abuse. Her comments follow allegations of sexual abuse involving female students at Obuasi Senior High Technical School, brought to public attention through an investigative documentary by journalist Manasseh Azure Awuni. Prof. Darkwah maintained that the controversy should prompt lasting institutional reforms rather than temporary responses, with particular emphasis on safeguarding students, reviewing teacher transfer policies and ensuring accountability in the handling of sexual abuse complaints
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-schoo.title_zh: Obuasi学校丑闻：NETRIGHT要求公布涉案人员名册及GES关于性侵案件的年度报告
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-schoo.body_zh: 加纳妇女权利网络（NETRIGHT）召集人阿科苏阿·达尔瓦教授呼吁加纳教育局（GES）建立违法人员登记册，并发布年度报告，详细说明学校报告的性虐待案件及其处理情况。10月24日星期六，达尔瓦教授在JoyNews《新闻档案》节目中表示，涉及奥布阿西高级技术学校校长的性虐待指控，应成为加纳教育局重新审视儿童保护政策并加强执法的一个转折点。她担心，加纳制定了许多旨在保护儿童的法律，但如何落实仍是一项重大挑战。达尔瓦教授说：“我最后要谈到加纳教育局，希望他们以此为反思点，重新审视自己的政策和执法工作，因为加纳在制定法律方面没有问题。”她提到加纳的儿童保护立法，认为该国愿意通过法律，并不总是意味着采取了有效措施保护儿童。她说：“我们把法律签署得很漂亮，然后就去睡觉了。我希望这件事能成为我们开始看到一些真正改变的起点。”她尤其质疑加纳教育局调换教师的政策，敦促该局重新考虑此类安排能否充分处理涉及性不端行为指控的案件。她强调：“我们还要继续调换教师吗？他们需要重新思考自己的调岗政策，看这样做是否合理。”这位NETRIGHT召集人还要求提高性虐待投诉处理工作的透明度，建议加纳教育局公布每年报告的案件数量及采取的措施。她说：“我们希望每年都能看到一份报告。加纳教育局收到了多少起性虐待案件，又是如何解决的？这样，当你送女儿上学时，就能安心知道她得到了保护。”她认为，此类问责措施有助于让家长放心，相信学校拥有保护儿童免受性虐待的有效制度。她的评论出现在记者曼纳塞·阿祖雷·阿武尼通过调查纪录片披露奥布阿西高级技术学校女学生遭受性虐待指控之后。达尔瓦教授坚持认为，这场争议应推动持久的制度改革，而非仅仅采取临时应对措施，尤其要重点保护学生、审查教师调岗政策，并确保性虐待投诉处理工作的问责机制。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.body: JoyNews investigative journalist Manasseh Azure Awuni says the suspended headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), Zakaria Abdulai, is moving freely despite allegations of sexual abuse involving female students. Speaking on JoyNews’ Newsfile on Saturday, October 24, Mr Awuni said that, to his knowledge, the headmaster had not been detained and was able to move around following his engagement with the police. “Zakaria, as far as I know, is a free man at least for now because I left Obuasi on the 25th of August and at the time, he hadn't been arrested,” he said. Mr Azure explained that although there had been reports of an attack on the headmaster by students, he understood that the incident was being used as a reason to allow him to recover. He also recounted claims that the father of one of the alleged victims had been contacted by the police and that there had been an attempt to settle the matter privately. “But even before that, the girl's father said the police had called him. The man wanted them to sit down and settle so that the case wouldn't go out, and the girl's father said no,” he said. According to Mr Awuni, the headmaster had subsequently indicated on other platforms that he had been cautioned by the police and granted self-recognisance bail. “He literally walked to the police. They listened to his story and then said you can go,” the journalist added. Mr Awuni further claimed that the headmaster had been in Accra recently to meet the NDC Functional Executive, arguing that he continued to move around despite the allegations. The controversy follows a JoyNews investigation by Mr Azure, titled Inside the Dreaded Headmaster’s Bungalow , which detailed allegations of sexual abuse involving female students at the school. One of the cases concerns a 20-year-old student who alleged that Mr Abdulai raped her at his official residence on campus on July 25, 2026. According to a police statement, the student reported the incident to the Domestic Violence and Victim Support Unit in Obuasi on August 4, accompanied by her father. She further alleged that the headmaster gave her GH¢100 to keep quiet. The allegations remain under investigation. The investigation also reported that complaints about alleged sexual abuse had been brought to the attention of school management, education officials and other authorities months before the headmaster’s suspension. Following the revelations, Education Minister Haruna Iddrisu directed the Ghana Education Service (GES) to suspend Mr Abdulai and referred the matter to the Criminal Investigations Department for investigation. Interior Minister Mohammed Muntaka Mubarak subsequently disclosed on October 20 that the headmaster had been arrested in connection with the allegations. Police investigations have included efforts to obtain DNA evidence, while the case docket has been forwarded to the Attorney-General’s Office for advice. Mr Abdulai has denied wrongdoing and has said he was cautioned and granted self-recognisance bail. He has also resigned as Juaben Constituency Secretary of the National Democratic Congress and withdrawn from the constituency chairmanship race amid the controversy. The allegations have triggered public concern and calls for a thorough investigation into both the claims against the headmaster and the handling of earlier complaints by school and education authorities
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.title_zh: 奥布阿西SHTS性侵案：据我所知，Zakaria Abdulai现已获释
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.body_zh: 《Joy新闻》调查记者曼纳塞·阿祖雷·阿武尼表示，奥布阿西高级技术学校（SHTS）被停职的校长扎卡里亚·阿卜杜莱据称涉嫌对女学生实施性侵，却仍能自由行动。10月24日星期六，阿武尼先生在《Joy新闻》的《新闻档案》节目中表示，据他了解，这名校长并未被拘留，在与警方接触后仍可自由活动。他说：“据我所知，扎卡里亚目前至少还是自由人，因为我8月25日离开奥布阿西时，他还没有被捕。”阿祖雷先生解释称，尽管有报道称学生曾袭击校长，但他理解，这起事件正被用作允许校长恢复职务的理由。他还称，有说法称警方曾联系一名据称受害者的父亲，并试图私下解决此事。他说：“但即使在那之前，女孩的父亲就说警方给他打了电话。那名男子希望双方坐下来解决此事，以免案件公开，但女孩的父亲拒绝了。”据阿武尼先生称，此后校长在其他平台上表示，警方已对他提出警告，并准予其以具结方式获释。记者补充道：“他直接走到警方那里。警方听完他的说法后说，你可以走了。”阿武尼先生进一步声称，这名校长最近曾在阿克拉会见全国民主大会（NDC）职能执行委员会成员，并认为尽管存在上述指控，他仍在四处活动。这场争议源于阿祖雷先生对《令人惧怕的校长的平房内景》的调查，该调查详细披露了针对该校女学生的性侵指控。其中一个案件涉及一名20岁的学生，她指控阿卜杜莱先生于2026年7月25日在校园内其官方住所强奸了她。警方声明称，这名学生于8月4日在父亲陪同下向奥布阿西家庭暴力与受害者支援组报告了此事。她还指控校长给了她GH¢100，让其保持沉默。有关指控仍在调查之中。调查还报道称，在校长被停职数月前，学校管理层、教育官员和其他主管部门就已获知有关涉嫌性侵的投诉。相关情况曝光后，教育部长哈鲁纳·伊德里苏指示加纳教育局（GES）停职阿卜杜莱先生，并将此事移交刑事调查局调查。内政部长穆罕默德·蒙塔卡·穆巴拉克随后于10月20日披露，这名校长因相关指控已被逮捕。警方调查包括努力获取DNA证据，案件材料也已移送总检察长办公室征求意见。阿卜杜莱先生否认有不法行为，并称自己受到警告后获准以具结方式保释。他还辞去了全国民主大会朱阿本选区秘书的职务，并在争议期间退出了选区主席竞选。这些指控引发公众担忧，并呼吁对针对校长的指控以及学校和教育主管部门处理此前投诉的情况展开全面调查

https://www.myjoyonline.com/sexual-abuse.body: The Deputy Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Tourism Development Company, Felicity Nelson, has called for an end to the practice of traditional and religious leaders intervening to seek private settlements in sexual abuse cases instead of allowing the police to investigate. Speaking on JoyNews’ Newsfile on Saturday, October 24, Ms Nelson said the practice of elders, chiefs, queen mothers, pastors and imams pleading on behalf of alleged perpetrators of sexual offences undermines accountability and must be discouraged. Her comments follow allegations of sexual abuse involving female students at Obuasi Senior High Technical School, which have raised concerns about child protection and the handling of complaints within educational institutions. "We have to look culturally as Ghanaians and say this idea that when someone commits a crime, especially of a sexual nature, where elders, church leaders, imams, chiefs and queen mothers go and beg on their behalf needs to stop," she stated. "If it was even my wish, we need to criminalise it," she added. Ms Nelson stressed that allegations of sexual abuse must be subjected to thorough investigations rather than resolved through informal interventions, while safeguarding the rights of all parties involved. She also urged authorities to prioritise the welfare of the alleged victims by ensuring they receive adequate psychological, emotional and medical support. "Of course, all allegations must be investigated. As it stands now, these still remain allegations, so we are still saying yes, let's investigate. However, I want us to prioritise the victims in this case, their wants, their needs," she said. "We need to ensure that they are fine. We need to ensure that psychologically they are okay, emotionally they are fine. In terms of health, we need to do those checks," she emphasised. Highlighting the broader problem of sexual abuse in Ghana, Ms Nelson cited UNICEF reports which, according to her, indicated that 22 per cent of adolescent girls had experienced some form of sexual abuse, while another report suggested that 51 per cent of girls in secondary schools experienced sexual abuse between 2019 and 2021. She described the situation as endemic, warning that the allegations at Obuasi Senior High Technical School reflect a wider national concern, with many incidents going unreported. "This is endemic, it's a serious issue. Inasmuch as we are talking about Obuasi, we need to be mindful of the fact that this is not just happening at Obuasi," she noted. The Deputy CEO further called for stronger safeguarding systems to protect children, ensure complaints are appropriately handled and prevent alleged perpetrators from escaping scrutiny through community interventions
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sexual-abuse.title_zh: 性侵应触发警方调查，而非社区介入
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sexual-abuse.body_zh: 加纳旅游发展公司副首席执行官费莉希蒂·纳尔逊呼吁停止一种做法：传统和宗教领袖在性侵案件中出面为涉嫌犯罪者争取私下和解，而不是让警方展开调查。纳尔逊女士于10月24日星期六在JoyNews《新闻档案》节目中表示，长老、酋长、王后母亲、牧师和伊玛目代表涉嫌实施性犯罪者求情的做法，会削弱问责机制，必须加以遏制。此前，奥布阿西高级高中技术学校曝出涉及女学生的性侵指控，引发了人们对儿童保护以及教育机构处理投诉方式的关注。纳尔逊女士说：“作为加纳人，我们必须在文化层面进行反思，并明确指出，当有人犯罪，尤其是实施性犯罪时，长老、教会领袖、伊玛目、酋长和王后母亲出面为犯罪者求情的做法必须停止。她还补充道：“即便这只是我的个人愿望，我们也需要将这种行为入罪。”纳尔逊女士强调，性侵指控必须接受彻底调查，而不应通过非正式干预解决，同时要保障所有相关方的权利。她还敦促当局优先保障涉嫌受害者的福祉，确保他们获得充分的心理、情绪和医疗支持。她说：“当然，所有指控都必须调查。就目前情况而言，这些仍属于指控，所以我们仍在说，没错，应该展开调查。不过，我希望我们优先关注本案的受害者，关注他们的意愿和需求。我们必须确保他们安然无恙，确保他们的心理状态良好、情绪稳定。在健康方面，我们需要进行相关检查。”在谈及加纳更广泛的性侵问题时，纳尔逊女士援引了UNICEF报告。据她说，相关报告显示，22%的青春期女孩经历过某种形式的性侵；另一份报告则表明，2019年至2021年间，中学女生中有51%经历过性侵。她将这一情况描述为普遍存在的问题，并警告称，奥布阿西高级高中技术学校的指控反映了一个更广泛的全国性隐患，许多事件并未得到举报。她指出：“这是一种普遍存在的现象，是一个严重问题。既然我们正在讨论奥布阿西，就必须意识到，情况并非只发生在奥布阿西。”这位副首席执行官还呼吁建立更完善的儿童保护制度，保护儿童、确保投诉得到妥善处理，并防止涉嫌犯罪者借由社区干预逃避审查

https://www.myjoyonline.com/abeiku-santa.summary: Deputy Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Tourism Authority (GTA) in charge of Marketing and Special Duties, Gilbert Abeiku Aggrey aka Santana, has asked the Tourism Minister to intervene in recurring difficulties accessing the Authority’s CEO, Maame Efua Houadjeto, for urgent consultations. President John Dramani Mahama appointed Abeiku Santana as Deputy Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Tourism Authority in February 2025 after the National Democratic Congress assumed office on 7th January 2025.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/abeiku-santa.summary_zh: 加纳旅游局（GTA）负责市场营销和特别事务的副首席执行官Gilbert Abeiku Aggrey（又名Santana），已请求旅游部长介入，解决无法及时联系该局首席执行官Maame Efua Houadjeto进行紧急磋商的反复问题。2025年1月7日National Democratic Congress就任后，John Dramani Mahama总统于2025年2月任命Abeiku Santana为加纳旅游局副首席执行官。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/abeiku-santa.body: Deputy Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Tourism Authority (GTA) in charge of Marketing and Special Duties, Gilbert Abeiku Aggrey aka Santana, has asked the Tourism Minister to intervene in recurring difficulties accessing the Authority’s CEO, Maame Efua Houadjeto, for urgent consultations. In a letter dated Thursday, 22nd October 2026, and addressed to the Minister of Tourism, Culture and Creative Arts, Abla Dzifa Gomashie, Abeiku said the challenge was affecting his ability to obtain timely guidance, approvals and decisions needed to carry out his responsibilities, particularly in domestic tourism, special events and marketing. “On several occasions, I have had to request meetings through the CEO’s secretary or personal assistant, only to be informed that she is unavailable,” he stated. He acknowledged the demands on the CEO’s schedule but said the situation had made it difficult for him to perform his duties effectively. “This situation sometimes causes delays in operations, stakeholder engagements, and the implementation of key assignments,” Mr Aggrey wrote. He also stressed that his concerns were not intended as a personal complaint but were aimed at addressing what he considers a communication gap within the institution. “My intention is not to make a personal complaint, but to highlight a communication gap that needs to be addressed in the interest of effective management and institutional efficiency,” he said. Abeiku has consequently asked the Minister to intervene to help establish a more effective arrangement for communication and consultation between himself and the CEO, particularly on urgent official matters. “I therefore respectfully seek your intervention, with the knowledge of the Board Chairperson, to help establish a more effective communication and consultation arrangement between the CEO and my office, especially on urgent official matters,” he stated. Despite the concerns raised, Mr Aggrey reaffirmed his commitment to working with the CEO and the Authority’s management team. “I remain committed to working professionally with the CEO and the entire management team to achieve the Ministry’s objectives and strengthen the performance of the Ghana Tourism Authority,” he said. President John Dramani Mahama appointed Abeiku Santana as Deputy Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Tourism Authority in February 2025 after the National Democratic Congress assumed office on 7th January 2025. Abeiku Santana is a broadcaster, tourism advocate and entrepreneur with experience in media, marketing, travel and hospitality. He is the Chief Executive Officer of Kaya Tours Ghana Limited and holds a master’s degree in Tourism Management from the University of Cape Coast and a master’s degree in Marketing Strategy from the University of Ghana Business School
https://www.myjoyonline.com/abeiku-santa.title_zh: Abeiku Santana对接触GTA首席执行官Maame Efua Houadjeto提出担忧
https://www.myjoyonline.com/abeiku-santa.body_zh: 加纳旅游局（GTA）分管市场营销和特别事务的副首席执行官Gilbert Abeiku Aggrey（又名Santana）已请求旅游部长介入，解决他难以联系该局首席执行官Maame Efua Houadjeto并就紧急事务进行磋商的反复问题。在一封日期为2026年10月22日星期四、收件人为旅游、文化和创意艺术部长Abla Dzifa Gomashie的信函中，Abeiku表示，这一难题影响了他及时获得履行职责所需指导、批准和决策的能力，尤其是在国内旅游、特别活动和市场营销方面。他说：“我曾多次不得不通过首席执行官的秘书或个人助理请求会面，却只被告知她无法出席。”他承认首席执行官的日程十分繁忙，但表示这一情况使他难以有效履行职责。Aggrey先生写道：“这种情况有时会导致业务运营、利益相关方沟通以及关键任务落实延误。”他还强调，他的意见并非意在提出个人投诉，而是为了解决他认为机构内部存在的沟通鸿沟。他说：“我的本意不是提出个人投诉，而是指出一个需要解决的沟通鸿沟，以便实现有效管理和提高机构效率。”因此，Abeiku请求部长介入，帮助建立他本人与首席执行官之间更有效的沟通和磋商机制，尤其是在紧急公务事项方面。他表示：“因此，在董事会主席知情的情况下，我谨请您介入，帮助建立首席执行官与我的办公室之间更有效的沟通和磋商机制，尤其是在紧急公务事项方面。”尽管提出了上述担忧，Aggrey先生仍重申，他愿与首席执行官和该局管理团队合作。他说：“我仍致力于与首席执行官和整个管理团队以专业方式合作，实现该部的目标，并加强加纳旅游局的绩效。”2025年2月，在民族民主大会于2025年1月7日就任后，John Dramani Mahama总统任命Abeiku Santana为加纳旅游局副首席执行官。Abeiku Santana是一名 broadcaster、旅游业倡导者和企业家，拥有媒体、市场营销、旅游及酒店接待业经验。他现任Kaya Tours Ghana Limited首席执行官，并拥有开普敦大学旅游管理硕士学位及加纳大学商学院营销战略硕士学位

Unlock these with Subscription All India Students' Association president Neha Bora will not sign a peace bond before a Special Executive Magistrate, the student leader said on Saturday (October 24, 2026), a day after the Delhi High Court dismissed the plea challenging a police notice directing Bora to provide a personal bond of ₹10,000 with one surety. Questioning the rationale behind the notice, Bora asked, “Whose peace am I being asked to keep?” The police notice, issued on October 17 under Section 126 of the BNSS, asked the student leader to appear before a special executive magistrate (SEM) on October 19 and show cause as to why a personal bond of ₹10,000 with one surety “for keeping peace for a period of inquiry” should not be executed. Addressing the press at the CPI(ML) Liberation Parliamentary office here, Bora said demonstrating peacefully on the streets is a democratic right, and questioned how raising concerns against the government could be construed as a threat to peace. “If we do not ask the government any questions, whose peace are we keeping?” Bora asked, stressing that the right to question those in power and express dissent is fundamental to a democracy. Bora asserted that the fight against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, regardless of the direction it takes, must not come at the cost of labelling the right to dissent as a threat to peace. The notice was issued on October 17, a day after Delhi Police detained Bora during the 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march in the capital. The demonstration was part of the protests demanding Mr. Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Bora had challenged the notice in the Delhi High Court, terming the preventive proceedings an attempt to suppress peaceful dissent, and said that the notice did not adequately establish the likelihood of a breach of peace. The student leader maintained that peaceful protests and democratic opposition should not be treated as violations of public order, emphasising that the right to dissent must be protected. 全印度学生协会主席内哈·博拉周六（2026年10月24日）表示，在特别行政治安法官面前，她不会签署治安保证书。此前一天，德里高等法院驳回了针对警方通知的申诉。该通知要求博拉提供一份金额为₹10,000、由一名担保人担保的个人保证书。

博拉质疑这份通知背后的理由，问道：“他们要求我维护的是谁的治安？”

警方于10月17日依据《BNSS》第126条发出通知，要求这位学生领袖于10月19日到特别行政治安法官（SEM）面前说明，为何不应签署一份金额为₹10,000、由一名担保人担保的个人保证书，以“在调查期间维护治安”。

博拉在位于此地的印度共产党（马克思主义—列宁主义）解放议会办公室向记者表示，在街头和平示威是民主权利，并质疑为何向政府提出关切会被视为对治安的威胁。

“如果我们不向政府提出任何问题，那么我们维护的是谁的治安？”博拉问道。她强调，质疑执政者并表达异议的权利，是民主制度的基本权利。

博拉断言，无论反对首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔的斗争最终走向何方，都不能以将表达异议的权利定性为对治安的威胁为代价。

该通知于10月17日发出。就在前一天，德里警方曾在首都举行的“Lehra Do Tiranga”游行期间拘留博拉。此次示威是抗议活动的一部分，活动要求库马马尔先生辞职，原因是选民名册特别密集修订（SIR） allegedly存在违规行为。

博拉曾在德里高等法院对该通知提出挑战，称这些预防性程序是压制和平异议的企图，并表示通知未能充分证明可能发生破坏治安行为。

这位学生领袖坚持认为，和平抗议和民主反对不应被视为违反公共秩序的行为，并强调必须保护表达异议的权利。

Unlock these with Subscription Union Home Minister Amit Shah reached the Delhi Police headquarters on Saturday (October 24, 2026) afternoon to take stock of the law and order situation in the national capital, officials said. The recent protests by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) , the fight against drugs, action against gangsters operating from abroad and crimes against women are likely to figure in Shah’s discussions with senior officers, police sources said. Mr. Shah reached the police headquarters on Jai Singh Road around 3 p.m., where senior officers will brief him on the force's performance, ongoing investigations and key law enforcement challenges, they said. The visit comes amid heightened scrutiny of the Delhi Police over allegations of using excessive force against protesters during the CJP's 'Sansad Chalo' march in July. The meeting is expected to review the circumstances surrounding the protest, the police response and measures taken to prevent similar incidents in the future, the sources said. The Home Minister's visit is also expected to boost the morale of the force, which has been under fire of late over its handling of protests, they said. The meeting will also provide an opportunity for the senior leadership to discuss operational challenges and outline the steps taken to maintain law and order in the capital. Mr. Shah's visit marks his return to the Delhi Police headquarters after more than four years. He last visited the police headquarters on August 30, 2022. The meeting is also expected to focus on the government's key priorities, including curbing drug trafficking, dismantling criminal networks of gangsters based overseas, and strengthening action against crimes targeting women, the sources said. Unlock these with Subscription The Telangana State Road Transport Corporation (TGSRTC) is in the process of retrofitting 250 old diesel buses into electric vehicles in the first phase as part of its efforts to reduce emissions. Speaking on Saturday (October 24, 2026) at the foundation-laying ceremony for a new bus terminal at Uppal Zonal Workshop, with an estimated cost of ₹3.22 crore, Mr. Ponnam Parbhakar, Minister of Transport and BC Welfare, said that the move was part of a larger push toward clean mobility. He added that 3,000 electric buses have already been added to the RTC fleet, and another 2,200 are expected to be inducted under the PM e-Drive initiative. Touching upon the principal demand of TGSRTC workers and unions to merge the corporation with the government, he said that efforts toward this are underway. Following the recently held trade union elections after a gap of 10 years, a committee would be constituted with the elected recognised union to initiate the process, he added. The Minister said the government was also in the process of addressing the issue of pensions of retired employees and clearing pending contributions relating to the CCS and provident fund in phases. Pay Revision Commission (PRC) recommendations had been implemented, and no DA was outstanding, he said. Referring to the flagship Mahalakshmi scheme, Mr. Prabhakar said women had made several crore journeys free of cost under the scheme, resulting in substantial savings on travel expenses. The RTC was being developed with a focus on passenger convenience, employee welfare and the protection of the organisation, he said. The proposed bus terminal at Uppal would have modern facilities to serve nearly one lakh passengers a day. About 1,053 bus trips originate from the location, with services connecting places such as Bhongir, Yadagirigutta, Hanamkonda and Warangal. The terminal would serve the Peerzadiguda and Boduppal areas and be named accordingly, Mr Prabhakar said. The project is expected to be completed within 100 days. Mr. Prabhakar also said the government was promoting electric vehicles through its EV policy, under which zero tax was applicable to eligible vehicles. An allocation of ₹200 crore has been earmarked for electric vehicles, including autos, in the Core Urban Region. Automated testing stations were also being established, while reflectors and a vehicle scrapping policy had been introduced to improve road safety. 特伦甘纳邦公路运输公司（TGSRTC）正着手在第一阶段将250辆老旧柴油公交车改装为电动汽车，以推动减少排放。交通与Backward Class福利部长Ponnam Parbhakar先生于2026年10月24日星期六在Uppal分区车间新公交总站奠基仪式上表示，该项目预计耗资₹3.22 crore，是推动清洁出行更大行动的一部分。他补充说，RTC车队已经增加3,000辆电动公交车，根据PM e-Drive计划，预计还将有另外2,200辆电动公交车投入运营。

谈及TGSRTC员工和工会将公司与政府合并的主要诉求时，他表示，相关工作正在推进。他补充说，在时隔10年 recently举行的工会选举之后，将与当选且获认可的工会成立一个委员会，启动这一程序。

部长表示，政府也正着手分阶段解决退休员工养老金问题，并清理与公务员薪酬体系（CCS）和公积金有关的未缴款项。他说，薪酬修订委员会（PRC）的建议已经落实，没有拖欠的DA。

谈及旗舰项目Mahalakshmi计划时，Prabhakar先生表示，女性已经通过该计划免费乘坐了数百万次公共交通，从而大幅节省了出行费用。他说，RTC的发展重点是方便乘客、福祉员工和保护该组织。

拟建的Uppal公交总站将配备现代化设施，每日可服务近10万名乘客。约有1,053趟公交线路从该地点始发，连接Bhongir、Yadagirigutta、Hanamkonda和Warangal等地。Prabhakar先生说，该总站将服务Peerzadiguda和Boduppal地区，并据此命名。项目预计将在100天内完工。

Prabhakar先生还表示，政府正通过电动汽车政策推动电动汽车发展，符合条件的车辆可享受零税率优惠。核心城市区域已划拨₹200 crore用于包括自动三轮车在内的电动汽车。政府还在建设自动化检测站，并推出反光标志和车辆报废政策，以改善道路安全。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/kadu.body: The Kaduna State Government has dismissed as fabricated a viral letter alleging that Gov. Uba Sani approved and released N2.3 trillion for the APC presidential campaign flag-off. The government described the purported letter as fraudulent and misleading, accusing its authors of attempting to damage the governor’s reputation for fiscal discipline and responsible governance. The Commissioner for Information and Culture, Malam Ahmed Maiyaki, stated this in a statement on Saturday in Kaduna. Maiyaki said the letter, dated Oct. 18, 2026, and titled “Notification for Preparations for the Grand Rally Flag Off”, contained inconsistencies that questioned its authenticity. He said the purported letter, allegedly addressed to Sen. Abdulazeez Yari, Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, falsely claimed that N2.3 trillion was released for the campaign flag-off. The commissioner noted that Kaduna’s 2026 budget stood at N985.92 billion, making the alleged expenditure more than twice the state’s annual budget. He said the claim was financially implausible and unsupported by any authentic appropriation, approval or expenditure records. Maiyaki also identified irregularities, including the misspelling of the governor’s surname as “Uba Sai” and the apparent unauthorised reproduction of his signature. “The Kaduna State Government categorically disowns this document. Gov. Uba Sani neither authored nor authorised the purported letter, and no N2.3 trillion was budgeted, approved or released,” he said. He described the allegation as fictitious and a deliberate attempt to mislead the public. Maiyaki said that since assuming office on May 29, 2023, Sani had prioritised fiscal discipline, transparency, accountability and prudent management of public resources. He listed investments in security, infrastructure, education, healthcare, agriculture and social protection among the administration’s priorities. The commissioner expressed concern over what he described as coordinated misinformation aimed at discrediting the governor and his administration ahead of the 2027 general elections. He warned that fabricating official correspondence and circulating false financial claims could constitute criminal offences. “Political competition must be conducted within the bounds of truth, decency and the law,” Maiyaki said, urging critics to rely on credible evidence when questioning government expenditure. He disclosed that steps were being taken to establish the origin of the purported letter. Maiyaki also called on security and investigative agencies to examine the document and ensure that anyone found culpable faced appropriate legal action. He urged media organisations and members of the public to verify documents before circulating or publishing allegations concerning public expenditure. The commissioner reaffirmed the administration’s commitment to peace, institutional strengthening, infrastructure development, citizens’ welfare and sustainable governance. He said the government would remain focused on prudent financial management and would not be distracted by what it described as deliberate misinformation. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/kadu.body_zh: 卡杜纳州政府斥责一封 viral 信件纯属捏造。该信谎称州长乌巴·萨尼批准并拨付2.3万亿奈拉，用于APC总统竞选活动启动仪式。州政府称这封所谓的信函欺诈且误导，指控其制作者企图损害州长在财政纪律和负责任治理方面的声誉。信息与文化专员艾哈迈德·马亚基周六在卡杜纳发表声明称，马亚基说，这封信日期为2026年10月18日，题为《关于准备盛大集会启动仪式的通知》，其中存在矛盾之处，令其真实性受到质疑。他说，这封据称致APC总统竞选委员会主任阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里的信函谎称已为竞选启动仪式拨付2.3万亿奈拉。该专员指出，卡杜纳州2026年预算为9859.2亿奈拉，因此所谓支出超过该州年度预算的两倍。他说，这一说法在财政上难以置信，也没有任何真实的拨款、批准或支出记录予以支持。马亚基还指出文件存在多项异常，包括将州长姓氏误写为“Uba Sai”，以及显然未经授权复制其签名。他说：“卡杜纳州政府坚决否认这份文件。乌巴·萨尼州长既没有撰写也没有授权这封所谓的信函，2.3万亿奈拉既未被列入预算，也未获批准或拨付。”他称这一指控纯属虚构，是企图误导公众的蓄意行为。马亚基说，萨尼自2023年5月29日就任以来，始终把财政纪律、透明度、问责和公共资源审慎管理置于优先位置。他列举了增加安全、基础设施、教育、医疗保健、农业和社会保护领域投入等本届政府的优先事项。该专员对所谓协调实施的错误信息表示关切，称其目的是在2027年大选前抹黑州长及其政府。他警告，伪造官方信函和散布虚假财务说法可能构成刑事犯罪。马亚基说：“政治竞争必须在真理、体面和法律的界限内进行。”他敦促批评者在质疑政府支出时依据可信证据。他透露，当局正在采取措施查明这封所谓信函的来源。马亚基还呼吁安全和调查机构审查该文件，确保任何被认定负有责任的人都受到适当法律制裁。他敦促媒体机构和公众在传播或发布有关公共支出的指控前核实文件。该专员重申，本届政府致力于和平、制度强化、基础设施发展、公民福祉和可持续治理。他说，政府将继续专注于审慎的财务管理，不会被其所称的蓄意错误信息分散注意力。（NAN）此处发表的评论不代表Vanguard报纸及其任何雇员的观点

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council has accused the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential candidate, f ormer Vice President Atiku Abubakar, o f planning to discredit the ruling party’s presidential campaign flag-off in Kaduna today. The allegation was contained in a statement signed by Dele Alake, spokesperson for the APC Presidential Campaign Council. The council alleged that Atiku and the ADC had deployed what it described as “fake news operations,” including artificial intelligence-generated content, deepfake videos and counterfeit documents, to discredit President Bola Tinubu, Kaduna State Governor Uba Sani and other APC leaders. The council said the alleged campaign began with the circulation of a photograph showing a security vehicle stationed near an APC campaign billboard in Kaduna. According to the APC, the photograph was presented as evidence that security agents had been deployed to protect the party’s billboards. The council also alleged that a purported letter from Mr Sani to the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Abdulaziz Yari, claiming that the Kaduna State Government released N2.3 trillion to host the rally, was fabricated. The APC described the claim as “utterly baseless,” noting that Kaduna State’s budgets for 2024, 2025 and 2026 amounted to less than N2.3 trillion. “We are still at a loss as to how anyone can imagine and concoct this senseless and utterly baseless lie that defies logic and basic common sense. How much is the entire annual revenue of Kaduna State, or any state, for that matter, that a state would spend N2.3 trillion to host a rally? “The N2.3 trillion that Atiku and his hirelings are circulating online is more than Kaduna State’s annual budget for three years,” the statement said. The APC alleged that the figures were intended to create a negative impression about the cost of hosting the rally. It further accused the opposition of planning to circulate “old, doctored and deepfake videos” during the rally to create the impression that residents were opposed to the APC campaign. “We hereby use this opportunity to alert the general public about this malicious and ignoble plan,” the council said. The APC also urged Nigerians to be vigilant and reject what it described as attempts to manipulate public opinion ahead of the 2027 general elections. The allegations were made as the APC begins its presidential campaign for the 2027 election with a flag-off rally in Kaduna today. President Bola Tinubu is expected to attend the rally at the Kaduna Township Stadium, where the party is expected to mobilise supporters from across the country. The APC had earlier announced Kaduna as the starting point of its nationwide campaign programme. The Kaduna APC has said it is targeting a large turnout for the event, while a support group, Arewa for Asiwaju, said it plans to mobilise 10,000 supporters from the 19 northern states and the Federal Capital Territory. The party’s campaign council has said the Kaduna rally will mark the formal commencement of its drive to secure Mr Tinubu’s re-election in 2027, with subsequent presidential rallies scheduled across the country. The APC’s proposed itinerary includes rallies in Rivers State on 7 November, Plateau on 14 November, Oyo on 21 November, Borno on 25 November, Enugu on 28 November and Bauchi on 29 November, among other states
