https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——白宫周五宣布，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普促成俄罗斯与乌克兰即将在饱受战火摧残的乌克兰城市奥列什基停火，以便运送人道主义援助并疏散平民。白宫称，梅拉尼娅·特朗普启动了相关磋商，她与一名代表直接同俄乌领导层合作，确定停火条款。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — First lady Melania Trump has brokered an upcoming ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the war-ravaged Ukrainian city of Oleshky to allow for humanitarian aid and the evacuation of civilians, the White House announced on Friday. The White House said Melania Trump had initiated the discussions and that she and a representative worked directly with Russian and Ukrainian leadership to define the terms of the ceasefire. “Under our agreement: first a ceasefire will be put in place; second, humanitarian aid will be delivered to Oleshky; and third, civilians will be allowed to move freely out of Oleshky,” Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine’s human rights ombudsman, said in a video message posted online. “The operation will be carried out gradually and is extremely challenging to implement. I will therefore keep Ukrainian society informed and share the results of the operation.” Russia’s chief of the general staff, Gen. Valery Gerasimov, said Russian forces “will cease fire on the Kherson axis” starting at 4 a.m. Tuesday Moscow time “in connection with the humanitarian operation near Oleshky.” The Russian forces will also carry out “engineering reconnaissance” and ensure “safe movement of the humanitarian convoy” into the city, Gerasimov said. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov also said Moscow was grateful to the first lady and that effort was discussed during the latest call between Russian President Vladimir Putin and President Donald Trump, he said. Peskov said "those who want to leave it would be able to do so.” He would not say whether those who evacuate will be taken to Russia- or Ukraine-held territory. He also demurred when asked how long the evacuation will last, saying only it would likely take several days. Melania Trump has made helping children in conflict one of her signature issues and hosted a U.N. Security Council meeting on the issue earlier this year. She has written Putin to work on efforts to reunite families with children who have been displaced by the war . “What she wants to do is save children, and that’s her focus,” the president said of the first lady during a question-and-answer exchange with journalists in Washington. The development comes as tensions have increased to new highs between the Trump administration and Ukraine’s government. Kyiv has faced restrictions on the satellite internet system that it relies on to knock down Russian attacks, with Trump and other top U.S. officials sending mixed messages about who was responsible for throttling the Elon Musk-made Starshield system. Trump also has recently waived new Russian sanctions , reached an agreement with Russia to import diesel and pushed Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to make a deal to end the war that began in February 2022. In renewed efforts to revive the peace process , Trump envoy Steve Witkoff traveled to Norway this week for talks with Zelenskyy before meeting with Putin in St. Petersburg, Russia. Zelenskyy did not mention the ceasefire in Oleshky during a remote appearance at the Hudson Institute, a Washington think tank. He did note that American Patriot missile interceptors were still on hold and Starshield and Starlink speed limits were still in place. He also spoke of the importance of the United States to renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war, including a possible joint meeting with Trump and Putin. Food and medical supplies have been scarce for months in Oleshky, which sits on the Dnipro River that separates Ukrainian forces from the city’s Russian occupiers. There is no electricity, heat or running water. Roads leading from town are mined and dotted with burned-out cars. Drones buzz overhead. Once a city of about 24,000 residents, Oleshky was captured by Moscow’s forces on the first day of their full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. Its buildings were shelled and burned, and its infrastructure damaged. In June 2023, floodwaters inundated the city after the Kakhovka Dam collapsed from an explosion that an Associated Press investigation found was likely caused by the Russian military. Hundreds of residents were killed. Those left in the city along Ukraine’s southeastern front face death from hunger or disease as another harsh winter looms. Ukraine has appealed repeatedly for a local ceasefire to organize evacuations. Russia, as the occupying power, is obligated by international law to ensure civilians under its control have what they need to survive. Melania Trump said in the White House news release that civilian leaders from Ukraine and Russia will visit Oleshky residents to determine the level of assistance they require. “Residents who wish to evacuate will receive coordinated support and transportation to their preferred destination,” she said. “I anticipate some will want to go to Russia, and some to Ukraine.” Melania Trump also said “an impartial American media organization” will accompany and document Russian and Ukrainian teams on the ground throughout the process. "This will play a significant role in ensuring that the wishes of each family are faithfully respected,” she said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 白宫称，梅拉尼娅·特朗普推动促成俄军占领的乌克兰城市达成停火协议
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——白宫周五宣布，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普已促成俄罗斯与乌克兰即将在饱受战争蹂躏的乌克兰城市奥列什基停火，以便运送人道主义援助并撤离平民。白宫表示，梅拉尼娅·特朗普启动了相关讨论，她和一名代表直接与俄罗斯和乌克兰领导层合作，确定停火条件。乌克兰人权专员德米特罗·卢比涅茨在网上发布的视频中说：“根据我们的协议：第一，实施停火；第二，向奥列什基运送人道主义援助；第三，允许平民自由撤离奥列什基。”“行动将逐步实施，执行难度极大。因此，我会让乌克兰社会了解情况，并通报行动成果。”俄罗斯总参谋长瓦列里·格拉西莫夫将军说，从周二莫斯科时间凌晨4时开始，俄军将“在赫尔松轴线上停止交火”，以配合奥列什基附近的人道主义行动。格拉西莫夫说，俄军还将进行“工程侦察”，确保“人道主义车队”安全进入该市。克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫也表示，莫斯科感谢这位第一夫人，并称双方在俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京与唐纳德·特朗普总统最近一次通话中讨论了相关努力。佩斯科夫说：“那些想离开的人将能够离开。”当被问及撤离人员将被送往俄罗斯控制区还是乌克兰控制区时，他不予置评。被问及撤离将持续多久时，他也拒绝回答，只表示可能需要数天。帮助冲突地区的儿童一直是梅拉尼娅·特朗普重点关注的议题之一。今年早些时候，她主持了一场联合国安理会会议，讨论这一问题。她还曾致信普京，推动努力让因战争流离失所的儿童与家人团聚。特朗普总统在华盛顿与记者问答时评价这位第一夫人说：“她想做的是拯救儿童，这就是她关注的重点。”此次进展正值特朗普政府与乌克兰政府之间的紧张关系升至新高度之际。基辅一直受到卫星互联网系统使用限制的影响，该系统是乌克兰打击俄罗斯袭击所依赖的工具；特朗普和其他美国高层对限制埃隆·马斯克旗下Starshield系统的责任归属发出了不一致的信息。特朗普最近还豁免了新一轮对俄制裁，与俄罗斯达成进口柴油协议，并推动乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基达成结束2022年2月开战的协议。为再次推动和平进程，特朗普特使史蒂夫·维特科夫本周前往挪威，与泽连斯基会谈，随后将在俄罗斯圣彼得堡与普京会面。泽连斯基在华盛顿智库Hudson Institute远程出镜时没有提及奥列什基停火。他确实指出，美国爱国者导弹拦截系统仍处于暂缓状态，Starshield和Starlink的速度限制仍然有效。他还谈到美国重新开展外交努力、推动结束战争的重要性，包括特朗普与普京可能举行联合会议。奥列什基位于第聂伯河畔，该河将乌克兰军队与占据该市的俄军分隔开来。数月来，当地食品和医疗物资一直短缺。市内没有电力、供暖和自来水。通往该镇的道路布满地雷，散落着烧毁的汽车。无人机的嗡嗡声不断掠过上空。奥列什基曾有约2.4万名居民，2022年2月俄军全面入侵乌克兰的第一天，该市便被莫斯科军队攻占。市内外建筑遭到炮击和焚烧，基础设施遭到破坏。2023年6月，卡霍夫卡大坝因爆炸坍塌，洪水淹没该市；美联社调查发现，这次爆炸很可能是俄军所为，数百名居民死亡。随着又一个严寒冬季逼近，留在乌克兰东南前线这座城市里的居民面临饥荒或疾病导致的死亡。乌克兰一再呼吁当地停火，以便组织撤离。作为占领国，俄罗斯有义务依据国际法确保其控制下的平民获得生存所需物资。梅拉尼娅·特朗普在白宫新闻稿中说，来自乌克兰和俄罗斯的平民领导人将走访奥列什基居民，以确定他们需要何种程度的援助。她说：“希望撤离的居民将获得协调一致的支援和交通服务，以送往他们选择的目的地。”“我预计有些人希望前往俄罗斯，有些人希望前往乌克兰。”梅拉尼娅·特朗普还表示，一家“公正的美国媒体组织”将在整个过程中随行，记录俄罗斯和乌克兰团队的现场行动。她说：“这将在确保忠实尊重每个家庭的意愿方面发挥重要作用。”

The Mumbai-headquartered refiner’s net profit declined to ₹4,993.17 crore in the reported quarter compared to ₹6,442.5 crore in the same period last year. The state-owned oil-marketing company’s cost of materials consumed soared 44.2% during the period to ₹74,969 crore. Revenues increased about 30% on a year-over-year basis to more than ₹1.58 lakh crore. The refiners’ physical performance reported an uptick. It rose 6% during the mentioned period to 10.41 million metric tonnes (MMT). Unlock these with Subscription Rescuers combed through a remote area in the Chinese region of Tibet on Friday (October 23, 2026) after a magnitude 7 earthquake that killed at least 16 people, injured 54 and collapsed hundreds of homes, according to Chinese state media. The disaster struck Nagqu, a city north of Tibet’s capital, Lhasa, which is some 4,800 meters (5,249 yards) above sea level, on Thursday (October 22, 2026). At least 339 homes collapsed, and officials told journalists they were concerned about further building collapses from aftershocks, as well as casualties from rockslides. More than 5,000 people from three local counties were deployed for rescue efforts. Supplies, including 2,000 prefabricated housing units, around 3,400 tents and 2,000 folding beds, as well as flashlights and winter clothing arrived in the region. The U.S. Geological Survey said the quake occurred at 10:33 p.m. local time on Thursday (October 22, 2026), with its epicentre 191 kilometres (119 miles) east-northeast of Nagqu. It put the earthquake’s depth at 18 kilometers (11 miles). ALSO WATCH Watch: Rescue operations continue in Tibet after 7.0-magnitude earthquake The U.S. agency recorded at least seven aftershocks with magnitudes between 4.3 and 5.2, all of them with a depth of 10 kilometers (6 miles), according to its website. China’s official news agency Xinhua said on Friday (October 23, 2026) that communication in some areas hit by the quake was down. Local railway authorities have taken emergency action to halt trains passing through the region. The earthquake also caused rockfalls that have forced local authorities to close a section of National Highway 317, allowing only emergency, rescue and official support vehicles through as crews worked to clear debris, according to Xinhua. Intermittent snows are expected in the earthquake region over the next three days, Xinhua said. Chinese President Xi Jinping called for all-out efforts in rescue operations and medical relief work, issuing instructions Friday morning. Unlock these with Subscription The Line of Actual Control (LAC) has been “disturbed” by the People’s Liberation Army’s (PLA) patrolling behaviour, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said on Friday (October 23, 2026) in response to questions about a report in The Hindu on skirmishes along the LAC in Arunachal Pradesh. The report, which had quoted the outgoing Director General of the Indo-Tibetan Border Police Forces (ITBP), Shatrujeet Kapur, expressing concern over “face-offs” underway since July 2026, drew sharp criticism from the Congress. VIDEO | Delhi: Addressing a press conference, MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal says, "As we have noted in the past, the situation in the India-China border areas gets disturbed from time to time when Chinese forces deviate from established patrolling patterns. Both sides continue to use existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve outstanding issues and avoid misunderstandings and miscalculations along the Line of Actual Control (LAC). The two sides have also agreed to discuss ways to improve their understanding of the LAC in appropriate areas for better border management. I would also like to emphasise that the maintenance of peace and tranquillity in the border areas is essential for the overall development of bilateral relations." (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd) Despite the Ministry’s confirmation, the video of Mr. Kapur’s speech, given at an event in Alwar on Thursday (October 22, 2026), was deleted from the ITBP’s official YouTube channel. This was the first time the government has officially accepted that, more than two years after Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping announced a détente between their militaries, the border areas remain tense and “get disturbed” over patrolling routes. “As we have noted in the past, the situation in the India-China border areas gets disturbed from time to time when Chinese forces diverge from established patrolling patterns,” Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal told journalists at a briefing here, blaming the PLA for the divergences. “Both sides continue to use existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve outstanding issues and avoid misunderstanding and miscalculation along the Line of Actual Control,” he added, directing queries on the specific situation to the Ministry of Defence. Mr. Jaiswal also reiterated the government’s position since the beginning of the four-year military standoff at the LAC, including the Galwan clashes in 2020, that the “maintenance of peace and tranquility in the border areas is essential for the overall development of bilateral relations”, and said that both sides were in touch about improving their understanding of the LAC for “better border management”. In a post on X , Mr. Kharge said the confirmation by the chief of ITBP forces stationed at the LAC was “deeply alarming”. The Congress chief alleged that Mr. Modi’s June 2020 statement that no one had entered Indian territory after the Galwan clashes had emboldened China. Addressing a press conference, Congress media and publicity department chairman, Pawan Khera, commended the ITBP’s ‘Shaurya Commandos’ for handling the confrontations with China, but accused the government of suppressing information from the border. “The fact that China has entered our territory does not bother [the government]; what bothers them is that this has been reported,” Mr. Khera said, adding that “image is more important for them than the country’s interests”. The Congress questioned the government’s easing of restrictions on Chinese investment and the growing trade deficit. “India’s trade deficit with China zoomed even further to a record $112 billion in 2025–26, up from $99 billion the previous year. This has simply crushed our MSMEs in many industries,” Congress leader Jairam Ramesh said in a post, adding, “Make in India has become Import from China. This staggering trade deficit is in itself a very significant threat to our economic security.” Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. They cannot be abusive or personal. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m.body_zh: 订阅账户可享受Premium Stories、社论、观点文章等权益。订阅即可解锁这些内容 实际控制线（LAC）因中国人民解放军（PLA）的巡逻行为而“受到扰动”，外交部（MEA）10月23日周五在回应《印度教徒报》关于阿鲁纳恰尔邦沿实际控制线发生冲突的报道时表示。该报道援引即将离任的印藏边境警察部队（ITBP）总局长沙特鲁吉特·卡普尔的话，对2026年7月以来持续发生的“对峙”表达担忧，引发国大党强烈批评。视频 | 德里：外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾斯瓦尔在新闻发布会上表示，“正如我们过去指出的，当中国部队偏离既定巡逻模式时，印中边境地区局势会不时受到扰动。双方继续利用现有的外交和军事机制解决未决问题，避免在实际控制线（LAC）沿线发生误解和误判。双方还同意讨论在适当区域加强相互理解以更好管理边境的方式。我还要强调，维护边境地区的和平与安宁对双边关系的整体发展至关重要。”（完整视频可在PTI Videos获取 - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd）尽管外交部予以确认，但卡普尔先生10月22日周四在阿尔瓦尔一场活动上的讲话视频已从ITBP官方YouTube频道删除。这是政府首次正式承认，在总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和中国国家主席习近平宣布两国军队缓和关系两年多后，边境地区仍处于紧张状态，并会因巡逻路线而“受到扰动”。“正如我们过去指出的，当中国部队偏离既定巡逻模式时，印中边境地区局势会不时受到扰动，”外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾斯瓦尔在新闻发布会上对记者表示，并将这种偏离归咎于解放军。“双方继续利用现有的外交和军事机制解决未决问题，避免在实际控制线沿线发生误解和误判，”他补充说，并将有关具体局势的询问转给国防部。贾斯瓦尔先生还重申了政府自实际控制线四年军事对峙开始以来的立场，包括2020年加勒万冲突，他表示“维护边境地区的和平与安宁对双边关系的整体发展至关重要”，并称双方正在就加强相互理解以实现“更好边境管理”保持沟通。在X平台上的一篇帖子中，卡尔格先生表示，驻守实际控制线的ITBP部队负责人的确认“令人深感震惊”。国大党主席指责莫迪先生2020年6月关于加勒万冲突后无人进入印度领土的声明壮大了中国的胆量。在新闻发布会上，国大党媒体与宣传部门主席帕万·凯拉赞扬了ITBP的“英勇突击队”处理与中国对峙的表现，但指责政府压制边境信息。“中国进入我国领土的事实并不困扰（政府）；困扰他们的是这一情况被报道出来，”凯拉先生说，并补充称“对他们来说，形象比国家利益更重要”。国大党质疑政府放宽对中国投资的限制以及不断扩大的贸易逆差。“印度对华贸易逆差在2025-26财年进一步飙升至创纪录的1120亿美元，高于前一年的990亿美元。这严重打击了我国许多行业的中小微企业，”国大党领袖贾伊拉姆·拉梅什在一篇帖子中表示，并补充说，“印度制造已变成从中国进口。这种惊人的贸易逆差本身就是对我国经济安全的重大威胁。” 评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子形式。评论不得带有辱骂或人身攻击。请遵守我们的社区准则发布评论。我们已迁移到新的评论平台。如果您已是《印度教徒报》注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章讨论。如果您没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户可通过登录Vuukle上的账户访问他们以前的评论。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 美国驻韩国最高使节周三将首尔与华盛顿之间的双边关系描述为处于“动荡”状态，并强调要努力推动这一联盟向前发展，成为更强大、更平等的伙伴关系。美国大使米歇尔·斯蒂尔的言论是在安全和贸易关系出现明显摩擦之际发表的，这些摩擦涉及落实去年 10 月的峰会协议、分享有关朝鲜的情报以及首尔推动从华盛顿收回战时作战指挥权（OPCON）。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The top U.S. envoy to South Korea on Wednesday described bilateral relations between Seoul and Washington as being in a state of "turbulence," stressing efforts to move the alliance forward into a stronger and more equal partnership. U.S. Ambassador Michelle Steel's remarks come amid apparent friction in the security and trade ties, from implementing their summit agreement from last October and intelligence sharing on North Korea to Seoul's push to retake wartime operational control (OPCON) from Washington. "This is, kind of, like a turbulence that we are going through between the Republic of Korea and the U.S.," she said during a dialogue session hosted by the American Chamber of Commerce in Korea (AMCHAM), referring to South Korea by its official name. "An alliance does not mean it stays always the same. It can be weaker, and we can move forward to be stronger. This is exactly what we are working on," she said. Seoul and Washington have agreed on a series of economic and security commitments, including nuclear energy, shipbuilding cooperation and South Korean investment in the U.S., following their leaders' summit in October last year. However, they have made slow progress in implementing the deals, as issues like Seoul's legal scrutiny over U.S.-listed e-commerce giant Coupang Inc. have emerged as a key sticking point hampering momentum in the broader relationship. Washington has also scaled back intelligence sharing on North Korea with Seoul in a pushback against South Korea's unification minister disclosing a confidential North Korean nuclear facility. The OPCON transfer remains an area where the allies have shown differences over the timing of the transition. "So this working partnership between the U.S. and the Republic of Korea is the most important part," Steel said. Addressing U.S. concerns over South Korea's regulatory policy affecting U.S. companies like Coupang, the ambassador strongly called on Seoul to ensure fair and equal treatment. "American companies in Korea deserve to compete on a level playing field, fairly and without discrimination," she said in her opening remarks. While speaking on the panel, she also noted that the summit agreement, known as the joint fact sheet, states fair treatment for these companies. "They have raided these companies, and they have audited these companies," she said. "Hopefully, it is getting better; I heard it was getting better since we signed the joint fact sheet." Steel also said South Korea is no longer a country that needs U.S. protection, citing its remarkable economic growth since the 1950-53 Korean War, and called on the ally to take a more leading role alongside the U.S. in the Indo-Pacific region. "Now it's time to stand up and lead together with the United States and lead the Indo-Pacific region. South Korea's economy grew so much," she noted. Her remarks appeared to echo the Donald Trump administration's regional strategy, which centers on curbing an increasingly assertive China
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国高级特使称韩美同盟因安全和贸易优先事项分歧出现‘动荡’
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国驻韩国最高使节周三将首尔与华盛顿之间的双边关系描述为处于“动荡”状态，强调要努力推动这一同盟向前发展，成为更强大、更平等的伙伴关系。美国大使米歇尔·斯蒂尔发表上述言论之际，两国在安全和贸易联系上显然存在摩擦，包括落实去年10月峰会协议、共享有关朝鲜的情报，以及首尔推动从华盛顿收回战时作战指挥权（OPCON）。“这有点像我们在大韩民国和美国之间正在经历的动荡，”她在由美国驻韩国商会（AMCHAM）主办的对话会上说，使用韩国的正式国名。“同盟并不意味着它永远保持不变。它可能会变弱，我们也可以向前发展变得更强。这正是我们正在努力实现的目标，”她说。首尔和华盛顿在去年10月领导人峰会后达成了一系列经济和安全承诺，包括核能、造船合作以及韩国在美国投资。然而，它们在落实这些协议方面进展缓慢，因为首尔对在美国上市的电商巨头Coupang Inc.进行法律审查等问题已成为阻碍两国更广泛关系势头的一个关键症结。华盛顿还减少了与首尔共享有关朝鲜的情报，以反击韩国统一部长披露朝鲜一个机密核设施。作战指挥权移交仍是盟国在过渡时机上存在分歧的一个领域。“因此，美国和大韩民国之间的这种工作伙伴关系是最重要的部分，”斯蒂尔说。在谈到美国对韩国影响美国企业（如Coupang）的监管政策的担忧时，大使强烈呼吁首尔确保公平和平等的待遇。“在韩国的美国企业理应在公平的竞争环境中竞争，不受歧视，”她在开场白中说。在小组讨论中，她还指出，峰会协议（即联合事实清单）规定了对这些企业的公平待遇。“他们突击检查了这些公司，还审计了这些公司，”她说。“希望情况正在好转；我听说自从我们签署联合事实清单以来情况正在好转。”斯蒂尔还表示，韩国不再是一个需要美国保护的国家，她提到了自1950-53年朝鲜战争以来韩国取得的显著经济增长，并呼吁这个盟友与美国一道在印太地区发挥更主导的作用。“现在是时候站出来与美国一起领导并引领印太地区了。韩国的经济已经增长了这么多，”她指出。她的言论似乎呼应了唐纳德·特朗普政府的地区战略，该战略的核心是遏制日益强势的中国

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国铁路车辆和电动巴士制造商Woojin Industrial Systems于周五表示，公司入选今年韩国就业和劳动部表彰计划，以表彰创造就业机会和改善工作条件的企业。Woojin表示，在首尔 metropolitan area以外投资推动了其就业增长。Woojin将这一增长归因于与当地大学和职业高中开展的投资与招聘合作。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Woojin Industrial Systems, a Korean manufacturer of railway vehicles and electric buses, said Friday it has been selected for this year’s Ministry of Employment and Labor recognition program honoring companies for creating jobs and improving working conditions. The annual program recognizes 100 private companies and provides administrative and financial incentives to encourage hiring and improve workplace practices. Woojin said investment outside the Seoul metropolitan area helped drive its employment growth. It completed a 47 billion won ($35 million) electric bus factory in Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang Province, supporting efforts to recruit about 100 local workers. The proportion of the company’s workforce covered by employment insurance rose to 673 at the end of 2025 from 578 in 2024. Woojin attributed the growth to investment and recruitment partnerships with local universities and vocational high schools. Of its 140 new hires in 2025, 64 were aged 15 to 34. The company said expanded recruitment of women and support for maternity protection measures helped reduce its female employee turnover rate from 18 percent to 5.3 percent over the past three years. Woojin also said it uses anonymized applications and artificial intelligence analysis based on job descriptions to screen candidates. All 57 recruits evaluated during their probationary periods in 2025 were appointed to regular positions. For older employees, the company rehired all four workers who reached retirement age in 2024 under new contracts following job suitability assessments, without a break in employment. Its wage adjustment system for senior workers links reductions to performance rather than imposing a uniform 30 percent cut. Employees receiving an A rating face no reduction, while those rated B face annual cuts capped at 2 percent, with cumulative reductions limited to 10 percent over five years. Employee benefits include up to 800,000 won annually for professional qualifications, free dormitory accommodation, commuter buses and lunches. Workers can take leave in two- or four-hour increments, and one hour of every two hours spent studying languages counts toward scheduled working time. “This recognition reflects the efforts of all our employees to foster mutual respect and pursue sustainable growth," Woojin Industrial Systems Managing Director Lee Heung-pyo said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Woojin因创造就业机会和改善工作条件而获得认可
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国铁路车辆和电动公交车制造商Woojin Industrial Systems周五表示，该公司入选今年韩国雇佣劳动部表彰计划，以嘉奖创造就业机会和改善工作条件的企业。这项年度计划表彰100家私营企业，并提供行政和财政激励，鼓励企业招聘员工和改善工作场所实践。Woojin表示，在首尔 Metropolitan area 以外投资有助于推动其就业增长。该公司在庆尚北道金泉建成一座投资470亿韩元（3500万美元）的电动公交车工厂，支持招聘约100名当地员工。公司享有雇佣保险的员工比例从2024年的578人上升至2025年底的673人。Woojin将这一增长归因于与当地大学和职业高中开展投资及招聘合作。公司2025年新增的140名员工中，有64人年龄在15至34岁之间。该公司表示，扩大女性招聘并支持 maternity protection 措施，帮助其女性员工流失率在过去三年中从18%降至5.3%。Woojin还表示，公司采用匿名申请和基于职位描述的人工智能分析来筛选候选人。2025年在试用期内接受评估的57名招聘人员全部获聘为正式员工。对于年长员工，公司在2024年对4名达到退休年龄的员工进行岗位适配评估后，以新合同重新聘用他们，期间不中断 employment。公司的资深员工工资调整制度将减薪与绩效挂钩，而不是统一削减30%。获得A级的员工不削减工资，获得B级的员工每年减薪上限为2%，五年累计减薪上限为10%。员工福利包括每年最高800,000韩元的职业资格证书补贴、免费宿舍住宿、通勤巴士和午餐。员工可以按两小时或四小时为单位请假，每学习两小时语言，其中一小时计入规定工作时间。“此次表彰反映了我们全体员工为促进相互尊重和追求可持续增长所作的努力，”Woojin Industrial Systems董事总经理Lee Heung-pyo表示。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 科学部长裴庆勋周五表示，其部门将努力制定措施，解决智能眼镜带来的问题，并承诺加快制定已经在编制的相关指导方针。裴庆勋说：“我们将迅速从跨部门层面制定应对措施。”他指出，李在明总统近日在内阁会议上提到了这一问题。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Science Minister Bae Kyung-hoon said Friday his ministry will make efforts to devise measures to address problems caused by smart glasses, vowing to speed up related guidelines already under preparation. Bae made the remarks during a parliamentary audit held at the National Assembly when a lawmaker asked whether the ministry is planning to deal with concerns over covert filming and privacy violations caused by such devices. "We will swiftly come up with response measures from a pan-ministerial level," Bae said, noting that President Lee Jae Myung pointed out the issue during a recent Cabinet meeting. "We are preparing a guideline but will speed up its progress." Smart glasses are wearable computer frames that integrate digital technology into eyewear, allowing people to film objects with a camera installed on the glasses, or show visual information on the lenses. The technology was brought to the mainstream mostly by Ray-Ban from Meta Platforms Inc. The device has recently face scrutiny in Korea, as a few people have been caught using them to cheat in academic and technical exams or illegally film others. Several countries, including Norway, Australia and the European Union, are already weighing possible restrictions on such devices. Authorities found a total of three cases of illegal filming utilizing smart glasses as of this year, according to data from Rep. Lee Jeong-heon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 科学部长承诺制定跨部门措施监管智能眼镜
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 科学部长裴庆勋周五表示，该部将努力制定措施，应对智能眼镜引发的问题，并承诺加快制定目前正在筹备的相关指南。在韩国国会举行的一场国会议员质询中，有议员询问该部是否计划处理此类设备可能带来的秘密拍摄和侵犯隐私等问题，裴庆勋作出了上述表态。裴庆勋说：“我们将迅速从跨部门层面制定应对措施。”他还指出，李在明总统最近一次内阁会议上提到了这一问题。他说：“我们正在制定一项指南，但将加快进度。”智能眼镜是一种将数字技术融入眼镜的可穿戴计算机框架，人们可以利用安装在眼镜上的摄像头拍摄物体，也可以在镜片上显示视觉信息。这项技术主要由Meta Platforms Inc.旗下的Ray-Ban推向大众市场。近来，这种设备在韩国受到严格审查，因为有人被发现利用智能眼镜在学业考试和技术考试中作弊，或非法拍摄他人。包括挪威、澳大利亚和欧盟在内的多个国家已经考虑对此类设备实施可能的限制。据韩国执政党民主党议员李正勋提供的数据，截至今年，当局共发现3起利用智能眼镜非法拍摄的案件

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 韩国周五在首尔举行首个韩食日正式纪念日庆祝活动。韩食日是韩国新指定的韩国料理国家纪念日。韩国农业、食品和农村事务部与外交部于周五在韩国国立中央博物馆联合主办了庆祝活动，为周六韩食日前一天举行。此次活动旨在传承泡菜和酱类等发酵食品，即韩国以大豆为基础制成的酱汁和酱料，并推广其科学价值。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Korea held its first official ceremony for Hansik Day, a newly designated national commemorative day for Korean cuisine, in Seoul on Friday. At the event, officials outlined plans to turn the country’s food into a global cultural and industrial asset. The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs co-hosted the ceremony at the National Museum of Korea, a day before Hansik Day on Saturday. “Hansik” is the Korean word for Korean food. Marked on Oct. 24, the date combines the number 10, which the government says stands for completion and harmony, with the 24 solar terms. These are the traditional seasonal markers that have long guided farming in Korea. About 300 people attended the ceremony. They included diplomats from 15 countries, food industry officials, academics and certified food masters, who are artisans the government recognizes for preserving traditional food-making techniques. Vice Agriculture Minister Kim Jong-gu presented four policy directions. The first is preserving fermented foods such as kimchi and jang, Korea’s soybean-based sauces and pastes, and promoting their scientific value. The second is using artificial intelligence and food technology to innovate Korean cuisine. The third is promoting culinary tourism that links regional food culture with travel. The fourth is strengthening Korean restaurants overseas and training professionals for them. “We will spare no policy support so that Korean food is loved more in daily lives around the world and its growth leads to a real leap for agriculture and the food and restaurant industries,” Kim said. Lim Sang-woo, the foreign ministry’s ambassador for public diplomacy, called Korean food a diplomatic asset. He said the ministry is expanding K-food diplomacy through more than 170 overseas missions. Six honorees received ministerial citations. Among them were Buddhist temple food master the Venerable Seonjae, chef Lee Jun of the Michelin-starred Seoul restaurant Soigné, Huh Young-man, the cartoonist behind the food comic “Sikgaek,” and the sauce maker Sempio Foods. HANSIK FESTA, a three-day festival, opened alongside the ceremony and runs through Sunday around the museum’s Mirror Pond. It features cooking demonstrations by chefs and food masters, cooking classes, pop-up stores and a flea market. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 韩国纪念首个韩食日，展示韩国料理发展愿景
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 韩国周五在首尔举行首个官方韩食日纪念仪式。韩食日是韩国新设立的韩国料理国家纪念日。仪式上，官员概述了将韩国食品打造为全球文化和产业资产的计划。韩国农业食品 rural事务部和外交部于周六韩食日前一天，在国立韩国博物馆联合主办了仪式。“Hansik”是韩语中对韩国料理的称呼。韩食日为10月24日，这一日期将数字10与二十四节气结合起来；政府表示，10象征圆满与和谐。二十四节气是韩国长期以来指导农耕的传统季节节点。约300人参加了仪式，其中包括来自15个国家的外交官、食品行业官员、学者和认证食品大师；这些大师是政府认可的传承传统食品制作技艺的匠人。韩国农业食品 rural事务部副部长金钟九提出四项政策方向。第一是保护泡菜和酱类等发酵食品；酱类是韩国以大豆制成的酱料和酱膏，同时推广其科学价值。第二是利用人工智能和食品技术推动韩国料理创新。第三是推广将地方饮食文化与旅行相结合的美食旅游。第四是加强海外韩国餐厅实力，并为其培训专业人员。金钟九说：“我们将不遗余力地提供政策支持，让韩国料理在世界各地的日常生活中更受喜爱，使其发展带动农业、食品和餐饮业实现真正飞跃。”外交部公共外交大使林相伍称韩国料理是一种外交资产。他说，外交部正通过170多个驻外机构拓展K-food外交。6名获表彰者获得了部长嘉奖，其中包括佛教寺院料理大师仙哉大师、首尔米其林星级餐厅Soigné主厨李俊、饮食漫画“Sikgaek”作者漫画家许永万，以及酱料制造商Sempio Foods。为期3天的HANSIK FESTA与仪式同步开幕，活动持续至周日，在博物馆倒影池周边举行。活动包括厨师和食品大师现场烹饪示范、烹饪课、快闪店和跳蚤市场。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

You Hong-june stepped down earlier this week after the museum wrongly displayed the calligraphy in an exhibition as the work of a Korean independence activist.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国文化部长周五表示，该部将对前韩国国立中央博物馆馆长进行全面调查。此人因博物馆存在争议地展出其私人收藏中的一幅归属错误书法作品而辞职。柳洪俊本周早些时候辞职，此前博物馆在展览中错误地将这幅书法作品标为韩国独立activist的作品。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The culture minister said Friday his ministry will conduct a thorough audit of the former National Museum of Korea chief who resigned over the museum's controversial display of a misattributed calligraphic work from his private collection. You Hong-june stepped down earlier this week after the museum wrongly displayed the calligraphy in an exhibition as the work of a Korean independence activist. The piece was later identified as the work of a prominent pro-Japanese collaborator during Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule of Korea and turned out to be from You's own private collection. "I think the incident has damaged the reputation and public trust the museum has built over the years," Culture Minister Chae Hwi-young told a lawmaker during a parliamentary audit of the ministry. "The ministry will seek to restore public confidence through a rigorous investigation." The audit will not be limited to the alleged abuse of authority by the former director but will also look into "every procedure involved in the management and authentication of the exhibit at issue," Chae added
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 文化部将审计前博物馆馆长错署书法作品事件
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国文化部长周五表示，该部将对前国立中央博物馆馆长展开全面调查。此人因博物馆有争议地展出其私人收藏中一件归属判断错误的书法作品而辞职。柳贤俊本周早些时候卸任，此前博物馆在一场展览中错误地将这幅书法标为韩国独立运动人士的作品。该作品后来被认定为日本于1910年至1945年殖民统治朝鲜期间一名 prominent 亲日 collaboration者的作品，并被发现来自柳贤俊本人的私人收藏。文化部长车wi-young在对该部进行议会审计时告诉一名议员：“我认为，这起事件损害了博物馆多年来建立的声誉和公众信任。”“该部将通过严格调查努力恢复公众信心。”车wi-young补充说，审计不仅限于调查前馆长涉嫌滥用职权的行为，还将调查“涉及涉案展品管理和鉴定的每一道程序”。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: US colleges scale back cooperation with Chinese institutions after Pentagon's push
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: This decision comes as the Pentagon's push to tighten oversight of US universities' research ties with China has led to more than 80 termination-related actions across 30 American colleges, with some schools scaling back academic partnerships with Chinese institutions. In August, the US Department of Defence ordered 30 universities to audit their foreign research ties, including partnerships with Chinese institutions on its blacklist, or risk losing federal funding.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 这一决定出台之际，五角大楼正推动加强对美国高校与中国研究关系的监管；此举已导致美国30多所高校采取80多项终止合作的相关措施，一些学校还缩减了与中国机构之间的学术伙伴关系。今年8月，美国国防部命令30所高校审查其外国研究关系，包括与列入黑名单的中国机构之间的合作关系，否则可能失去联邦资助。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: Virginia Tech is accelerating the closure of a joint undergraduate program with China's Xidian University, bringing forward the end of a partnership that it had previously planned to keep running until 2029, according to a university spokesperson and a copy of an official letter reviewed by the South China Morning Post. This decision comes as the Pentagon's push to tighten oversight of US universities' research ties with China has led to more than 80 termination-related actions across 30 American colleges, with some schools scaling back academic partnerships with Chinese institutions. Margaret Ashburn, Virginia Tech's associate director of media relations and deputy spokesperson, shared a copy of the school's letter to the Pentagon and told SCMP that the university had recently decided to accelerate the closure of the joint program with Xidian University. "The program noted in the letter will officially terminate after the current academic year," she said. In the letter, the school said it had previously decided in 2025 to wind down the program and stopped admitting new students, but enrolled students could continue until 2029. It remains unclear how the accelerated shutdown will affect students currently enrolled in the program. SCMP has contacted Xidian University for comment but has not received a response. To address security concerns before the complete shutdown, the letter also said Virginia Tech had introduced significant mitigation measures for the program, including research security briefings before and after travel for faculty members visiting Xidian University. Additionally, addressing another flagged relationship, Virginia Tech clarified that recent joint publications with Shandong University - added to the US blacklist in July 2026 - stemmed from earlier work, noting that active collaboration had already been discontinued in 2019. The Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Beijing has consistently opposed the restrictions. Liu Chang, a spokesperson for the Chinese embassy, previously accused the US of overstretching the concept of national security and politicising academic exchanges. Liu said scientific research required openness, that restricting normal exchanges would also harm American researchers and institutions, and urged Washington to abandon its "Cold War mentality" and ensure a fair and open environment. In August, the US Department of Defence ordered 30 universities to audit their foreign research ties, including partnerships with Chinese institutions on its blacklist, or risk losing federal funding. The blacklist, formally known as the Section 1286 list, contains 130 foreign organisations, mostly Chinese but also Russian and Iranian, that Washington deems national security risks. Many leading Chinese civilian universities, including Fudan University, are on the Section 1286 list. The August announcement did not name the universities, but media reports citing a US official said the 30 included some of the country's most prestigious institutions, such as Harvard, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Cornell University. The Pentagon announced on Monday that the 30 universities had completed initial audits of their foreign research ties and addressed relationships flagged as potential security risks. It also named seven universities for their swift actions in compliance with the audit: Oklahoma State University, Pennsylvania State University, the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, the University of South Carolina, the University of Southern California, the University of Texas at Austin and Virginia Tech. The department did not provide further details about the termination-related actions. Emil Michael, undersecretary of defence for research and engineering, said institutions that failed to meet research security standards were on notice and would not receive taxpayer funding if their partnerships endangered US troops or the country's technological edge. "Our work will continue," Michael said. "The department commends the institutions that took decisive action to mitigate relationships that could expose American research to foreign exploitation." There has been pushback elsewhere, too. According to The Washington Post, a Pentagon official asked Southern Illinois University Carbondale this summer to audit its ties with nine Chinese entities. The university initially saw no need to cut ties but later ended an agreement with Shenyang Aerospace University, which had recently been added to the blacklist, at the department's insistence. Drake University in Iowa said in September that the government had raised concerns about its joint degree program with Qingdao University, which Drake said was not on the list. The audits are not the end of the effort. The department said it would continue working with Congress, including the armed services and appropriations committees in both chambers, as well as the House Select Committee on China
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国五角大楼施压后，美国高校缩减与中国机构的合作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh:
据弗吉尼亚理工大学发言人以及《南华早报》查阅的一封官方信函副本，弗吉尼亚理工大学正在加快终止与西安电子科技大学共同开展的本科合作项目，比原计划提前结束这一延续至2029年的合作关系。

随着五角大楼加强监管美国高校对华研究合作，30多所美国高校已采取80多项与终止合作有关的措施，其中一些学校正在缩减与中国机构之间的学术合作。弗吉尼亚理工大学媒体关系副主任兼副发言人Margaret Ashburn向《南华早报》提供了该校致五角大楼的信函副本，并表示学校最近决定加快终止与西安电子科技大学的联合项目。

她说：“信函中提到的项目将在本学年度结束后正式终止。”

信函称，学校曾于2025年决定逐步结束该项目，并停止招收新生，但已入学的学生原本可以继续学习至2029年。目前尚不清楚加速关闭该项目会如何影响目前正在就读的学生。《南华早报》已联系西安电子科技大学置评，但尚未收到回应。

为在项目完全关闭前解决安全疑虑，信函还表示，弗吉尼亚理工大学已为该项目采取多项重要缓解措施，包括在前往西安电子科技大学访问的教职人员出发前及返回后，为他们安排研究安全简介。此外，弗吉尼亚理工大学还就另一项被列为审查对象的合作关系作出说明，称该校近期与山东大学联合发表的论文源于此前开展的工作，实际合作已于2019年停止。山东大学于2026年7月被美国列入黑名单。

中国驻华盛顿大使馆没有立即回应置评请求。北京一贯反对这些限制措施。中国大使馆发言人刘昌此前指责美国过度延伸国家安全的概念，并将学术交流政治化。

刘昌表示，科学研究需要开放，限制正常交流也会损害美国研究人员和机构，并敦促华盛顿放弃“冷战思维”，确保营造公平开放的环境。

今年8月，美国国防部要求30所高校审查其外国研究合作关系，包括与列入黑名单的中国机构之间的合作，否则可能失去联邦资金。这份黑名单正式名称为“第1286条清单”，包含130个被华盛顿视为国家安全风险的外国机构，其中大多数来自中国，也包括俄罗斯和伊朗的机构。

包括复旦大学在内的许多中国顶尖公立大学均被列入“第1286条清单”。8月发布的公告没有点明这些高校，但援引一名美国官员的媒体报道称，30所高校中包括哈佛大学、麻省理工学院和康奈尔大学等该国最负盛名的部分院校。

五角大楼周一宣布，这30所高校已完成对外国研究合作关系的初步审查，并处理了被列为潜在安全风险的合作关系。国防部还表彰了7所迅速采取行动配合审查的高校：俄克拉何马州立大学、宾夕法尼亚州立大学、北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校、南卡罗来纳大学、南加州大学、得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校和弗吉尼亚理工大学。

国防部没有进一步说明这些终止合作的措施。

负责研究与工程的国防部副部长Emil Michael表示，未能达到研究安全标准的机构已收到警告；如果其合作关系危及美军或美国的技术优势，这些机构将无法获得纳税人资金。

Michael说：“我们的工作将继续。国防部表彰那些果断采取行动，缓解可能使美国研究受到外国利用的合作关系的机构。”

其他方面也出现了反对。据《华盛顿邮报》报道，五角大楼一名官员今年夏天要求南伊利诺伊大学卡本代尔分校审查其与9个中国机构的合作关系。该大学最初认为没有必要切断联系，但后来在国防部坚持要求下，终止了与沈阳航空航天大学的协议；该校近期刚被列入黑名单。

爱荷华州德雷克大学9月表示，政府对其与青岛大学的联合学位项目提出了担忧，而德雷克大学称青岛大学并不在该清单上。

这些审查并非这项工作的终点。国防部表示，将继续与国会合作，包括与众议院和参议院两院的军事委员会及拨款委员会，以及众议院中国问题特别委员会合作……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korean shipbuilding giant HD Hyundai Co. said Friday it will establish a joint venture with U.S. engineering and construction company Kiewit to build a new shipyard in the United States. HD Hyundai and Kiewit signed an agreement in Houston on Thursday (local time) to establish the joint venture, tentatively named HD-Kiewit Shipbuilding LLC. The joint venture plans to begin construction of the shipyard next year, with full-scale operations targeted for 2029. Under the partnership, HD Hyundai will provide shipbuilding technology and production expertise, while Kiewit will leverage its engineering and construction capabilities to support the development of the facility. HD Hyundai said the project is significant as it involves building a new shipyard rather than upgrading an existing facility, a move expected to help expand U.S. shipbuilding capacity and strengthen domestic supply chains. The joint venture will explore business opportunities in U.S. Navy logistics support vessels and commercial ships, while also considering the production and supply of ship blocks and modules to U.S. shipyards. The two companies also plan to expand their cooperation into port infrastructure development. HD Hyundai said it expects the joint venture to mark an important milestone in strengthening its position as a strategic partner to the U.S. shipbuilding industry, vowing to contribute to expanding shipbuilding cooperation between the two nations. "Together with HD Hyundai's world-class shipbuilding expertise, we see an opportunity to build a modern shipyard that expands U.S. shipbuilding capacity, develops a skilled workforce and strengthens the domestic supply chain," Chad Johnson, Kiewit Maritime Co. president, said in a release
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: HD现代与Kiewit将在美国成立合资企业建设船厂

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: BEIJING — A magnitude 7 earthquake hit China's Tibet region on Thursday evening, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54 and collapsing hundreds of homes in the northern regional city of Nagqu, official media said. More than 1,600 people from the local county were deployed for rescue efforts. Supplies including 1,000 prefabricated housing units, around 3,000 tents and folding beds, as well as flashlights and winter clothing arrived in the region. China’s official news agency Xinhua said on Friday that communication in part of the region has been down. Local railway authorities have taken emergency actions to halt trains passing through the region. The earthquake also caused rockfalls that have forced local authorities to close a section of National Highway 317, allowing only emergency, rescue and official support vehicles through as crews worked to clear debris, according to Xinhua. Intermittent snows are expected in the earthquake region over the next three days, Xinhua said. It was the biggest earthquake in the region in the last five years, China's national broadcaster CCTV said. The U.S. Geological Survey said the quake occurred at 10:33 p.m. local time, with its epicenter 191 kilometers (119 miles) east-northeast of Nagqu, in a sparsely populated, high-altitude area of northern Tibet. It put the earthquake’s depth at 18 kilometers (11 miles). Nagqu is more than 300 kilometers (186 miles) north of Tibet’s capital, Lhasa

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: Their urgent search for practical applications to justify the investment and hype surrounding humanoids coincides with Korea’s physical AI drive. 6, Rep. Lee Jeong-heon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea brought in robots from China’s Unitree and Agibot to challenge the government over Korea’s competitiveness in physical AI. Deputy Prime Minister and Science and ICT Minister Bae Kyung-hoon urged Korea to ramp up physical AI investment and development, pointing to China’s growing deployment of humanoids.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 各方正急切寻找人形机器人的实际应用，以证明围绕这类机器人进行的投资和宣传有理有据；与此同时，韩国也在推动实体AI发展。6日，韩国执政党民主党议员Lee Jeong-hoon从中国宇树和Agibot进口机器人，就韩国在实体AI领域的竞争力问题向政府施压。副总理兼科学和信息通信部长Bae Kyung-hoon敦促韩国加大实体AI的投资和研发力度，并指出中国正在扩大人形机器人的部署。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Chinese humanoid robot makers are accelerating efforts to gain a foothold in Korea, moving beyond dance performances and showroom displays to factory trials and other commercial applications as Seoul beefs up investment in physical artificial intelligence (AI). A string of Chinese robotics companies have flexed their muscles or announced projects in the country this year, including Hong Kong-listed Ubtech, startup Anyverse Dynamics, Shanghai-based Agibot and leading robot maker Unitree. “China’s new generation of robot companies has global DNA and naturally looks overseas, and Korea is one of the most important markets in Asia-Pacific,” said Ethan Qi, an associate director covering robotics at Counterpoint Research. The absence of locally built humanoids available at scale has created an opening for Chinese suppliers, he added. Representatives of Galaxy Robot Park, a robot-themed entertainment venue in Seoul, agreed to buy Ubtech’s lifelike U1 model after attending its debut in Shenzhen in June, according to Sean Qin, overseas head of the company's commercial robots division. The robot, designed with a female appearance and standing 1.68 meters tall, cost around 170,000 yuan ($25,000) and was delivered to the park last month, Qin said. Ubtech tapped the market as early as 2019 and has since sold more than 10,000 robots to dozens of corporate and government customers, according to him. In July, Ubtech, headquartered in China’s southern tech hub Shenzhen, also announced plans to trial humanoids on a Korean automotive parts production line with local partner Duksan JM Robotics and parts maker AJIN Industrial. Several Ubtech models are undergoing on-site operational tests in the country, Qin said, without specifying. “As a manufacturing powerhouse, Korea already makes extensive use of robotic arms, autonomous mobile robots and other conventional systems,” he said. “The next step is to help workers become more productive in tasks that demand greater flexibility. That makes Korea a key market for Ubtech and for humanoids more broadly.” “Korea is one of our most important overseas markets,” said Zhang Yufeng, founder and CEO of Anyverse Dynamics, who previously worked with SK Telecom and Hyundai Motor. The Beijing-based startup teamed up with coffee chain Hollys at the World Robot Conference in Beijing in August to test robots serving drinks, clearing tables and resetting seats. The robots are undergoing trial operaion at a cafe in Beijing, Zhang said. Korea ranked as China’s third-largest export market by value for “intelligent bionic robots” in the first seven months of this year, trailing the United States and Japan, according to Chinese customs statistics. Exports to Korea totaled 96.45 million yuan out of 949 million yuan shipped globally. China exported 12,368 robots to 95 countries and regions under the customs category, introduced this year, which covers humanoids and robot dogs. Eight of China’s 10 top-selling humanoid robot makers have been testing the waters in Korea through product certification, trademark filings and sales channels, according to a Labsdeep report cited by Electronic Times this month. “We plan to begin trials in Korean cafes and other commercial service settings in the fourth quarter, before expanding into manufacturing,” Zhang said, noting that the company has been working on product certification for the market. Korea’s stringent KC certification prompted Ubtech to adapt its communications modules and radio frequency settings for local use, for example, Qin said. China’s robotics boom has spawned a wave of unicorn firms over the past two years, with some already claiming mass shipment, backed by an extensive supply chain at home. Their urgent search for practical applications to justify the investment and hype surrounding humanoids coincides with Korea’s physical AI drive. Seoul is prioritizing the technology to strengthen manufacturing as its working-age population shrinks and potential economic growth slows. The government has proposed 3.1 trillion won ($2.34 billion) in physical AI funding for 2027, more than triple this year’s figure. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources’ Manufacturing AI Transformation program, dubbed M.AX, supports AI adoption and factory trials of robots, including humanoids, with a target of 500 AI factories by 2030. The ministry budgeted 1.1 trillion won to AI transformation this year. Korea’s industrial heavyweights are also moving fast amid the push. LG Electronics is building its Data Factory in Seoul to train robots for industrial and household applications, while testing robots on its own production lines. Samsung Electronics established its Robotics eXperience division in July, targeting manufacturing before expanding into homes and retail. A bipedal robot designed to operate round-the-clock in manufacturing and logistics will potentially debut at CES 2027, JoongAng Ilbo reported on Tuesday. Hyundai Motor Group has begun training Boston Dynamics’ Atlas humanoids at its Georgia factory campus, ahead of a planned 2028 deployment in manufacturing. Doosan Robotics has unveiled AI-powered sanding and palletizing systems and is developing robot-control software, with support from Nvidia. Korea’s startup ecosystem is also drawing fresh capital. AI and robotics accounted for 45 percent by value of third-quarter investments tracked by The VC, a Korean startup and venture capital investment database platform. Within physical AI, funding is reaching robot makers as well as startups developing foundational models for robots and supplying training data. Korea offers a wealth of potential deployment sites in carmaking, shipbuilding and semiconductors, Counterpoint's Qi said. But gaining access is difficult for Chinese suppliers — they need local customers willing to work with them on proof-of-concept trials. The foreign entrants have stirred political debate. At a parliamentary audit on Oct. 6, Rep. Lee Jeong-heon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea brought in robots from China’s Unitree and Agibot to challenge the government over Korea’s competitiveness in physical AI. Rep. Ahn Cheol-soo of the main opposition People Power Party questioned their security checks and accused the National Assembly of providing a stage for Chinese technology. Deputy Prime Minister and Science and ICT Minister Bae Kyung-hoon urged Korea to ramp up physical AI investment and development, pointing to China’s growing deployment of humanoids. “China is also deploying more humanoid robots in the field and collecting data,” he said during a Physical AI Tech Week roundtable at Seoul’s Coex on Oct. 13, quoted by MoneyToday. Bae questioned whether Korea’s plans were bold enough and called for higher targets to avoid regretting insufficient investment in the years ahead. Companies also needed to shoulder more, as the government could not support everything, he said. Park Young-hoon, head of the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency’s Shenzhen office, also sees opportunities for cooperation. “Companies need to explore new business opportunities using Shenzhen’s local supply chains and innovation capabilities while competing with Chinese technology companies,” he told local media outlet Newspim in October. Zhang sees the two countries’ industrial strengths as “highly complementary.” Korea combines global leadership in advanced manufacturing with a capacity for AI innovation, while China offers a comprehensive supply chain, a deep pool of engineering, AI talents and rapid product iteration, he said. For Qin, policies favoring domestic companies has not deterred Korean customers from considering Chinese suppliers. “The Korean customers we have dealt with are open to working with Chinese robot makers,” he said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国押注实体人工智能之际，中国人形机器人开始求职
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 中国人形机器人制造商正加快 efforts 在韩国抢占市场足迹，活动已从舞蹈表演和展厅展示延伸至工厂试用及其他商业应用，与首尔加大具身人工智能投资力度同步推进。今年以来，一批中国机器人企业已在该国展示实力或宣布项目，包括在香港上市的Ubtech、初创公司Anyverse Dynamics、总部位于上海的Agibot以及领先机器人制造商Unitree。Counterpoint Research负责机器人业务的副总监Ethan Qi表示：“中国新一代机器人企业具有全球基因，天然会关注海外市场，而韩国是亚太地区最重要的市场之一。”他补充说，韩国目前缺乏可规模化供应的本土制造人形机器人，这为中国供应商创造了机会。据Ubtech商用机器人事业部海外负责人Sean Qin介绍，首尔机器人主题娱乐场所Galaxy Robot Park的代表在6月赴深圳参加U1首发活动后，同意购买这款仿真人形机器人。Qin称，这款机器人采用女性外观设计，身高1.68米，价格约为170,000元（$25,000），已于上月交付该园区。据他介绍，Ubtech早在2019年便开始开拓韩国市场，此后已向数十家企业和政府客户销售超过10,000台机器人。7月，总部位于中国科技重镇深圳的Ubtech还宣布，计划与当地合作伙伴Duksan JM Robotics及零部件制造商AJIN Industrial合作，在韩国汽车零部件生产线上试用人形机器人。Qin表示，Ubtech的多款模型正在韩国进行现场运行测试，但他未披露具体型号。他说：“韩国作为制造业强国，已经广泛使用机械臂、自主移动机器人和其他常规系统。下一步是帮助 workers 在需要更高灵活性的任务中提高生产力。因此，韩国是Ubtech以及更广泛的人形机器人行业的关键市场。”Anyverse Dynamics创始人兼首席执行官Zhang Yufeng表示：“韩国是我们最重要的海外市场之一。”他此前曾任职于SK Telecom和Hyundai Motor。这家北京初创公司今年8月在北京世界机器人大会上与咖啡连锁品牌Hollys合作，测试机器人提供饮品、清理餐桌和复位座椅。Zhang表示，这些机器人正在北京的一家咖啡馆进行试运行。根据中国海关统计数据，今年前7个月，按出口额计算，韩国是中国“智能仿生机器人”的第三大出口市场，仅次于美国和日本。在全球949,000,000元的相关出口中，对韩国出口总额为96,450,000元。中国依据今年新设、涵盖人形机器人和机器狗的海关类别，向95个国家和地区出口了12,368台机器人。据Electronic Times本月援引Labsdeep的一份报告，中国十大畅销人形机器人制造商中已有八家通过产品认证、商标申请和销售渠道等方式在韩国试水。Zhang表示：“我们计划第四季度开始先在韩国咖啡馆和其他商业服务场景进行试用，之后再扩展至制造业。”他指出，该公司一直在为韩国市场推进产品认证。Qin表示，例如，韩国严格的KC认证促使Ubtech调整通信模块和射频设置，以满足本地使用要求。过去两年，中国机器人产业的热潮催生了一批独角兽企业，其中一些企业依托国内完善的供应链，已经宣称实现大规模出货。它们迫切寻找实际应用，以证明围绕人形机器人的投资和市场热度具有合理性，而这与韩国推动具身人工智能发展的举措不谋而合。随着劳动年龄人口减少和潜在经济增长放缓，首尔正优先发展这项技术，以强化制造业。韩国政府提议2027年为具身人工智能提供3.1万亿韩元（$2.34 billion）资金，超过今年水平的两倍。韩国产业通商资源部推出的“制造业人工智能转型”计划（简称M.AX）支持企业采用人工智能并在工厂试用包括人形机器人在内的机器人，目标是到2030年建成500家人工智能工厂。该部今年为人工智能转型拨付了1.1万亿韩元。在这一推动下，韩国工业巨头也在迅速行动。LG Electronics正在首尔建设Data Factory，用于训练面向工业和家庭应用的机器人，同时在自有生产线上测试机器人。Samsung Electronics于7月成立Robotics eXperience部门，率先瞄准制造业，随后拓展至家庭和零售场景。《中央日报》周二报道，一款用于制造业和物流领域、全天候运行的双足机器人可能于CES 2027首次亮相。Hyundai Motor Group已在其位于佐治亚州的工厂园区开始训练Boston Dynamics的Atlas人形机器人，为计划于2028年投入制造业应用做准备。Doosan Robotics已发布人工智能驱动的打磨和码垛系统，并在Nvidia支持下开发机器人控制软件。韩国初创企业生态系统也在吸引新资金。韩国初创企业和风险投资投资数据库平台The VC的数据显示，第三季度追踪到的投资中，人工智能和机器人领域按投资额占比达45%。在具身人工智能领域，资金正流向机器人制造商、研发机器人基础模型的初创企业以及提供训练数据的公司。Counterpoint的Qi表示，韩国在汽车制造、造船和半导体领域拥有大量潜在部署场所。但中国供应商难以进入这些领域，因为它们需要愿意与其合作开展概念验证试用的本地客户。这些外国进入者引发了政治争论。10月6日举行的一次国会审计会议上，执政党韩国民主党议员Lee Jeong-heon带来中国Unitree和Agibot的机器人，就韩国在具身人工智能领域的竞争力向政府提出质询。主要反对党国民力量党议员Ahn Cheol-soo质疑这些机器人的安全检查，并指责国会为中国技术提供展示平台。副总理兼科学技术信息通信部长Bae Kyung-hoon以中国日益增加的人形机器人部署为例，敦促韩国加大具身人工智能投资和开发力度。MoneyToday援引他在10月13日于首尔Coex举行的Physical AI Tech Week圆桌会议上的话说：“中国也在现场部署更多人形机器人并收集数据。”Bae质疑韩国的规划是否足够大胆，并呼吁提高目标，以免在未来多年因投资不足而后悔。他说，政府无法支持所有事项，企业也需要承担更多责任。韩国贸易投资促进机构深圳办事处负责人Park Young-hoon也看到了合作机会。10月，他告诉当地媒体Newspim：“企业需要利用深圳本地供应链和创新能力探索新的商业机会，同时也要与中国科技企业竞争。”Zhang认为，两国的产业优势“高度互补”。他说，韩国兼具先进制造业的全球领导地位和人工智能创新能力，而中国则拥有完整的供应链、大量工程和人工智能人才，以及快速迭代产品的能力。Qin表示，偏向本土企业的政策并未阻止韩国客户考虑中国供应商。他说：“我们接触过的韩国客户愿意与中国机器人制造商合作。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 纽约——人工智能行业相关股票下跌，周四拖累全球市场；由于市场担忧与伊朗的战争，油价升至5月以来的最高水平。标普500指数下跌1.4%，可能录得7月以来的最差单日表现；纳斯达克综合指数重挫2.8%。这家芯片巨头按总市值计算是华尔街市值最大的股票，因此成为拖累标普500指数的最重磅成分股。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: NEW YORK — Drops for stocks in the artificial-intelligence industry are dragging markets down worldwide on Thursday, while oil prices hit their highest levels since May on worries about the war with Iran. The S&P 500 fell 1.4 percent toward its worst day since July, while the Nasdaq composite tumbled 2.8 percent. The weakness for tech stocks was so overwhelming that it masked strength for the rest of the market, where the majority of U.S. stocks actually rose. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down only a modest 0.2 percent, or 113 points, as of 2:30 p.m. Eastern time. AI-related stocks have become shaky on worries that their boom may be under threat because of how expensive it’s become to borrow money to build data centers and buy more AI chips. Concerns also remain that their prices shot too high following a yearslong frenzy, even though companies in the industry continue to report growth. Lam Research, whose equipment and services help make semiconductors, reported gains in profit and revenue for the summer that were slightly stronger than analysts expected, for example. Usually, that helps boost a stock’s price, but Lam Research’s tumbled 11.6 percent. It gave a range for its forecast for profit this quarter whose midpoint was slightly below analysts’ expectations. Its stock also came into the day with a 52.4 percent surge for the year so far, nearly quadruple the gain for the overall S&P 500, leaving plenty of room for potential disappointment. Other big tech stocks likewise fell following their own quarterly reports that included at least some encouraging nuggets. Meta Platforms, which is pushing its Muse AI agent, lost 7.9 percent after reporting stronger revenue for the latest quarter than analysts expected, though its profit fell short. The company behind Facebook and Instagram also said it’s creating a new class of stock to raise money to pay for AI investments and other expenses. Tesla fell 2.6 percent after reporting a stronger profit for the summer than analysts expected, though its revenue was weaker than forecast. The global tide against AI stocks knocked Nvidia down 4.3 percent. Because it’s the largest stock on Wall Street by total value, the chip giant was the heaviest weight on the S&P 500. CoreWeave, which has borrowed money to buy Nvidia’s AI chips that it rents out to customers over the cloud, has been particularly shaky in recent weeks because of worries about its debt. It dropped 11 percent. The weakness for AI and other tech stocks began in Asia, where indexes are full of AI industry players. South Korea’s Kospi tumbled 3.5 percent, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng dropped 3 percent and Japan’s Nikkei 225 sank 2.7 percent. Also weighing on global stock markets was a jump in oil prices. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil rose 3.7 percent to $112.80 after touching its highest level in five months. It’s shot up from less than $97 at the start of the month on uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow the global energy industry to return to normal. In Europe, France’s CAC 40 stock index fell to one of the continent’s sharpest losses with a drop of 1.4 percent. It has fewer tech stocks than Asian or U.S. indexes, but it was hurt by another jump in yields for French government bonds. Yields have been generally climbing there because of worries about the government’s big debt load and strained budget. Violent protests across France have raised pressure on the government to increase spending, which could add further to its debt. Worries about big government debt are weighing on almost every developed economy in the world, including the United States. Such concerns have pushed yields in the U.S. bond market to their highest levels in decades, along with high inflation, signals of a still-strong U.S. economy and other factors. But U.S. yields nevertheless fell sharply Thursday in a signal that investors were buying U.S. government bonds in search of something safer to own as AI stocks tumbled. The yield on the 10-year Treasury tumbled to 4.96 percent from 5.13 percent late Wednesday and from more than 5.30 percent earlier this month. That’s a major move for the bond market. That solid economy has helped U.S. companies broadly to make bigger profits, which is what propelled the U.S. stock market to a record high earlier this month despite the many worries tugging at it. Nearly two out of every three stocks within the S&P 500 rose Thursday, only to get drowned out by the drops for more influential tech stocks. Procter & Gamble, Lockheed Martin and CSX were among the latest companies to join the list of those topping profit expectations for the summer, and gains for their stocks helped limit the market’s losses on Thursday. CEO Shailesh Jejurikar said Procter & Gamble expects “geopolitical and economic challenges” to continue, but it stood by its forecasts for growth in revenue, profit and other measures for the full year. The stock price for the company behind the Crest, Olay and Oral-B brands rose 6 percent
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 全球人工智能股票下跌，华尔街迈向7月以来最糟糕的一天
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 纽约消息——人工智能行业股票下挫，周四拖累全球市场；与此同时，由于市场担忧与伊朗的战争，油价升至5月以来最高水平。标普500指数下跌1.4%，可能录得7月以来的最差单日表现；纳斯达克综合指数重挫2.8%。科技股走势如此疲弱，以至于掩盖了其他市场的上涨，美国多数股票实际上均有上涨。截至美东时间下午2时30分，道琼斯工业平均指数仅小幅下跌0.2%，跌幅为113点。人工智能相关股票一直震荡不稳，因为借贷资金建设数据中心、购买更多人工智能芯片的成本过高，人们担心人工智能热潮可能受到威胁。经过多年的狂热炒作，这些股票的价格已经升得过高，而行业公司仍在持续报告增长，这也令投资者担忧。例如，生产半导体所需设备并提供相关服务的Lam Research报告称，夏季利润和收入增幅略强于分析师预期。通常，这会提振股价，但Lam Research股价暴跌11.6%。该公司给出的本季度利润预测区间中点略低于分析师预期。该股周四开盘前年内已累计上涨52.4%，涨幅接近标普500指数整体涨幅的4倍，因此存在很大的潜在失望空间。其他大型科技股在各自季度报告发布后也纷纷下跌，尽管报告中至少包含了一些令人鼓舞的信息。正在推广其Muse人工智能代理的Meta Platforms报告称，最新季度收入高于分析师预期，但利润不及预期，股价下跌7.9%。这家Facebook和Instagram背后的公司还表示，将发行一类新股票，为人工智能投资和其他开支筹资。特斯拉报告称，夏季利润高于分析师预期，但收入低于预测，股价下跌2.6%。全球人工智能股票遭遇抛售，Nvidia下跌4.3%。这家芯片巨头按总市值计算是华尔街最大的上市公司，成为拖累标普500指数的最沉重成分。CoreWeave借款购买Nvidia的人工智能芯片，并通过云服务出租给客户；由于市场担忧其债务，该股近几周尤其动荡，股价下跌11%。人工智能及其他科技股的疲弱走势始于亚洲，那里的指数中有大量人工智能行业公司。韩国综合指数重挫3.5%，香港恒生指数下跌3%，日本日经225指数下跌2.7%。油价上涨也压累了全球股市。布伦特原油每桶价格上涨3.7%至$112.80，此前曾触及5个月以来的最高水平。本月初油价还不到$97，但由于人们不确定与伊朗的战争何时才能让全球能源行业恢复正常，油价自此大幅上涨。在欧洲，法国CAC 40股票指数下跌1.4%，跌幅居欧洲主要指数前列。该指数中的科技股数量少于亚洲或美国指数，但法国政府债券收益率再次上升，也令指数受损。法国政府债务负担沉重、预算承压，收益率总体持续攀升。法国各地爆发激烈抗议，加大了政府增加支出的压力，这可能进一步推高债务。政府债务过高的担忧几乎拖累全球所有发达经济体，包括美国。通胀高企、美国经济依然强劲的信号以及其他因素，推动美国债券市场收益率升至数十年来最高水平。不过，周四随着人工智能股票重挫，投资者买入美国政府债券以寻找更安全的资产，美国国债收益率仍大幅下降。10年期美国国债收益率从周三晚间的5.13%跌至4.96%，而本月初一度超过5.30%。这对债券市场而言是一次重大波动。美国经济强劲，已帮助各行业企业普遍扩大利润；尽管面临许多令市场不安的因素，美国股市仍在本月初创下历史新高。标普500指数成分股中，周四近三分之二的股票上涨，但这些涨幅被影响力更大的科技股下跌所淹没。宝洁、洛克希德·马丁和CSX成为最新一批夏季利润超过预期的公司之一，其股价上涨帮助限制了周四的市场跌幅。首席执行官Shailesh Jejurikar表示，宝洁预计“地缘政治和经济挑战”仍将持续，但公司维持了对全年收入、利润及其他指标增长的预测。这个拥有Crest、Olay和Oral-B等品牌的公司股价上涨6%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel on Thursday highlighted the potential for greater shipbuilding cooperation between Seoul and Washington following a visit to a shipyard operated by Samsung Heavy Industries Co. "By combining American and Korean expertise, we can strengthen our shipbuilding industries, drive innovation and create new opportunities for workers in both countries," she wrote in a post on social media platform X after visiting the Geoje shipyard, about 330 kilometers south of Seoul. She thanked Samsung Heavy Industries, the world's fifth-largest shipbuilder in terms of its existing orders, for welcoming her and for sharing the company's vision for shipbuilding cooperation. The remarks come amid South Korea's broader efforts to revive the U.S. shipbuilding industry under the MASGA, or "Make American Shipbuilding Great Again," initiative. Earlier this year, Samsung Heavy Industries established a research center in San Diego to support the South Korea-U.S. initiative. The SHI-SDSU Advanced Maritime Center, jointly launched with San Diego State University, was established to explore cooperation to support the revitalization of the U.S. shipbuilding industry in areas such as artificial intelligence (AI)-based production automation, robotics and eco-friendly technologies, according to the company

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: Wall Street sinks as Nasdaq falls over 2% on AI cost worries
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: The tech-heavy Nasdaq slid more than 2 percent on Thursday as growth stocks weakened after earnings from mega-caps Tesla and Meta did little to address AI-related concerns, with a recovery in oil prices further adding to market unease. The selloff put the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor Index on track to shed more than $616 billion in market value, while the Nasdaq-100 was set to erase nearly $1 trillion.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 科技股占比极高的纳斯达克指数周四下跌逾2%。在特斯拉和 Meta 这两家巨型企业的财报未能有效缓解与人工智能相关的担忧之际，成长股走弱，油价回升又进一步加剧了市场的不安。此次抛售使费城半导体指数市值预计减少逾6160亿美元，而纳斯达克100指数市值则 Nearly 蒸发了近1万亿美元。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: The tech-heavy Nasdaq slid more than 2 percent on Thursday as growth stocks weakened after earnings from mega-caps Tesla and Meta did little to address AI-related concerns, with a recovery in oil prices further adding to market unease. Meta slipped 5.2 percent after the social media giant unveiled a new class of non-voting shares to help fund its costly AI expansion. The decline came despite stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue and an upbeat fourth-quarter sales forecast. The market weakness marked a sharp reversal from Wednesday, when robust results from SpaceX and Super Micro sparked an AI-fueled rally. The optimism faded as investors shifted their focus from earnings strength to the enormous capital required to build AI infrastructure and their uncertain return timeline. The selloff put the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor Index on track to shed more than $616 billion in market value, while the Nasdaq-100 was set to erase nearly $1 trillion. The semiconductor index fell 5.6 percent to its lowest since July 29. "Semiconductors and the Nasdaq have been elevated to a huge degree by investors' rush to participate in the AI build-out. Investors are now reassessing the pace of AI spending and the returns that spending can generate," said Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers. Tesla fell 0.7 percent after the electric-vehicle maker cut annual capital expenditure forecast, raising questions about the pace of its AI and robotics ambitions. Other constituents of the 'Magnificent 7' group also declined, with Amazon.com and Nvidia down more than 3 percent each. At 11:58 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 29.18 points, or 0.06 percent, to 52,826.91. The S&P 500 lost 85.27 points, or 1.10 percent, to 7,671.90, while the Nasdaq Composite slipped 551.50 points, or 2.06 percent, to 26,152.90. Six of the 11 S&P 500 sectors posted losses, led by technology, down more than 2.7 percent. Consumer staples were leading the gains with a 2.5 percent rise. Procter & Gamble jumped 6.1 percent to a near eight-month high after the consumer goods giant beat first-quarter estimates. The S&P 500 value index was flat compared to a 2.2 percent drop in its growth counterpart. Brent crude was hovering near its five-month high, after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked fears of supply disruptions and a wider Middle East conflict. A flight to safety pushed the 10-year yield down to around 5.0025 percent. Meanwhile, weekly jobless claims unexpectedly fell, pointing to a resilient labor market and supporting expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged at its meeting next week. On the earnings front, S&P 500 third-quarter profit growth is forecast at 32.3 percent, up from 30.7 percent previously, according to LSEG data. Blackstone gained nearly 6 percent after the alternative asset manager beat third-quarter profit expectations, while Chief Operating Officer Jon Gray said widening credit spreads on AI-linked debt could create opportunities to secure higher returns. Lockheed Martin climbed 5.9 percent after the defense contractor raised annual sales and profit forecast. Spotify rose 9 percent after the Swedish music streaming firm forecast fourth-quarter profit above Wall Street estimates, betting on its AI-powered features to drive user growth. Declining issues outnumbered advancers by a 1.06-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by 1.23-to-1 on the Nasdaq. The S&P 500 posted 35 new 52-week highs and three new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 70 new highs and 247 new lows
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 人工智能成本担忧令纳斯达克指数下跌逾2%，华尔街股市下挫
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 科技股占比较重的纳斯达克指数周四下跌逾2%。在大型科技公司Tesla和Meta公布财报后，与人工智能有关的担忧持续压制成长股，油价回升进一步加剧了市场不安。Meta公布一类新的无投票权股票，以帮助为其代价高昂的人工智能扩张提供资金，该股下跌5.2%。尽管其季度营收强于预期，且第四季度销售前景乐观，股价仍然下滑。市场走弱与周三形成鲜明反差；当时SpaceX和Super Micro公布的强劲业绩引发了一轮由人工智能推动的涨势。随着投资者将目光从强劲的业绩转向建设人工智能基础设施所需的大量资本以及回报时间表的不确定性，乐观情绪逐渐消退。这轮抛售使Philadelphia SE半导体指数市值可能减少逾6160亿美元，Nasdaq-100指数则可能抹去近1万亿美元市值。半导体指数下跌5.6%，触及7月29日以来的最低水平。Interactive Brokers首席市场分析师Steve Sosnick表示：“投资者争相参与人工智能建设，已在很大程度上推高了半导体股和纳斯达克指数。投资者目前正在重新评估人工智能支出的规模及其能够产生的回报。”Tesla下调年度资本支出预测，引发市场对其人工智能和机器人业务推进速度的质疑，该股下跌0.7%。“ Magnificent 7”集团的其他成分股也出现下跌，其中Amazon.com和Nvidia均跌逾3%。美国东部时间上午11时58分，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌29.18点，跌幅0.06%，报52,826.91点。标普500指数下跌85.27点，跌幅1.10%，报7,671.90点；纳斯达克综合指数下跌551.50点，跌幅2.06%，报26,152.90点。标普500指数11个行业中有6个下跌，其中科技板块领跌，跌幅超过2.7%。必需消费品板块以2.5%的涨幅领涨。Procter & Gamble第一季度业绩超过预期，这家消费品巨头股价上涨6.1%，触及近8个月高位。标普500价值指数与此前持平，其成长股对应指数则下跌2.2%。由于胡塞武装在沙特阿拉伯发动更多袭击，引发人们对供应中断和更广泛中东冲突的担忧，Brent原油价格徘徊在5个月高位附近。避险情绪推动美国10年期国债收益率降至约5.0025%。与此同时，每周初请失业金人数意外下降，显示劳动力市场具有韧性，并支持市场预计美联储将在下周会议上维持利率不变。财报方面，LSEG数据显示，标普500指数第三季度利润增幅预计为32.3%，高于此前预计的30.7%。另类资产管理公司Blackstone第三季度利润超过预期，股价上涨近6%；其首席运营官Jon Gray表示，与人工智能相关的债券信用利差扩大，可能为获取更高回报创造机会。国防承包商Lockheed Martin上调年度销售和利润预测，股价上涨5.9%。瑞典音乐流媒体公司Spotify预计第四季度利润高于华尔街预期，并押注其人工智能驱动功能将促进用户增长，股价上涨9%。在NYSE，下跌股票与上涨股票之比为1.06比1；在Nasdaq则为1.23比1。标普500指数录得35个新的52周高点和3个新低点，纳斯达克综合指数则录得70个新高和247个新低点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck China's southwestern region of Tibet at around 10:33 p.m. (1433 GMT) on Thursday, the China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC) said. The epicentre was in a high-altitude county in Nagqu, northern Tibet, at a depth of 10 km (6.21 miles), and the average elevation within 5 km of the epicentre is about 4,864 metres, CENC data showed. The quake, the strongest to hit China since January 2024, was clearly felt in the local area, CENC said.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 中国地震台网（CENC）表示，周四晚上10时33分（GMT时间14时33分）左右，中国西南部西藏地区发生7级地震。震源位于西藏北部那曲一个高海拔县，震源深度为10公里（6.21英里）。中国地震台网（CENC）的数据显示，震源周边5公里范围内的平均海拔约为4,864米。中国地震台网称，这是中国自2024年1月以来遭遇的最强地震，震源附近地区有明显震感。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck China's southwestern region of Tibet at around 10:33 p.m. (1433 GMT) on Thursday, the China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC) said. It was not immediately known if there were any casualties or damage. The epicentre was in a high-altitude county in Nagqu, northern Tibet, at a depth of 10 km (6.21 miles), and the average elevation within 5 km of the epicentre is about 4,864 metres, CENC data showed. The quake, the strongest to hit China since January 2024, was clearly felt in the local area, CENC said. The epicentre was around 400 km from the Tibetan capital of Lhasa. In 2010, a magnitude 7.1 tremor struck Yushu, around 280 km away in neighbouring Qinghai province, killing at least 2,698 people and leaving nearly 300 people missing

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Hyundai Engineering & Construction (E&C) and three other local builders are at risk of losing more than 1 trillion won ($755 million) tied up in a major Iraqi refinery project, according to documents obtained by a ruling party lawmaker Friday. The builders have been seeking payment for work on the $6.8 billion Karbala Refinery Project, commissioned by Iraq's state-owned State Company for Oil Projects (SCOP).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 据 ruling party 议员周五获得的文件显示，现代工程与建设公司（E&C）以及另外三家本土建筑企业可能因伊拉克一座大型炼油厂项目而损失超过1万亿韩元（7.55亿美元）的相关款项。这些建筑企业一直在寻求获得伊拉克国有石油项目公司（SCOP）委托实施的68亿美元卡尔巴拉炼油厂项目的工程款。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hyundai Engineering & Construction (E&C) and three other local builders are at risk of losing more than 1 trillion won ($755 million) tied up in a major Iraqi refinery project, according to documents obtained by a ruling party lawmaker Friday. Hyundai E&C, GS Engineering & Construction, SK ecoplant and Hyundai Engineering have yet to collect 625.4 billion won in outstanding payments and are facing the possible forfeiture of another 420.2 billion won in performance guarantees. The builders have been seeking payment for work on the $6.8 billion Karbala Refinery Project, commissioned by Iraq's state-owned State Company for Oil Projects (SCOP). Company materials provided to Rep. Lee Jae-gang of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea showed the construction of a refinery capable of processing 140,000 barrels of crude oil per day was delayed by factors including Iraq’s internal conflict and the COVID-19 pandemic. The companies handed over the refinery's facilities to the Iraqi side in December 2023. However, SCOP has withheld payments, citing outstanding defects and missing tax-related documentation. The unpaid amount includes 209.3 billion won withheld for alleged defects and related issues, 277.7 billion won in tax-related payments and 138.4 billion won for refinery operations and maintenance. The Iraqi firm had agreed in April last year to pay about 33.5 billion won of the outstanding operations and maintenance fees, but the payment has yet to be made. The Korean companies are also facing the possible forfeiture of 420.2 billion won in performance guarantees submitted to ensure they fulfilled their contractual obligations, pushing up the total sum to 1.04 trillion won. The two sides began negotiations in May to settle the outstanding payments, but the talks were effectively reset following a change in Iraq's oil minister and the arrest of a deputy minister. In September, the Iraqi side rejected settlement terms proposed by the South Korean companies. The builders are preparing plans to address the reported defects, but progress has been hampered by limited cooperation from Iraqi authorities on site access permits, visas for essential personnel and the scheduling of refinery shutdowns needed to carry out repairs. Of the 162 reported defects, 120 cannot be addressed until the refinery is shut down or the causes of the problems have been determined. The Iraqi government has recently suggested that the companies accept crude oil instead of cash as payment for the outstanding amounts. In the past, some Korean builders had recovered part of their payments through a subsidiary in the oil sector that took delivery of and sold crude. However, companies without facilities to store or sell crude oil would find it difficult to use the same arrangement. The lawmaker called on the Korean government to intervene in the dispute. “The Iraqi side changes its position whenever ministries or officials change, while our companies are left fighting on their own. It is time for the government to get involved to help them.” Lee said. “I will urge the relevant government agencies to establish a coordinated, interagency support mechanism for recovering the unpaid payments during the National Assembly audit of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 韩国建筑商面临失去7.55亿美元伊拉克炼油厂项目未付款的风险
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 据执政党议员周五获得的文件，现代工程与建设（E&C）等另外三家韩国本土建筑商在伊拉克一座大型炼油厂项目中面临损失逾1万亿韩元（7.55亿美元）的风险，这些资金目前被拖欠。现代工程与建设、GS工程与建设、SK ecoplant和现代工程尚未收回6254亿韩元的未付款项，并可能再被没收4202亿韩元的履约保证金。这些建筑商一直在追讨价值68亿美元的卡尔巴拉炼油厂项目工程款，该项目由伊拉克国有国家石油项目公司（SCOP）委托建设。向韩国执政党议员李在岗提供的公司文件显示，这座日均能够处理14万桶原油的炼油厂因伊拉克内部冲突和新冠疫情等因素而延误建设。上述公司于2023年12月将该炼油厂的设施移交伊方，但SCOP以仍存在缺陷以及缺少税务相关文件为由扣留了款项。未付款项包括：因涉嫌存在缺陷及相关问题而被扣留的2093亿韩元、2777亿韩元税务相关款项，以及1384亿韩元炼油厂运营和维护款项。伊拉克公司去年4月同意支付约335亿韩元的未付运营维护费，但至今尚未付款。韩国公司还可能失去为确保履行合同义务而提交的4202亿韩元履约保证金，使损失总额升至1.04万亿韩元。双方于5月开始谈判解决拖欠款项问题，但伊拉克石油部长更换以及一名副部长被捕后，谈判实际上被重新搁置。今年9月，伊方拒绝了韩国公司提出的和解条款。各建筑商正着手制定处理所报告缺陷的方案，但伊拉克当局在现场准入许可、必要人员签证以及炼油厂停工检修安排方面提供的有限合作阻碍了进展。在所报告的162项缺陷中，有120项必须等炼油厂停机或查明问题原因后才能处理。伊拉克政府最近建议这些公司接受原油而非现金来支付拖欠款项。过去，一些韩国建筑商曾通过一家石油行业子公司收回部分工程款，该子公司负责接收并出售原油。然而，不具备原油储存或销售设施的公司很难采用同样方式解决拖欠问题。该议员呼吁韩国政府介入这起争端。李在岗说：“每当各部委或官员发生变化时，伊拉克方面就会改变立场，而我们韩国的公司只能独自应战。现在政府应介入并提供帮助。我将在周一对外交部进行国会审计时，敦促相关政府部门建立跨部门协调支持机制，以追回拖欠款项。”

https://leadership.ng/jpmorgan-gets-cbn-.summary: Akuka said JPMorgan Merchant Bank Nigeria Limited would still be required to incorporate with the Corporate Affairs Commission and complete the necessary operational and regulatory arrangements before receiving authorisation to commence business. Recall that JPMorgan Chase & Co. had deposited N50 billion, equivalent to about $38 million, with the Central Bank of Nigeria as part of its bid to secure a merchant banking licence.
https://leadership.ng/jpmorgan-gets-cbn-.summary_zh: Akuka表示，JPMorgan Merchant Bank Nigeria Limited仍须在公司事务委员会完成注册，并办妥必要的运营和监管安排，之后才能获准开始营业。此前，为申请商人银行牌照，JPMorgan Chase & Co.已向尼日利亚中央银行存入500亿奈拉，相当于约3,800万美元。
https://leadership.ng/jpmorgan-gets-cbn-.body: The approval is the first stage of the licensing process and does not amount to a final banking licence. The proposed bank can begin operations only after it meets all regulatory conditions and the CBN issues a final licence. CBN’s Director of Corporate Communications and Investor Relations, Michael Akuka, said the decision reflected the apex bank’s efforts to strengthen financial stability, improve market confidence and deepen Nigeria’s links with global capital markets. He explained that the approval followed the completion of the banking sector recapitalisation exercise, which he said had strengthened the resilience and capacity of Nigerian banks. Akuka said JPMorgan Merchant Bank Nigeria Limited would still be required to incorporate with the Corporate Affairs Commission and complete the necessary operational and regulatory arrangements before receiving authorisation to commence business. CBN Governor Olayemi Cardoso said the central bank’s objective was to build a financial system that was stable, competitive and internationally connected. “Our objective is to build a financial system that is stable, competitive and internationally connected, one that commands confidence and can effectively support investment and economic growth,” he said. “We are encouraged by the growing interest of international financial institutions in Nigeria. Our focus remains on sustaining the reforms, strengthening the credibility of our markets and creating an environment in which both domestic and international institutions can participate and thrive,” Cardoso added. The development is expected to boost competition in Nigeria’s corporate banking, investment banking and capital markets segments. It also signals renewed international interest in the country’s financial sector following ongoing reforms under the Cardoso-led CBN. The CBN approved the nomination of Adedapo Adedayo Olagunju as Managing Director of the proposed bank. It also approved Latter Kevin George, Nzelu Chinedum Izunwanne and Syed Gabriel Murtaza as Non-Executive Directors, while Alade Sarah Omotunde, Ajayi Olukonyinsola and Adetu Seni were approved as Independent Non-Executive Directors. The central bank reaffirmed its commitment to maintaining a sound, competitive and internationally connected financial system that supports sustainable growth and expands Nigeria’s participation in global financial markets. Recall that JPMorgan Chase & Co. had deposited N50 billion, equivalent to about $38 million, with the Central Bank of Nigeria as part of its bid to secure a merchant banking licence. The deposit was reported to be a key capital requirement for a nationally licensed merchant bank under the CBN’s recapitalisation framework, and was described as one of the final regulatory steps in the application process. The payment was seen as a signal of JPMorgan’s readiness to establish a licensed merchant-banking operation in Nigeria, although it did not guarantee regulatory approval. Reports said the bank expected to obtain the licence by the end of 2026 or early 2027, subject to the CBN completing its assessment and issuing final authorisation. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/jpmorgan-gets-cbn-.title_zh: 摩根大通获得尼日利亚中央银行原则性批准，可设立商业银行
https://leadership.ng/jpmorgan-gets-cbn-.body_zh: 这项批准是许可程序的第一阶段，并不等同于最终银行牌照。拟议银行只有在满足所有监管条件、并由尼日利亚中央银行签发最终牌照后，才能开始运营。尼日利亚中央银行企业传播与投资者关系总监Michael Akuka表示，这项决定反映了这家最高银行机构为加强金融稳定、提升市场信心以及深化尼日利亚与全球资本市场联系所作的努力。他解释道，在银行业资本重组工作完成后，该银行获得了批准；他称，这项工作增强了尼日利亚各家银行的韧性和能力。Akuka表示，JPMorgan Merchant Bank Nigeria Limited仍须在企业事务委员会完成公司注册，并完成必要的运营和监管安排，之后才能获准开始营业。尼日利亚中央银行行长Olayemi Cardoso表示，该央行的目标是建设一个稳定、具有竞争力并与国际接轨的金融体系。他说：“我们的目标是建设一个稳定、具有竞争力并与国际接轨的金融体系，一个能够赢得信心、有效支持投资和经济增长的金融体系。”Cardoso补充道：“国际金融机构对尼日利亚的兴趣日益增长，这令我们深受鼓舞。我们仍专注于维持改革成果、加强市场公信力，并营造一个让国内外机构都能参与和发展的环境。”预计这一进展将推动尼日利亚公司银行、投资银行和资本市场领域的竞争，也表明在Cardoso领导下的尼日利亚中央银行持续推进改革后，国际社会对该国金融部门的兴趣重新升温。尼日利亚中央银行批准提名Adedapo Adedayo Olagunju担任拟议银行董事总经理，还批准Latter Kevin George、Nzelu Chinedum Izunwanne和Syed Gabriel Murtaza担任非执行董事，并批准Alade Sarah Omotunde、Ajayi Olukonyinsola和Adetu Seni担任独立非执行董事。尼日利亚中央银行重申，将致力于维护一个稳健、具有竞争力并与国际接轨的金融体系，以支持可持续增长，并扩大尼日利亚在全球金融市场的参与。回顾此前，JPMorgan Chase & Co.作为争取获得商人银行牌照的一部分，已向尼日利亚中央银行存入500亿奈拉，约合3,800万美元。据报道，这笔存款是尼日利亚中央银行资本重组框架下取得全国性商人银行牌照所需的一项关键资本要求，也是申请流程中最后几个监管步骤之一。这笔款项被视为JPMorgan准备在尼日利亚设立持牌商人银行业务的信号，但并不意味着监管机构一定批准。报道称，该银行预计将在2026年底或2027年初获得牌照，前提是尼日利亚中央银行完成评估并签发最终授权。We've got the edge.
