https://www.inquirer.net/493707/teodoro-.title: Teodoro: China’s attempt to tow BRP Sierra Madre by force an act of war
https://www.inquirer.net/493707/teodoro-.summary: “Any threat against BRP Sierra Madre will be taken very seriously because it will be an act against a military vessel of the Republic of the Philippines,” Teodoro said in a virtual interview with reporters.
https://www.inquirer.net/493707/teodoro-.summary_zh: Teodoro在接受记者视频采访时表示：“针对BRP Sierra Madre的任何威胁都将受到严肃处理，因为这将构成针对菲律宾共和国海军军舰的袭击行为。”
https://www.inquirer.net/493707/teodoro-.body: “Any threat against BRP Sierra Madre will be taken very seriously because it will be an act against a military vessel of the Republic of the Philippines,” Teodoro said in a virtual interview with reporters. “Kung ‘yan ay tinangka, o may mangyari diyan … ginamitan ng pwersa eh ‘yan ay act of war against the Republic of the Philippines,” he said. Teodoro was responding to reports that China was considering 10 possible countermeasures against the Philippines, including towing away the Philippine warship from Ayungin (Second Thomas) Shoal, blocking resupply missions and imposing economic sanctions. The measures were outlined in a report by the Chinese Commercial News, a Manila-based Chinese-language newspaper, although there has been no official confirmation from Beijing that the proposals were being considered or had been approved. Teodoro stressed that an offensive act against a Philippine warship should not be confused with the formal existence of a state of war. “Only the President and the Congress of the Philippines can declare the existence of a state of war. So, I have no power to declare the existence of a state of war,” he said, adding that Congress has the final say. Under the Constitution, Congress has the power to declare the existence of a state of war by a two-thirds vote of both houses, voting separately. Asked whether an attempt by China to board the Sierra Madre could trigger the Philippines’ Mutual Defense Treaty (MDT) with the United States, Teodoro said the possibility remained open, although the decision would ultimately rest with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. “The possibility is open,” he said, clarifying that whether such an incident would lead to a response under the treaty would be a presidential decision. He emphasized that the incident could, rather than necessarily would, lead to the treaty’s invocation. Under the 1951 MDT, the Philippines and the United States committed to act in accordance with their respective constitutional processes in response to an armed attack against either party in the Pacific. Washington has repeatedly affirmed that the treaty covers armed attacks on Philippine armed forces, public vessels and aircraft, including those of the Philippine Coast Guard, anywhere in the South China Sea. Teodoro declined to discuss whether the military was considering changes to its rules of engagement to prevent Chinese personnel from boarding the Sierra Madre, citing operational considerations. Asked about the reported economic sanctions, Teodoro said he had not read the article but warned that the Philippines’ dependence on China could be used against it. “It just goes to show you that whatever supposedly goodwill that they are doing is a weapon and they are weaponizing it,” he said. He urged the government and private sector to strengthen domestic industries and diversify supply chains, particularly for critical infrastructure. “We are constantly being threatened subtly and now more overtly,” Teodoro said. The warning came days after the Philippines completed another rotation and resupply mission to the Sierra Madre, which has been grounded at Ayungin Shoal since 1999 to serve as Manila’s military outpost. READ: AFP mission aborted due to Chinese ships Chinese authorities claimed Wednesday that the Philippine mission had proceeded under their supervision. Teodoro rejected suggestions that Manila had sought Beijing’s permission to deliver supplies to its troops. “No one has the right to ask the Republic of the Philippines to ask for permission for a resupply of Sierra Madre. So, that is false,” he said. He also dismissed Chinese media claims that Philippine personnel had disclosed the contents of their supplies during radio exchanges with Chinese vessels. “Wala tayong obligasyon na sabihin kung anong laman o anong kargada … doon sa isang barko ng Republika ng Pilipinas,” he said. In September, the Armed Forces of the Philippines suspended a resupply mission after Chinese coast guard and naval vessels obstructed Philippine ships approaching Ayungin Shoal, prompting commanders to halt the operation over safety concerns. Earlier this month, the Philippine Coast Guard also accused Chinese vessels of obstructing a medical evacuation from the Sierra Madre, delaying the transfer of an ailing Filipino sailor by nearly 10 hours. The incident prompted Marcos to condemn China’s actions, saying that even during wartime, humanitarian assistance should be allowed to proceed. China has repeatedly demanded that Manila remove the grounded warship, which Beijing claims is illegally occupying the shoal. https://www.inquirer.net/493707/teodoro-.title_zh: 特奥多罗：中国企图强行拖走菲律宾海警船BRP Sierra Madre属于战争行为
https://www.inquirer.net/493707/teodoro-.body_zh: “任何针对BRP Sierra Madre号的威胁都将被非常严肃地对待，因为这将是对菲律宾共和国军舰的攻击行为，”Teodoro在接受记者线上采访时说。“如果他们真的有意为之，而且在那里动用武力，那就是对菲律宾共和国的战争行为，”他说。Teodoro是在回应有关中国正考虑对菲律宾采取10项可能反制措施的报道，其中包括从Ayungin（Second Thomas）浅滩拖走菲律宾军舰、阻断补给任务以及实施经济制裁。这些措施载于总部位于马尼拉的中文报纸《Chinese Commercial News》的一篇报道中，但北京尚未正式确认是否正在考虑或已经批准这些建议。Teodoro强调，针对菲律宾军舰的挑衅行为不应与正式进入战争状态混为一谈。“只有菲律宾总统和国会才有权宣布进入战争状态。因此，我没有权力宣布进入战争状态，”他说，并补充称最终决定权在国会。根据《宪法》，国会有权以两院分别进行表决并获得三分之二多数票的方式宣布进入战争状态。当被问及中国试图登上Sierra Madre号是否会触发菲律宾与美国之间的《共同防御条约》（MDT）时，Teodoro表示，这种可能性仍然存在，尽管最终决定将由总统Ferdinand Marcos Jr.作出。“这种可能性是存在的，”他说，并澄清称，此类事件是否会引发条约规定的响应将由总统决定。他强调，该事件可能触发条约，但并非一定会触发。根据1951年《共同防御条约》，菲律宾和美国承诺，在太平洋地区任何一方遭到武装攻击时，均按照各自宪法程序采取行动。华盛顿多次确认，该条约涵盖对菲律宾武装部队、公用船舶和飞机，包括菲律宾海岸警卫队船只在南海任何地点发动的武装攻击。Teodoro拒绝讨论军方是否正考虑修改交战规则，以阻止中国人员登上Sierra Madre号，理由是涉及行动方面的考量。当被问及有关经济制裁的报道时，Teodoro称自己尚未阅读那篇文章，但警告称，菲律宾对中国的依赖可能被用来对付菲律宾。“这只能说明，他们所谓释放的善意本身就是一种武器，而且他们正在将其武器化，”他说。他敦促政府和私营部门加强国内产业并实现供应链多元化，尤其是关键基础设施的供应链。“我们不断受到隐蔽威胁，如今这些威胁又变得更加公开，”Teodoro说。这一警告发布数日后，菲律宾完成了对Sierra Madre号的一次轮换和补给任务。该舰自1999年起一直停泊在Ayungin浅滩，作为马尼拉的军事前哨。阅读：任务因中国船只而中止 中国当局周三声称，菲律宾的任务是在其监督下进行的。Teodoro驳斥了马尼拉曾寻求北京允许向其部队运送补给的说法。“没有人有权要求菲律宾共和国为Sierra Madre号的补给申请许可。所以，这种说法是错误的，”他说。他还否认了中国媒体关于菲律宾人员在与中国船只进行无线电交流时泄露了补给品内容的说法。“我们没有义务说明菲律宾共和国军舰上装了什么、装载了什么货物，”他说。今年9月，中国海警和海军船只阻碍菲律宾船只接近Ayungin浅滩后，菲律宾武装部队暂停了一次补给任务，相关指挥官出于安全考虑叫停了行动。本月早些时候，菲律宾海岸警卫队还指控中国船只阻碍从Sierra Madre号撤离一名患病菲律宾水兵，使转运延误近10小时。该事件促使Marcos谴责中国的行为，称即使在战时，人道主义援助也应获准继续进行。中国多次要求马尼拉移走这艘搁浅军舰，北京声称该舰非法占据该浅滩。Ayungin浅滩位于Palawan外海约194公里处，处于菲律宾专属经济区内。您的订阅无法保存。请重试。您的订阅已成功。2016年，一个仲裁法庭裁定中国在南海“九段线”范围内对历史权利提出的大范围主张缺乏法律依据，但北京拒绝承认该裁决。/jpv 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们的西菲律宾海专题页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点随时了解最新信息

Unlock these with Subscription The rupee depreciated for the second consecutive day and fell 12 paise to close at 94.93 (provisional) against the U.S. dollar on Friday, pressured by rising crude prices and sluggish domestic equities, with ongoing Saudi-Houthi tensions threatening to keep oil markets volatile.. Forex traders said the rupee is likely to trade with a slight negative bias on global dollar strength and Brent crude prices hovering near $114 per barrel. Renewed tensions between Yemeni Houthis and Saudi Arabia may continue to impact crude oil prices, they said, adding that the US dollar index recovered while 10-year U.S. Treasury yields slipped below the 5% mark. At the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 94.78 against the dollar, then lost ground to touch an intra-day low of 94.98 and finally settled for the day at 94.93 (provisional), registering a decline of 12 paise over its previous close. On Thursday, the rupee slumped 43 paise to close at 94.81 against the U.S. dollar. "We expect the rupee to trade with a slight negative bias on elevated crude oil prices amid escalation of tensions in the Middle East and weakness in domestic markets. "Selling FIIs may also pressurise the rupee. However, softening of U.S. treasury yields and any fresh intervention by the RBI may support the rupee at lower levels," said Anuj Choudhary, Research Analyst, Mirae Asset Sharekhan. Traders may take cues from PMI data from the U.S. and India, Mr. Choudhary said, adding that USD-INR spot price is expected to trade in a range of 94.65 to 95.25. Meanwhile, the dollar index, which gauges the greenback's strength against a basket of six currencies, was trading at 101.73, higher by 0.12%. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, was trading higher by 1.01% at $114.31 per barrel in futures trade. On the domestic equity market front, Sensex declined 125.56 points to settle at 73,123.83, while the Nifty dropped 87.65 points to 22,600. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) offloaded equities worth ₹3,458.70 crore on a net basis on Thursday, according to exchange data. Forex traders said near-term dollar liquidity has improved following the Jio IPO. Jio Platforms' IPO had drawn bids for 136.32 crore shares, against 19.75 crore shares on offer, by 12:03 p.m. on Friday. That is an overall subscription of almost seven times. Institutional demand is leading. Qualified Institutional Buyers bid 70.85 crore shares against 4.90 crore reserved, or 14.46 times. Domestic financial institutions (banks, FIs and insurers) accounted for 34.51 crore shares and foreign institutional investors for 26.95 crore. Mutual funds were much smaller at 4.40 crore. https://www.myjoyonline.com/finance-mini.body: The Ministry of Finance has rejected claim that it withheld information on the utilisation of the Annual Budget Funding Amount (ABFA) from the Public Interest and Accountability Committee (PIAC). In a statement issued on Friday, October 23, 2026, the Ministry said it had provided PIAC with petroleum receipts and distribution data and explained the arrangements governing the use of ABFA resources, including funds ring-fenced for the Accra–Kumasi Expressway. The clarification follows a PIAC statement dated October 21 concerning the exclusion of ABFA utilisation data from its 2026 Semi-Annual Report. “The exclusion of ABFA utilisation data from PIAC’s report should therefore not be presented as evidence that the Ministry withheld information,” the Ministry stated. According to the Ministry, officials participated in PIAC’s virtual validation workshop and held in-person meetings with the Committee to explain petroleum revenue receipts, distribution and the arrangements for ABFA utilisation. On the Accra–Kumasi Expressway, the Ministry cited paragraph 572 of the 2026 Mid-Year Fiscal Policy Review, which states that all funds allocated to the project, including the total ABFA realised in 2026, have been ring-fenced. The funds will be used for construction when the contract is awarded. The Ministry said the decision follows PIAC’s recommendation to stop spreading petroleum revenues thinly across numerous projects with limited economic impact. It explained that concentrating the resources on the expressway is intended to deliver a major infrastructure investment with clear national benefits and value for money. The Ministry also rejected suggestions that District Assemblies had been deprived of their share of ABFA resources. It said the five per cent share due to the District Assemblies Common Fund is being paid from the Consolidated Fund, an arrangement it had explained to PIAC. “Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies have therefore not been shortchanged by the decision to ring-fence ABFA resources for the expressway,” the statement said. The Ministry reaffirmed its commitment to providing PIAC with the information required to discharge its mandate and to accounting publicly for petroleum revenues. It added that relevant details would continue to be published in the Annual Report on Petroleum Funds, Petroleum Reconciliation Reports, Budget Statements and other fiscal reports
https://www.myjoyonline.com/finance-mini.title_zh: 财政部否认向尼日利亚基础设施资产管控办公室隐瞒ABFA数据
https://www.myjoyonline.com/finance-mini.body_zh:
财政部否认向公共利益与问责委员会（PIAC）隐瞒年度预算资金（ABFA）使用信息的说法。财政部在2026年10月23日星期五发布的声明中表示，已向PIAC提供石油收入及分配数据，并解释了ABFA资源使用的相关安排，包括为阿克拉—库马西高速公路预留的资金。此前，PIAC曾于10月21日发表声明，称其2026年半年度报告未纳入ABFA使用数据。财政部表示：“因此，不应将ABFA使用数据未纳入PIAC报告一事说成财政部隐瞒信息的证据。”

财政部称，相关官员参加了PIAC的虚拟核验研讨会，并与委员会举行面对面会议，说明石油收入收入、分配情况以及ABFA使用安排。关于阿克拉—库马西高速公路，财政部援引《2026年中期财政政策评估》第572段，其中指出，拨给该项目的全部资金，包括2026年已实现的ABFA总额，均已单独预留。高速公路合同授予后，这笔资金将用于工程建设。

财政部表示，此决定采纳了PIAC的建议，即不再将石油收入分散投入 numerous 个经济影响有限的项目。财政部解释称，将资源集中用于高速公路，旨在实施一项具有明确全国效益和物有所值效益的大型基础设施投资。

财政部还否认了有关各区议会未获得其应得ABFA资源份额的说法。财政部表示，各区议会共同基金应得的5%份额由综合基金支付，此前已向PIAC作过说明。声明称：“因此，将ABFA资源为高速公路单独预留，并不会使大都会区、市政区和区议会少获应得资金。”

财政部重申，将向PIAC提供履行职责所需的信息，并就石油收入进行公开核算。财政部补充说，相关细节将继续通过《石油基金年度报告》《石油对账报告》《预算报表》及其他财政报告予以公布。

Unlock these with Subscription Mysuru is among 17 cities across the country selected to establish dedicated street food hubs under the Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) scheme, an initiative aimed at supporting street vendors while promoting local cuisine and tourism. The initiative of the Union Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) seeks to provide organised spaces for street food vendors, improve food safety and hygiene, and offer better facilities to customers. The proposed hub in Mysuru is expected to provide food stalls, seating, drinking water, toilets, adequate lighting, signboards, solid waste management facilities, and digital payment options, along with arrangements to ensure compliance with food safety standards. The facility is expected to improve the vending environment, help vendors enhance their earnings, and offer tourists a better experience of Mysuru’s local cuisine, according the Mysuru City Corporation (MCC). Mysuru’s selection is significant given its rich culinary heritage, tourism potential, and reputation as a clean city. The project is expected to support local food businesses while adding to the city’s tourism attractions. The initiative aligns with broader efforts to improve urban amenities, promote cleanliness, and strengthen the livelihood of street vendors. The hub is expected to provide an opportunity to showcase Mysuru’s traditional food and culinary culture to a wider audience while creating a more organised and hygienic environment for vendors and visitors, said MCC Commissioner M. K. Savita. The project is part of the government’s efforts to promote inclusive urban development and improve livelihood opportunities for street vendors under the PM SVANidhi framework. https://leadership.ng/tinubu-promotes-ov.body: The latest figures were disclosed by the Minister of Interior, Dr Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, following a meeting of the Civil Defence, Correctional, Fire and Immigration Services Board (CDCFIB), where members reviewed the board’s activities and took far-reaching decisions on personnel development, welfare and institutional effectiveness. According to the minister, the cumulative promotions across the four paramilitary services since President Tinubu assumed office have risen to well over 100,000 officers, reflecting what he described as the Renewed Hope Agenda’s commitment to building a motivated, disciplined and effective workforce. Giving a breakdown of President Tinubu’s three-year promotion record between 2023 to 2026, the figures provided by the Minister on his Facebook page showed a sustained pattern of promotions across the four services over the period under review. He highlighted the annual figures as follows: 2023: Over 32,000 personnel promoted. 2024: Over 20,000 personnel promoted. 2025: More than 24,000 personnel promoted. The figures , according to Tunji -Ojo cover personnel across the NSCDC, NIS, NCoS and FFS, four critical institutions responsible for Civil Defence, Border Management and Immigration Control, Correctional Administration, and Fire and Emergency response. The minister further explained that the latest approvals further strengthen the administration’s cumulative promotion record, stating that the total number of officers promoted across the services since 2023 now stands at well over 100,000. Speaking on the administration’s renewed push to end career stagnation, Tunji-Ojo said the menace has remained a major concern for personnel in Nigeria’s paramilitary institutions, where delayed promotions can affect morale, productivity and professional development. The Minister said the sustained promotion exercises form part of efforts to address the challenge and ensure that deserving personnel have improved opportunities for career advancement. “By approving promotions across the four services, the government is seeking to strengthen institutional discipline, reward meritorious service and improve the motivation of officers entrusted with important national security and public safety responsibilities. He said, “The development is particularly significant for agencies whose personnel operate in demanding environments, including border posts, correctional facilities, fire emergencies and communities requiring civil defence operations. Tunji-Ojo further explained that beyond career advancement, the CDCFIB meeting also recorded a major development in personnel welfare, with the board validating a comprehensive healthcare policy framework designed to promote the health, fitness and overall well-being of officers and men across the four services. He said, “The framework signals an additional focus on the welfare needs of personnel whose duties often expose them to physical risks, demanding working conditions and considerable operational pressure. “A healthier workforce can contribute to improved readiness, productivity and service delivery, particularly in agencies where physical fitness and the ability to respond effectively to emergencies are essential. He expressed the optimism that the practical impact of the framework will depend on its subsequent implementation, funding arrangements, coverage and accessibility for eligible personnel across the services. “I must say that this latest decisions by the Board reflect a broader effort to strengthen the institutions under the Ministry of Interior through improved career progression and a greater focus on the well-being of their personnel. ” Its a fact that , Flfor the NSCDC, NIS, NCoS and FFS, the combination of promotions and a healthcare policy framework addresses two important dimensions of workforce management: professional advancement and personnel welfare. “As the Tinubu administration continues to implement its Renewed Hope Agenda, the government’s stated objective is to maintain a disciplined, motivated and fit workforce capable of discharging its constitutional responsibilities effectively.! https://leadership.ng/tinubu-promotes-ov.body_zh: 内政部长奥卢布米·通吉-奥乔博士在民防、惩教、消防和移民事务委员会（CDCFIB）会议后公布了最新数据。委员会成员审议了委员会的工作，并就人员发展、福利和机构效能作出重大决定。通吉-奥乔部长表示，自蒂努布总统上任以来，四个准军事部门累计晋升人数已超过10万名军官，体现了他所谓“新希望议程”对建设一支积极进取、纪律严明且高效能队伍的承诺。他在其Facebook页面上公布了蒂努布总统2023年至2026年三年间的晋升记录，显示在该报告期内，四个部门的晋升工作持续推进。年度数据如下：2023年：晋升超过32,000人。2024年：晋升超过20,000人。2025年：晋升超过24,000人。据通吉-奥乔介绍，这些数据涵盖国家民防委员会（NSCDC）、国家情报局（NIS）、监狱服务（NCoS）和消防局（FFS）的人员。这四个关键机构分别负责民防、边境管理和移民管控、惩教管理以及消防和应急响应。部长进一步表示，最新批准的晋升进一步强化了本届政府累计晋升纪录；自2023年以来，各部门累计晋升的军官总数现已远超10万名。谈及政府再次推动终结职业晋升停滞现象，通吉-奥乔表示，这一问题一直是尼日利亚准军事机构人员的一大关切，晋升延误可能影响士气、生产力和职业发展。部长说，持续开展晋升工作是应对这一挑战的一部分，旨在确保优秀人员获得更多职业晋升机会。他说：“政府批准四个部门的人员晋升，旨在加强机构纪律，奖励功勋卓著的服务人员，并提高承担重要国家安全和公共安全职责的军官的积极性。”他说：“这一进展对于人员需要在艰苦环境中工作的机构尤其重要，其中包括边境哨所、惩教设施、消防应急现场以及需要开展民防行动的社区。通吉-奥乔进一步解释称，除了职业晋升外，CDCFIB会议还在人员福利方面取得重大进展。委员会核准了一套全面的医疗保健政策框架，旨在促进四个部门官兵的健康、体能和整体福祉。他说：“该框架表明，政府更加重视人员福利需求，因为这些人员的职责往往使其面临身体风险、艰苦工作条件和巨大的行动压力。“更健康的队伍有助于提升战备水平、生产力和公共服务能力，尤其是对那些要求员工具备良好体能和有效应急响应能力的机构而言。他乐观地表示，该框架能否产生实际影响，将取决于后续实施情况、资金安排、覆盖范围以及各部门符合条件人员获得医疗服务的便利程度。“我必须指出，委员会最新作出的这些决定体现了更广泛的努力，即通过改善职业晋升渠道并更加关注人员福祉，加强内政部下属机构。 ” 事实上，对于NSCDC、NIS、NCoS和FFS而言，晋升与医疗保健政策框架相结合， addressed 人员管理的两个重要方面：职业晋升和人员福利。通吉-奥乔说：“随着蒂努布政府继续实施‘新希望议程’，政府既定目标是维持一支纪律严明、积极进取且身体健康、能够有效履行宪法职责的队伍。”他总结道。“我们占据了优势。获取实时报道、突发独家消息和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取24/7最新消息 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> 克里斯蒂安娜·恩瓦奥古 克里斯蒂安娜·埃塞博努·埃贝-恩瓦奥古是《Leadership Newspaper》的周刊副编辑，拥有超过15年报道民生、安全、发展和社会议题的经验。她是一位屡获殊荣的创意作家和资深记者，凭借出色的写作与编辑能力以及持续推出独家报道的纪录，从记者晋升至现任编辑职位。

https://www.thehindu.com/business/indust.body_zh:
订阅可享受《高端报道》《社论》《观点》等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。

政府已将关税配额（TRQ）项下100万吨原糖的免关税进口期限延长至12月31日，以在节日季增加国内供应。

据财政部通知，进口窗口已延长至2026年12月31日。8月20日，政府允许进口100万吨原糖，期限截至10月31日。据行业数据，迄今已进口约26万吨。

行业人士表示，由于价格缺乏平价，进口一直较为低迷。此次延期的目的是确保在国际价格回落至足以使进口具备经济可行性时获得供应。

除允许进口外，政府还采取了一系列措施，包括对贸易商实施持仓限制，以确保国内供应充足，并在供应紧张的情况下抑制价格。

目前预计，2025-26销售年度（10月至次年9月）的食糖产量为306万吨，低于此前343万吨的预测。国内年需求量约为280万至285万吨。

Unlock these with Subscription The Tamil Nadu government has written to the National Medical Commission (NMC) and University Grants Commission (UGC) seeking appropriate action against Saveetha Medical College for collecting additional fees from undergraduate medical students and for disabling access to the students’ attendance portal, Health Minister K.G. Arunraj said. In a press release issued on Wednesday, he said that NMC, in a public notice issued on April 7, had said the fees for MBBS course should be collected only for the prescribed academic duration of four and a half years. The State government took the complaints seriously, and the Directorate of Medical Education and Research constituted a three-member committee to conduct an inquiry. A total of 17 students and seven parents participated in the inquiry conducted on October 12. The management of Saveetha Medical College, which was called for the inquiry, did not attend it. The inquiry found that the college did not follow the NMC guidelines on collecting tuition fees from students, the Minister said. It was also found that the college had disabled the attendance portal for students who had not paid the full annual fee for the fifth year from September 30. As Saveetha Medical College is a deemed-to-be university, its fee structure falls outside the purview of the State Fee Fixation Committee. As the institution is regulated by the NMC and UGC, the State government wrote to them on October 21, urging them to take action against the college for collecting additional fees and to direct it to collect only half the annual fee for the fifth year, Dr. Arunraj said. The State government also urged the Commission to direct the college to restore students’ access to the attendance portal and ensure that no student was denied attendance, clinical training, or eligibility to appear for examinations for failing to pay the additional amount. It also sought directions to refund or adjust the amount collected in excess and to ensure that no student or parent faces consequences for filing a complaint or participating in the inquiry. The Minister said the State government was firm that no student’s education should be affected over fee issues. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. 泰米尔纳德邦政府已致函印度国家医学委员会（NMC）和大学拨款委员会（UGC），要求针对 Saveetha Medical College 向医学本科学生收取额外费用以及禁用学生考勤门户一事采取适当行动。卫生部长 K.G. Arunraj 表示。

他在周三发布的新闻公报中说，NMC 在 4 月 7 日发布的公告中表示，MBBS 课程的费用只能在规定的 4 年半学制期间收取。邦政府认真对待这些投诉，并成立了一个由 3 名成员组成的委员会进行调查。共有 17 名学生和 7 名家长参加了 10 月 12 日举行的调查。应要求参加调查的 Saveetha Medical College 管理层未予出席。

部长说，调查发现该学院未遵守 NMC 关于向学生收取学费的规定。调查还发现，自 9 月 30 日起，该学院禁用了未缴清第 5 年全年费用的学生考勤门户。

由于 Saveetha Medical College 是一所享有同等大学地位的大学，其收费结构不受邦费用固定委员会的监管。该机构受 NMC 和 UGC 监管，因此邦政府于 10 月 21 日致函两机构，敦促其针对该学院收取额外费用采取行动，并指示该学院第 5 年只收取半年费用。Arunraj 博士说。

邦政府还敦促委员会指示该学院恢复学生使用考勤门户的权限，并确保任何学生都不会因未支付额外费用而被拒绝考勤、参加临床培训或获得参加考试的资格。政府还要求有关部门指示学院退还多收的款项或予以调整，并确保任何学生或家长都不会因提出投诉或参与调查而面临后果。

部长表示，邦政府坚决认为，任何学生的教育都不应因费用问题受到影响。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Solidigm, SK hynix’s NAND flash memory subsidiary, has decided to halt its review of potential pre-initial public offering (IPO) fundraising and IPO options, citing volatile capital markets and recent trends in semiconductor stock prices, the chip giant said Friday. The company was established in the United States following SK hynix’s $9 billion acquisition of Intel’s NAND flash memory business. "While SK hynix and Solidigm continue to deliver solid business performance, financial market volatility has increased, contributing to a broader correction in semiconductor stocks," SK hynix said in a press statement. Reports circulated that Solidigm was considering a U.S. IPO as early as next year that could value the company at up to $150 billion, with the listing seen as a way to secure funding for U.S. production facilities and technology development amid growing demand for enterprise solid-state drives for artificial intelligence data centers. However, the potential listing had raised concerns over its impact on SK hynix's shareholder value, as well as regulatory scrutiny over the possibility of a subsidiary listing overseas while its parent company remains listed in Korea. Amid mounting controversy over Solidigm’s potential dual listing, financial authorities warned that the plan would face regulatory checks. Earlier this week, Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) Gov. Lee Chan-jin said both the FSS and the Financial Services Commission viewed Solidigm as subject to restrictions on duplicate listings. However, SK hynix said the decision does not reflect any change in the company’s growth prospects or investment needs. “Rather, it reflects a reassessment of whether an IPO would be the most beneficial option for SK hynix and its existing shareholders under current market conditions," it added. SK hynix said raising external capital through an IPO could have improved its consolidated cash flow, helping fund facility investments while supporting shareholder returns through dividends, share buybacks and share cancellations. It also said an IPO could have allowed the market to better recognize Solidigm’s growth potential, which it believes is not adequately reflected in SK hynix’s current corporate value. Expanding Solidigm’s production capacity and strengthening its competitiveness remain key priorities, SK hynix said, adding that it would continue to assess investment timing, scale and financing options to support the subsidiary’s growth and enhance value for existing shareholders
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: SK海力士暂停审查Solidigm在美国股市上市计划
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: SK hynix旗下NAND闪存子公司Solidigm周五表示，鉴于资本市场波动以及近期半导体股价格走势，该公司已决定暂停评估通过首次公开募股（IPO）筹资及实施IPO的方案。SK hynix以90亿美元收购英特尔的NAND闪存业务后，在美国设立了这家公司。SK hynix在一份新闻稿中表示：“尽管SK hynix和Solidigm持续取得稳健的业务业绩，但金融市场波动加剧，促使半导体股票出现更广泛回调。”此前有报道称，Solidigm最早可能在明年考虑赴美IPO，公司估值最高可达150亿美元；在人工智能数据中心对企业级固态驱动器需求不断增长的背景下，上市被视为一种筹资方式，可为美国生产设施和技术开发提供资金。然而，潜在的上市引发了外界担忧：一是可能影响SK hynix的股东价值；二是子公司在海外上市而母公司在韩国上市，可能受到监管审查。随着围绕Solidigm潜在双重上市的争议不断升温，韩国金融当局警告称，该计划将面临监管审查。本周早些时候，韩国金融监督院长李 chan-jin表示，金融监督院和韩国金融委员会均认为，Solidigm的上市安排须遵守重复上市限制。不过，SK hynix表示，这一决定并不意味着公司增长前景或投资需求发生了变化。公司称：“相反，这反映了对在当前市场条件下，IPO是否仍是SK hynix及其现有股东的最佳选择的重新评估。”SK hynix表示，通过IPO筹集外部资本原本可以改善其合并现金流，为设施投资提供资金，同时通过分红、股份回购和股份注销支持股东回报。公司还表示，IPO原本可以让市场更充分地认识到Solidigm的增长潜力，而该公司认为这一潜力尚未充分反映在SK hynix目前的整体企业价值中。SK hynix称，扩大Solidigm的产能并增强其竞争力仍是重点优先事项；公司将继续评估投资的时机、规模和融资方案，以支持该子公司增长并提升现有股东的价值

https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-touts.body: President John Dramani Mahama has touted his administration’s $10 billion Big Push Infrastructure Programme, saying the initiative will accelerate infrastructure development, create hundreds of thousands of jobs and complete stalled legacy projects across the country. Speaking at the 13th Financial Times (FT) Africa Summit in London, President Mahama said the programme would be implemented over five years, with $2 billion allocated annually. “We are building infrastructure through the Big Push Programme. It is a $10 billion programme over five years, with $2 billion allocated each year,” he said. He explained that the programme, which began with road infrastructure, would expand to cover schools, hospitals, irrigation schemes, and other projects to support national development. President Mahama also announced plans for a new economy plan involving $10 billion in self-financed investment over four years. He said the funds would go to nine job-rich sectors, including tourism, energy, agriculture, agro-processing, pharmaceuticals, and textiles and garments. He attributed the planned investments to fiscal adjustments his administration is undertaking, including reducing the primary balance target agreed with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) from 1.5 per cent to 0.5 per cent. The President said the adjustment would create an additional fiscal space equivalent to one percentage point, which would be channelled into the targeted sectors to stimulate economic activity and employment. “However, the economy is holding steadily. Our currency is stable, and interest rates are still falling. I think there is a lot we can do for ourselves, even as we call for reform of the global order,” he said. The two-day summit, held under the theme “Mobilising Growth in a New Global Order”, brought together global business leaders, policymakers and heads of state to discuss economic growth and development. Addressing Africa’s debt burden and the global financial system, President Mahama argued that the international economic order placed the continent at a disadvantage, particularly in accessing financing to respond to climate change. “We contribute just four per cent of greenhouse gas emissions, yet we borrow at eight times the cost to deal with the effects of flooding, forest fires and other climate-related challenges,” he said. He further cited the financial resources leaving the continent through debt servicing and illicit financial flows, saying about $80 billion went out annually in interest and debt repayments, while another $90 billion was lost through illicit financial flows, transfer pricing and related practices. The President also expressed concern about declining Overseas Development Assistance (ODA), noting that it fell by 23.5 per cent in 2025 and was expected to decline further in 2026. Despite these challenges, he described Africa as resilient, arguing that the continent continued to endure substantial financial outflows even as development assistance dwindled. “More than $200 billion goes out every year while ODA continues to dwindle,” he said, questioning how Europe would have coped under similar circumstances
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-touts.title_zh: 马哈马宣传价值100亿美元的“大推进”计划，以推动基础设施建设和就业
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-touts.body_zh: 约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马总统赞扬了本届政府规模为100亿美元的“大推进”基础设施计划，称该计划将加快基础设施建设，创造数十万个就业岗位，并完成全国各处停滞的遗留项目。马哈马总统在伦敦举行的第13届《金融时报》非洲峰会上表示，该计划将在5年内实施，每年拨款20亿美元。他说：“我们正通过‘大推进’计划建设基础设施。这是一个为期5年、总额100亿美元的计划，每年拨款20亿美元。”他解释道，该计划将从道路基础设施开始，随后扩展至学校、医院、灌溉设施及其他支持国家发展的项目。马哈马总统还宣布制定一项新经济计划，计划在4年内投入100亿美元的自筹资金。他说，这些资金将投向9个就业密集型部门，包括旅游、能源、农业、农产品加工、制药、纺织和服装业。他表示，拟议中的投资得益于本届政府正在进行的财政调整，包括将与国际货币基金组织（IMF）商定的基本盈余目标从1.5%降至0.5%。总统说，这一调整将额外释放相当于国内生产总值1个百分点的财政空间，并将其投入重点部门，以刺激经济活动和就业。他说：“不过，经济保持稳定。我们的货币保持稳定，利率仍在下降。我认为，即使我们呼吁改革全球秩序，我们仍然可以在很多事情上依靠自己。”这场为期两天的峰会以“新全球秩序下调动增长”为主题，汇聚全球商界领袖、政策制定者和国家元首，讨论经济增长与发展问题。谈及非洲债务负担和全球金融体系时，马哈马总统认为，国际经济秩序使非洲处于不利地位，尤其是在获得应对气候变化所需的融资方面。他说：“我们的温室气体排放量只占4%，然而，为应对洪水、森林火灾和其他气候相关挑战而借款，我们支付的利率却是其他借款的8倍。”他还提到，因偿债和非法资金流动而离开非洲的金融资源，称非洲每年为利息和债务偿还流出约800亿美元，另有900亿美元因非法资金流动、转让定价及相关做法而流失。总统还对海外发展援助（ODA）减少表示关切，指出其2025年下降了23.5%，预计2026年还会进一步下降。尽管面临这些挑战，他仍认为非洲具有韧性，并指出，即使发展援助日益减少，非洲仍在承受大量资金外流。他说：“每年有超过2000亿美元流出，而海外发展援助却持续萎缩。”他质疑，在类似情况下，欧洲将如何应对。

https://dailytrust.com/fg-giz-push-skill.body: The Federal Government and the German development agency, GIZ, have called for stronger links between skills development and employment opportunities to help Nigerian youths secure jobs and enable businesses to find qualified workers. They made the call at the Abuja Job and Career Fair 2026, where government officials and development partners stressed the need for improved career guidance, effective job-matching services and closer cooperation with employers. The Minister of Labour and Employment, Dr Muhammad Maigari Dingyadi, said the government was committed to expanding access to employment through public job centres and the National Electronic Labour Exchange (NELEX), a digital platform designed to connect job seekers with employers. He said the country’s youthful population could contribute significantly to national development if young people acquired relevant skills and had access to meaningful economic opportunities. Dingyadi, who declared the fair open, identified skills mismatches, informal employment and difficulties connecting job seekers with employers as challenges requiring coordinated action. He said the fair provided opportunities for recruitment, career counselling, professional networking and skills development, with sessions covering workplace readiness, entrepreneurship, digitalisation and migration pathways. The minister called on employers to look beyond academic qualifications when assessing candidates and consider their abilities, potential and willingness to learn. Mrs Oladoyin Olayi, Organisational Development Coordinator at GIZ Nigeria, said the organisation had worked with the Ministry of Labour and Employment for eight years to strengthen employment services in the country. Representing GIZ Country Director Dr Marcus Wagner, she said the partnership had supported job centres, vocational training, labour migration advice, business digitalisation and entrepreneurship. Olayi disclosed that 11 job centres had been established across five states under the Skills Development for Youth Programme, with four additional centres planned. She said the centres had served more than 65,000 people, over half of them women, by providing career guidance, connecting job seekers with vacancies and referring them to training opportunities. On labour migration, Olayi said more than 31,000 people had received advice on regular migration since 2023, while over 14,000 had been referred to qualification programmes in sectors including hospitality, information and communications technology, construction, renewable energy and fashion. She said more than 3,600 Nigerians returning from abroad had also received support to review their livelihoods. Olamide Adeyeye, Country Head of Programme at Jobberman Nigeria, said physical career fairs remained important despite the increasing use of digital recruitment platforms. He said many young people continued to face barriers to accessing online employment opportunities because of their location, gender, financial circumstances and limited access to digital resources. He said bringing employers and job seekers together physically allowed candidates to demonstrate their capabilities, ask questions and establish professional relationships. Adeyeye disclosed that more than 150,000 people had secured jobs through job fairs, career events and job centres in the past year, describing direct engagement as an important way to connect qualified candidates with employers. He said employment initiatives must focus not only on preparing young people for work but also on ensuring that suitable opportunities were available to them. Adeyeye urged participants to engage actively with recruiters and make the most of the training sessions, while encouraging employers to recognise the potential of candidates beyond their CVs. https://dailytrust.com/fg-giz-push-skill.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府和德国国际合作机构推动技能与就业衔接，应对青年失业问题
https://dailytrust.com/fg-giz-push-skill.body_zh:
尼日利亚联邦政府与德国发展机构GIZ呼吁加强技能培养与就业机会之间的衔接，帮助尼日利亚青年获得就业机会，也让企业找到合格的劳动者。他们在2026年阿布jobs职业博览会上发出这一呼吁。会上，政府官员和发展伙伴强调，需要改善职业指导、提供有效的职位匹配服务，并与雇主加强合作。

劳工与就业部长Muhammad Maigari Dingyadi博士表示，政府致力于通过公共就业中心和国家电子劳动力交易所（NELEX）扩大就业获取渠道。国家电子劳动力交易所是一个连接求职者与雇主的数字平台。他说，如果年轻人掌握相关技能并获得有意义的经济机会，尼日利亚庞大而年轻的劳动力人口就能为国家发展作出重大贡献。Dingyadi宣布博览会开幕，并指出技能错配、非正规就业以及求职者与雇主之间难以建立联系等问题，这些问题需要协调应对。

他说，本次博览会为招聘、职业咨询、专业 networking 和技能发展提供了机会，议程涵盖职场准备、创业、数字化和移民 pathways。部长呼吁雇主在评估求职者时超越学历要求，考虑他们的能力、潜力和学习意愿。

GIZ Nigeria组织发展协调员Oladoyin Olayi女士表示，该机构已与劳工与就业部合作8年，旨在加强尼日利亚的就业服务。她代表GIZ国家主任Marcus Wagner博士表示，双方合作支持了就业中心、职业培训、劳务移民咨询、企业数字化和创业发展。

Olayi透露，“青年技能发展计划”已在5个州建立11个就业中心，并计划再增设4个。她表示，这些中心已通过提供职业指导、连接求职者与职位空缺、将求职者转介至培训机会等方式，为超过65,000人提供服务，其中超过一半是女性。

谈及劳务移民，Olayi表示，自2023年以来，已有超过31,000人获得正规移民方面的咨询，超过14,000人被转介至酒店业、信息通信技术、建筑、可再生能源和时尚等行业资格培训项目。她表示，还有超过3,600名从海外返回的尼日利亚人获得了支持，以重新评估自己的生计方式。

Jobberman Nigeria项目负责人Olamide Adeyeye表示，尽管数字招聘平台的使用日益增加，实体职业博览会仍然十分重要。他说，许多年轻人因所在地、性别、经济状况以及数字资源获取能力有限等因素，仍然难以获得线上就业机会。

Adeyeye说，在实体场所把雇主和求职者聚集在一起，可以让求职者展示能力、提出问题并建立职业关系。他透露，过去一年，超过150,000人通过职业博览会、职业活动和就业中心获得了工作；他将与合格求职者和雇主直接接触视为实现匹配的重要途径。

Adeyeye表示，就业举措不仅要让年轻人为工作做好准备，还要确保他们能够获得合适的就业机会。他敦促参与者积极参与招聘人员互动，充分利用培训课程，同时鼓励雇主不要只依据求职者简历，而应认识到他们的潜力。

Unlock these with Subscription A U.S. judge on Thursday (October 22, 2026) issued President Donald Trump a December 11 deadline to testify under oath in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC . Judge Enjolique Lett in Miami gave the order in response to complaints by the British broadcaster that Mr. Trump has refused to sit for a deposition, including canceling a previously agreed date of October 16. If Mr. Trump fails to attend the deposition by then, he risks sanctions, including dismissal of his lawsuit, the court said. Mr. Trump has accused the BBC of deceptively editing its documentary "Trump: A Second Chance" to make it seem as if he was inciting violence when he told supporters to march on the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021, after losing the presidential election. The crowd proceeded to storm Congress in an attempt to stop the formal certification of Democrat Joe Biden's victory. While the BBC has apologised for the incident, which prompted the resignation of multiple senior executives, the broadcaster has denied it caused Mr. Trump any real injury and moved for the case to be dismissed. Mr. Trump filed his suit against the BBC in December 2025 and is seeking at least $5 billion on each of two counts. Charles Tobin, a lawyer for the BBC , said in court that Mr. Trump had no real excuse not to testify and that on October 16, he had only been campaigning, "participating in party politics." In a court filing Wednesday (October 21), Mr. Trump's legal team argued that he was not seeking to avoid a deposition but had been constrained by "matters of national importance." The lawyers said Mr. Trump would be able to give a deposition between January 11 and 22. Mr. Trump has made attacks on the media a signature of his two presidential terms, insulting reporters who ask questions he doesn't like and seeking to ban outlets airing critical reports from the White House. Most recently, the administration has plunged into a legal dispute with CNN, MSNOW and Politico over attempts to bar them from the White House. With his approval ratings in the low 30% range and polls showing his Republican Party likely to lose control of the House of Representatives in the November 3 midterm elections, Mr. Trump faces increasing headwinds as he approaches his final years in power. https://leadership.ng/senate-moves-to-st.summary: The proposed legislation, sponsored by Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele, representing Ekiti Central Senatorial District, seeks to establish a modern legal framework for the establishment, regulation, monitoring and management of universities and other degree-awarding institutions across the country. He said the proposed legislation would strengthen the commission’s ability to enforce regulations, penalise violations, improve quality assurance and promote internationally recognised academic standards.
https://leadership.ng/senate-moves-to-st.summary_zh: 由代表埃基蒂州中部选区的参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱提出的法案，旨在为全国高校及其他学位授予机构的设立、监管、监测和管理建立现代法律框架。他说，拟议法案将加强委员会执行规定、惩处违规行为、改进质量保证以及推广国际认可学术标准的能力。
https://leadership.ng/senate-moves-to-st.body: The proposed legislation, sponsored by Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele, representing Ekiti Central Senatorial District, seeks to establish a modern legal framework for the establishment, regulation, monitoring and management of universities and other degree-awarding institutions across the country. The bill, titled National Universities Commission Act (Repeal and Re-enactment) Bill, 2026 (SB. 1056), was presented on behalf of Bamidele by Senate Chief Whip Tahir Monguno, representing Borno North Senatorial District. Leading the debate, Monguno said the existing NUC Act had become outdated in view of changes in Nigeria’s higher education landscape, including the proliferation of private universities, technological advancements, internationalisation of education and evolving national development priorities. He said the proposed legislation would strengthen the commission’s ability to enforce regulations, penalise violations, improve quality assurance and promote internationally recognised academic standards. According to Monguno, the bill also seeks to balance regulatory oversight with institutional autonomy, modernise the commission’s governance structure, encourage international partnerships and address funding challenges affecting university education. “These reforms have become necessary to reposition the NUC as a dynamic catalyst for positive change and innovation in the delivery of quality university education,” he said. He urged senators to support the bill, arguing that a stronger regulatory framework would enable the commission to discharge its statutory responsibilities more effectively. Contributing to the debate, Senator Victor Umeh, representing Anambra Central Senatorial District, called for stronger enforcement powers for the NUC, alleging that some private universities had adopted management structures inconsistent with the existing legal framework. Umeh said that while the commission had initially focused on public universities, the growth of private institutions had created additional regulatory challenges. He alleged that some private universities registered as limited liability companies or companies limited by guarantee had introduced management arrangements involving managing directors and executive directors instead of adhering to governance structures prescribed by law. “The NUC, when it was established, was managing public universities, and at some point, private universities came into being. The private universities that we have in Nigeria today are being run by people who do not keep to the standards as prescribed by the National Universities Commission,” he said. According to Umeh, the commission sometimes struggled to enforce compliance when institutions ignored its directives or challenged its authority. He said the proposed legislation presented an opportunity to strengthen the NUC’s powers and ensure that universities complied with regulations governing their establishment and administration. “When you are told that you are not doing the right thing, that the way and the structure of governance in that private university is not in accordance with the law, you go to court and continue to vacillate,” he said. Umeh recalled that the commission had previously exercised considerable influence over university management by ensuring that institutions complied with its directives. He argued that stronger enforcement provisions were necessary to prevent institutions from disregarding regulatory orders. “Any university that is operating anywhere in Nigeria must align itself with the governance directives of the National Universities Commission. Otherwise, such universities should be proscribed,” he said. He added that the primary objective should be to protect academic standards and ensure that private universities operated within the law. During the debate, senators also discussed allegations of irregular management practices at Tansian University in Anambra State. Umeh cited the institution as an example of what he described as concerns over governance structures and compliance with NUC directives. He alleged that the university’s management arrangements allowed a managing director to exercise powers over appointments and administrative decisions in ways he considered inconsistent with established university governance practices. The allegations were raised during the Senate debate as lawmakers considered whether the proposed legislation would provide the commission with more effective tools to enforce compliance. The discussion also prompted calls for clearer procedures to address institutions that fail to comply with regulatory directives. The Senate President indicated that stronger legislation could help the National Assembly support the commission’s oversight responsibilities and address persistent cases of non-compliance. He also raised the possibility of recommending the proscription of institutions that failed to meet the required standards, subject to the appropriate legal and executive procedures. Beyond enforcement, the proposed legislation seeks to update the NUC’s regulatory framework to reflect developments in higher education. The bill aims to strengthen programme accreditation, update minimum academic standards, improve monitoring mechanisms and promote research and innovation. It also proposes changes to the composition and functions of the commission’s governing board to improve operational efficiency and accountability. Other objectives include providing a clearer framework for international partnerships, foreign investment in university education and the attraction of international faculty and students. The proposed reforms are also intended to encourage greater institutional autonomy while maintaining effective regulatory oversight. Monguno said the changes would help position Nigeria’s university system to respond to emerging challenges and compete more effectively internationally. Following the debate, the Senate passed the bill for second reading through a voice vote. The legislation was subsequently referred to the Senate Committee on Tertiary Institutions and TETFund for further legislative consideration, with the committee directed to report back to the Senate within four weeks. https://leadership.ng/senate-moves-to-st.body_zh:
由代表埃基蒂州中部选区的参议院领袖奥佩米·巴米德莱提出的法案，拟为全国大学及其他学位授予机构的设立、监管、监督和管理建立现代法律框架。该法案名为《2026年国家大学委员会法（废止并重新制定）法案》（SB. 1056），由代表博尔诺州北部选区的参议院首席党鞭 Tahir Monguno 代表巴米德莱提交。主持辩论时，Monguno表示，鉴于尼日利亚高等教育格局发生变化，包括私立大学激增、技术进步、教育国际化以及国家发展重点不断演变，现行《国家大学委员会法》已经过时。他说，拟议立法将增强委员会执行规定、惩处违规行为、改善质量保证以及推广国际认可学术标准的能力。

据Monguno介绍，该法案还寻求在监管与机构自主权之间取得平衡，推进委员会治理结构现代化，鼓励国际合作，并解决影响大学教育的资金难题。他说：“为了将国家大学委员会重新定位为提供优质大学教育和推动积极变革与创新的充满活力的催化剂，这些改革已成为必要。”他敦促参议员支持该法案，认为更有力的监管框架将使委员会更有效地履行法定职责。

代表阿南布拉州中部选区的参议员 Victor Umeh 参与辩论时，呼吁赋予国家大学委员会更强的执法权，并指称一些私立大学采用了与现行法律框架不一致的管理结构。Umeh表示，尽管委员会最初主要关注公立大学，但私立机构的发展带来了更多监管挑战。他指称，一些以有限责任公司或担保有限公司形式注册的私立大学引入了由常务董事和执行董事参与的管理安排，而没有遵循法律规定的治理结构。

他说：“国家大学委员会成立之初负责管理公立大学，后来私立大学也开始出现。如今尼日利亚的私立大学由一些人经营，他们没有遵守国家大学委员会规定的标准。”据Umeh介绍，当一些机构无视委员会指示或对其权威提出质疑时，委员会有时难以确保其遵守规定。他说，拟议立法为加强国家大学委员会的权力，并确保大学遵守有关设立和管理的规定提供了机会。

他说：“当你被告知没有正确履行职责，告知那所私立大学的治理方式和结构不符合法律时，你却仍然起诉并继续摇摆不定。”Umeh回顾称，委员会过去曾通过确保各机构遵守其指示，对大学管理施加了相当大的影响。他认为，必须设置更有力的执法条款，以防止机构无视监管命令。

他说：“任何在尼日利亚境内运营的大学都必须遵守国家大学委员会的治理指令，否则就应禁止其办学。”他还补充说，首要目标应是保护学术标准，确保私立大学依法运营。

辩论期间，参议员还讨论了关于阿南布拉州 Tansian University 管理做法不规范的指控。Umeh将该院校列为一个例子，用以说明他所称的治理结构问题以及不遵守国家大学委员会指示的问题。他指称，该大学的管理安排允许常务董事对任命和行政决定行使权力，而他认为这种做法与既定大学治理惯例不符。

这些指控是在参议院辩论期间提出的，当时议员正在审议拟议立法能否为委员会提供更有效的工具以执行合规要求。相关讨论还促使各方呼吁建立更明确的程序，以处理不遵守监管指示的机构。参议院议长表示，更强有力的立法能够帮助国民议会支持委员会的监督职责，并解决长期存在的不合规问题。他还提出，可以建议禁止未能达到规定标准的机构，但须遵守适当的法律和行政程序。

除执法外，拟议立法还旨在更新国家大学委员会的监管框架，使其反映高等教育领域的发展。该法案力求加强专业认证、更新最低学术标准、改善监督机制，并促进研究与创新。法案还提议调整委员会理事会的组成和职能，以提高运营效率和问责水平。其他目标包括为国际合作、大学教育领域的外国投资以及吸引国际教师和学生建立更清晰的框架。

拟议改革还旨在鼓励更大程度的机构自主权，同时保持有效的监管监督。Monguno表示，这些变化将帮助尼日利亚大学体系做好应对新挑战的准备，并在国际市场上具备更强的竞争力。辩论结束后，参议院以口头表决方式通过该法案，进入二读程序。随后，该法案被移交参议院高等教育机构及 TETFund 委员会作进一步立法审议，并指示该委员会在4周内向参议院提交报告。

https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.title: Senate Orders Probe Of Tansian University Over Alleged Regulatory Breaches
https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.summary: He argued that alleged disregard for established regulatory procedures could undermine university governance, weaken academic standards and damage the international reputation of Nigerian graduates. Following the deliberations, the Senate approved a motion for an investigation into Tansian University’s operations and management and directed the relevant committee to report back within two weeks.
https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.summary_zh: 他认为，涉嫌无视既定监管程序的行为可能破坏大学治理、削弱学术标准，并损害尼日利亚毕业生的国际声誉。参议院经过审议后，批准了一项动议，要求调查Tansian University的运营和管理，并指示相关委员会在两周内提交报告。
https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.body: The directive followed concerns raised by Senator Victor Umeh, representing Anambra Central Senatorial District, during deliberations on a bill seeking to repeal and re-enact the National Universities Commission Act. Umeh called for an immediate investigation into the university’s governance structure, particularly allegations concerning the appointment and removal of university officials and the exercise of management powers. He argued that alleged disregard for established regulatory procedures could undermine university governance, weaken academic standards and damage the international reputation of Nigerian graduates. Responding to the concerns, Senate President Godswill Akpabio emphasised the need to strengthen the regulatory authority of the NUC to ensure that public and private universities operated within the confines of the law. Akpabio noted that the National Assembly had an oversight responsibility to support the commission in enforcing standards across the university system. He added that where an institution was found to have violated applicable laws, the National Assembly could recommend appropriate action to the President, including its proscription, subject to the relevant legal procedures. Following the deliberations, the Senate approved a motion for an investigation into Tansian University’s operations and management and directed the relevant committee to report back within two weeks. Umeh had expressed concern that some private universities allegedly operated management structures inconsistent with established regulatory requirements. He warned that allowing university operators to disregard the NUC’s directives could weaken accountability and undermine confidence in the country’s higher education system. The senator called on the Senate to take action against any institution found to be operating outside the approved regulatory framework, stressing that enforcement should not wait for the proposed amendment to the NUC Act to become law. He also warned that failure to address alleged irregularities could have wider implications for the credibility of Nigerian university qualifications. The investigation is expected to establish whether Tansian University’s governance arrangements comply with applicable regulations and determine whether further action is warranted. The allegations against the institution have yet to be established by the investigation. The probe comes as the Senate considers a bill seeking to repeal and re-enact the National Universities Commission Act to strengthen the commission’s regulatory powers and improve oversight of university education in Nigeria. The bill, sponsored by Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele and presented by Senate Chief Whip Tahir Monguno, seeks to establish an updated legal framework for the regulation, monitoring and management of universities and other degree-awarding institutions. The proposed legislation aims to strengthen enforcement mechanisms, update minimum academic standards, improve accreditation processes and ensure that Nigerian universities align with international best practices. It also seeks to provide appropriate sanctions for regulatory violations and reinforce the NUC’s position as the apex regulatory authority for academic programme accreditation. During the debate, lawmakers argued that the existing legal framework needed to be updated to address changes in the university sector, particularly the expansion of private institutions and emerging challenges in university administration. They maintained that stronger regulation was necessary to improve quality assurance, promote research and innovation, and ensure that Nigerian universities remained competitive internationally. The Senate subsequently referred the investigation into Tansian University to the relevant committee for further consideration, with a directive to report back within two weeks. The committee is expected to examine the institution’s governance arrangements and determine whether they comply with the regulatory guidelines governing university administration in Nigeria. The development signals the Senate’s intention to strengthen oversight of university management as lawmakers consider broader reforms to the legal framework governing higher education. The proposed NUC amendment bill has passed its second reading and is undergoing further legislative consideration. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.title_zh: 参议院下令调查坦桑大学涉嫌违反监管规定一事
https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.body_zh: 该指令源于参议员维克托·乌梅赫在审议一项寻求废除并重新制定《国家 Universities Commission Act》的法案时提出的关切。乌梅赫代表阿南布拉中部选区，他呼吁立即调查该大学的治理结构，重点调查有关大学官员任免和管理权力行使的指控。他认为，无视既定监管程序的行为可能削弱大学治理、降低学术标准，并损害尼日利亚毕业生的国际声誉。针对这些关切，参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿克帕比奥强调，需要加强国家 Universities Commission（NUC）的监管权，确保公立和私立大学依法运营。阿克帕比奥指出，国民议会负有监督责任，应支持该委员会在整个大学体系中执行标准。他补充说，如果发现某机构违反适用法律，国民议会可建议总统采取适当行动，包括依法关闭该机构。经过审议，参议院批准了一项动议，对 Tansian University 的运营和管理展开调查，并指示相关委员会在两周内提交报告。乌梅赫此前表示担忧，一些私立大学据称采用与既定监管要求不一致的管理结构。他警告说，如果允许大学运营方无视 NUC 的指令，可能削弱问责制并损害外界对尼日利亚高等教育体系的信心。乌梅赫呼吁参议院对任何被发现脱离既定监管框架运营的机构采取行动，并强调执法不应等待拟议中的 NUC Act 修正案生效。他还警告称，未能处理涉嫌违规行为，可能对尼日利亚大学学历的可信度带来更广泛影响。此次调查预计将确定 Tansian University 的治理安排是否符合适用法规，并判断是否有必要采取进一步行动。针对该机构的指控尚未通过调查得到证实。调查之际，参议院正在审议一项寻求废除并重新制定《国家 Universities Commission Act》的法案，以加强该委员会的监管权力并加强对尼日利亚大学教育的监督。该法案由参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱提出，并由参议院首席党鞭塔希尔·蒙努诺提交，旨在为大学及其他学位授予机构的监管、监测和管理建立更新后的法律框架。拟议立法旨在加强执法机制、更新最低学术标准、改善认证流程，并确保尼日利亚大学符合国际最佳实践。法案还 seeks 对监管违规行为规定适当制裁，并强化 NUC 作为学术项目认证最高监管机构的地位。辩论期间，议员们认为，现有法律框架需要更新，以应对大学领域的变化，尤其是私立机构的扩张以及大学管理中 emerging 的挑战。他们坚持认为，加强监管对于改善质量保障、促进研究与创新，以及确保尼日利亚大学保持国际竞争力都是必要的。参议院随后将对 Tansian University 的调查移交相关委员会进一步审议，并指示其在两周内提交报告。预计该委员会将审查该机构的治理安排，确定其是否符合尼日利亚大学管理的监管指引。这一进展表明，参议院有意加强对大学管理的监督，同时议员们正在考虑对高等教育法律框架进行更广泛的改革。拟议中的 NUC 修正案已通过二读，目前正在进行进一步立法审议。我们掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家角度，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp 频道，随时获取全天候更新 → 加入我们的 WhatsApp 频道 --> --> Samson Elijah 是一名就职于 Leadership Newspaper 的记者，专门从事政治报道和公共事务分析。他以深入的事实分析而闻名，这些分析超越表面报道，使他成为该领域值得信赖且权威的声音

https://leadership.ng/state-police-yobe-.body: The approval followed deliberations by lawmakers on 26 proposed constitutional amendment bills transmitted by the National Assembly to state legislatures for consideration and voting. Speaking on the resolutions, the Speaker of the House, Alhaji Chiroma Buba Mashio, said the bills were forwarded to state legislatures to enable them to consider and vote on the proposed amendments in line with constitutional requirements. Mashio explained that the proposal for State Police was aimed at providing a constitutional framework for states to establish their own police services. He said the proposal formed part of ongoing national discussions on security sector reform, particularly efforts to strengthen the country’s capacity to address emerging security challenges. The 26 proposed constitutional alteration bills seek amendments to various provisions of the 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Under the constitutional amendment process, proposed alterations require the approval of at least two-thirds of the state Houses of Assembly to meet the relevant legislative requirement. The Yobe Assembly’s approval represents the state’s position on the proposal, while its implementation depends on the completion of the constitutionally prescribed amendment process. https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-ordere.summary_zh: 美国一名法官已命令总统唐纳德·特朗普于12月11日前在其针对英国广播公司的诽谤诉讼中宣誓回答问题。根据美国法律，宣誓取证是当事人在法庭外宣誓后就提问作出的陈述，该陈述会被记录，供后续诉讼程序使用。特朗普在佛罗里达州提起的诉讼指控英国广播公司“故意、恶意且欺骗性地篡改”了他于2021年1月6日在国会大厦外发表的讲话。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-ordere.body: A US judge has ordered President Donald Trump to answer questions under oath in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC by 11 December. Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave before the riot at the US Capitol in 2021. Charles Tobin, a lawyer representing the BBC, said in court that "we still haven't been able to depose the plaintiff" with two months left in the discovery period, during which both sides are legally required to exchange information with each other on their case. Trump cancelled a previous deposition on 16 October, citing "matters of national importance" while he was campaigning in Georgia. In US law, a deposition is an out-of-court statement made under oath in response to questions, which is recorded for use in later proceedings. The judge in the case, US Magistrate Judge Enjoliqué Lett, said that Trump must sit for the deposition by 11 December, unless the discovery period is extended. Last week, attorneys asked that Lett compel Trump to face deposition after the last scheduled meeting did not take place. On that day, Trump attended a midterms campaign rally in Dalton, Georgia and a fundraiser at his property in Mar-a-Lago in Florida. Trump's lawsuit - filed in Florida - accuses the BBC of "intentionally, maliciously, and deceptively doctoring" the speech he gave outside the Capitol on 6 January 2021. The BBC apologised for the error and said that the broadcast gave "the mistaken impression that President Trump made a direct call for violent action". The broadcaster has since asked that the court dismiss the lawsuit, arguing that the programme does not meet the legal criteria for defamation and was not available in the US. In July, Trump's lawyers conceded that they had no evidence that the documentary was available in the US on the BBC's BritBox subscription service - as they originally claimed - or on the BBC's website, BBC select or through US broadcasters. Trump ultimately agreed to drop the lawsuit against BBC Studios, its commercial arm, after the BBC argued that it had "no role in creating or producing the documentary". Typically, depositions take place in a lawyer's office - rather than a courtroom - without a judge physically present. Depositions, however, carry legal weight and take place under oath. They are recorded verbatim by a court reporter, and the transcripts can later be used as evidence during trials. In defamation cases, lawyers for both sides are normally present for depositions

https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-ordere.body_zh: 美国法官已命令总统唐纳德·特朗普在12月11日前，就他针对BBC提起的诽谤诉讼宣誓回答问题。特朗普起诉BBC，原因是《全景》节目的一期内容将他在2021年美国国会大厦发生骚乱前发表的一次演讲中两个不同的片段剪辑到了一起。代表BBC的律师查尔斯·托宾在法庭上表示，在证据开示期还剩两个月的情况下，“我们仍未能够让原告接受宣誓取证”，而在此期间，双方依法都必须交换与各自案件有关的信息。特朗普此前取消了10月16日的一次宣誓取证，理由是他正在佐治亚州竞选，声称存在“具有全国重要性的事务”。在美国法律中，宣誓取证是指在法庭外宣誓后回答问题所作的陈述，并会被记录下来，供后续诉讼程序使用。本案法官、美国治安法官恩乔利凯·莱特表示，除非证据开示期获准延长，否则特朗普必须在12月11日前接受宣誓取证。上周，律师请求莱特强迫特朗普接受宣誓取证，因为原定进行的最后一次会面未能举行。当天，特朗普出席了佐治亚州多尔顿市举行的中期选举竞选集会，以及佛罗里达州海湖庄园内的一场筹款活动。特朗普在佛罗里达州提起的诉讼指控BBC“故意、恶意且欺骗性地篡改”了他于2021年1月6日在国会大厦外发表的演讲。BBC为这一错误道歉，并称该节目“使人误以为特朗普总统直接呼吁采取暴力行动”。此后，该媒体请求法院驳回诉讼，理由是该节目不符合诽谤罪的法律标准，而且在美国无法收看。7月，特朗普的律师承认，他们没有证据证明该纪录片可通过BBC的BritBox订阅服务——正如他们最初所称——或通过BBC网站、BBC Select或美国各广播机构在美国收看。最终，在BBC主张其“在制作或创作该纪录片方面没有任何作用”后，特朗普同意放弃对BBC商业部门BBC Studios提起的诉讼。宣誓取证通常在律师事务所而非法庭内进行，法官不会亲自到场。不过，宣誓取证具有法律效力，并以宣誓方式进行。法庭记录员会逐字录制整个过程，记录文本之后可在审判中作为证据。在诽谤案件中，双方律师通常都会出席宣誓取证……

https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.title: US Treasury proposes a rule to crack down on high-tech investments in China and other ‘countries of concern’
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Treasury Department proposed a rule Thursday to crack down on American high-tech investments such as supercomputing and artificial intelligence in China, Russia, North Korea and other “countries of concern.’’ The U.S. government has been working for years to deny China and other adversaries investments that could help them boost their military power.
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.summary_zh: 华盛顿——美国财政部周四提出一项规则，旨在打击美国对中国、俄罗斯、朝鲜及其他“受关注国家”的高科技投资，例如超级计算和人工智能投资。多年来，美国政府一直设法阻止中国及其他对手获得能够增强其军事力量的投资。
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.body: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Treasury Department proposed a rule Thursday to crack down on American high-tech investments such as supercomputing and artificial intelligence in China, Russia, North Korea and other “countries of concern.’’ The U.S. government has been working for years to deny China and other adversaries investments that could help them boost their military power. That program began in 2023 when then-President Joe Biden signed an executive order putting restrictions on outbound U.S. investments in sectors such as semiconductors, quantum computing and artificial intelligence going into China. Treasury later established the Outbound Investment Security Program. In December 2025, Congress passed a law that codified and expanded the program to target more technologies and more foreign countries, including Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia. The inclusion of Russia in the proposed rule has come days after President Donald Trump waived sanctions on Russia following a diesel deal with President Vladimir Putin. The rule announced Thursday would expand the restrictions to cover investments in hypersonic systems (capable of traveling at five times the speed of sound), supercomputing, biotechnology and artificial intelligence, though Treasury used Trump’s favored term for AI, “superintelligence” or SI. The proposed rule “sends an important signal to markets that Washington is tracking where U.S. capital is flowing and what capabilities it is helping build,” said Craig Singleton, a senior fellow at the think tank Foundation for Defense of Democracies. The screening of outbound investments “recognizes that capital can accelerate military-relevant capabilities just as surely as technology transfer can,” Singleton said. Treasury’s rule to implement the 2025 law — the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act — would only apply to investments that exceed $50,000 and would exclude many financial investments, including stock purchases. Treasury will hear public comments on the proposal before issuing a final rule. “It’s just the first step in a fairly long process to get to changes which presumably will be more enforcement-minded, to put more teeth behind the outbound investment program,” said former U.S. trade official Ryan Majerus, now a partner at King & Spalding law firm. Since Trump’s first term, the United States and China — the world’s two biggest economies — have been locked in an economic and tech rivalry. They’ve restricted the export of sensitive technology and critical products (China’s rare earth minerals, America’s advanced computer chips) to each other and slapped tariffs on each other’s products. Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed last year to ease tensions while they engaged in talks, a temporary truce they last month extended into January. But the sparring continues. In July, the Treasury Department issued a $200,000 fine against a U.S.-based company for failing to report to the department a $92,500 investment in a Chinese artificial intelligence and robotics company by one of its subsidiaries
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.title_zh: 美国财政部提议制定规则，打击对中国及其他“受关注国家”的高科技投资
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国财政部周四提议制定一项规则，严厉限制美国对中国、俄罗斯、朝鲜及其他“受关注国家”的高科技投资，例如超级计算和人工智能。美国政府多年来一直致力于阻止中国及其他对手获得可能提升其军事力量的投资。该计划始于2023年，时任总统乔·拜登签署行政命令，限制美国对华 semiconductors、量子计算和人工智能等领域的对外投资。此后，财政部设立了对外投资安全计划。2025年12月，国会通过一项法律，将该计划成文化并予以扩大，将更多技术和更多外国国家列为目标，包括古巴、伊朗、朝鲜和俄罗斯。就在拟议规则发布前几天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成柴油交易后，豁免了对俄罗斯的制裁。周四公布的规则将扩大限制范围，涵盖对高超音速系统（飞行速度可达音速5倍）、超级计算、生物技术和人工智能的投资，不过财政部采用了特朗普偏好的人工智能称谓“超级智能”或SI。民主国防基金会高级研究员克雷格·辛格顿表示，拟议规则“向市场发出一个重要信号，表明华盛顿正在追踪美国资本流向何处，以及这些资本正在帮助构建什么能力”。辛格顿说，对对外投资进行审查，“承认资本与技术转让一样，能够加速与军事相关的能力发展”。财政部为落实2025年法律——《综合对外投资国家安全法》——而制定的规则，仅适用于金额超过50,000美元的投资，并将排除许多金融投资，包括购买股票。财政部将在发布最终规则前听取公众对该提案的意见。现任King & Spalding律师事务所合伙人、美国前贸易官员瑞安·马杰鲁斯说：“这只是推动对外投资计划发生改变的一个初步步骤，而这一过程相当漫长；最终出台的规定大概会更加注重执法，使该计划拥有更强的约束力。”自特朗普首个任期开始以来，世界两大经济体美国和中国一直陷于经济与科技竞争。双方相互限制敏感技术和关键产品的出口，其中包括稀土矿产（中国）和先进计算机芯片（美国），并对彼此产品加征关税。去年，特朗普和中国国家主席习近平同意在会谈期间缓和紧张局势，双方达成的临时休战上月又延长至1月。但双方仍不断交锋。今年7月，财政部对一家美国公司处以200,000美元罚款，原因是该公司未向财政部报告其一家子公司对一家中国人工智能和机器人公司进行的92,500美元投资

https://punchng.com/yobe-assembly-approv.body: The Yobe State House of Assembly has approved the establishment of a state police service as part of its consideration of proposed amendments to the 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. The approval followed deliberations by lawmakers on proposed constitutional amendment bills transmitted by the National Assembly to state Houses of Assembly for consideration and voting. The resolution was reached on Thursday, according to the proceedings of the House. The Speaker, Rt. Hon. Chiroma Buba Mashio, said the bills were forwarded to state legislatures to consider and vote on the proposed alterations in line with constitutional requirements. Mashio said the House’s position on state police was aimed at providing a constitutional framework that would allow states to establish their own police services alongside the existing Nigeria Police Force. He said, “The proposed establishment of state police is aimed at providing a constitutional framework that will enable states to maintain their own police services alongside the existing Nigeria Police Force.” The Speaker added that the proposal was part of ongoing national discussions on security sector reform aimed at strengthening Nigeria’s capacity to address emerging security challenges. “The establishment of state police is a key component of ongoing national discussions on security sector reform aimed at strengthening the country’s capacity to address emerging security challenges,” he said. https://leadership.ng/state-police-gombe.body: The bill, comprising 26 clauses, was transmitted to the state assembly by the National Assembly on October 6, 2026, for concurrence in line with Section 9(2) of the 1999 Constitution, as amended. The proposed legislation seeks to amend the Constitution to establish a legal framework for a State Police Service, distinct from the Nigeria Police Force and under federal control. LEADERSHIP reports that the assembly passed the bill on Thursday after considering the report of its Ad-hoc Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution. Upon receipt of the bill, the House constituted a seven-member ad hoc committee, chaired by the Deputy Speaker, Hon. Sadam Bello Sale, to examine the proposed amendments. Presenting the committee’s report, Sale said members had consulted relevant stakeholders as part of their review of the bill. He added that the report received the support of a two-thirds majority of members, in accordance with Order 17, Rule 3 of the Gombe State House of Assembly Standing Orders, 2020. During Thursday’s plenary, lawmakers considered the report at the Committee of the Whole. They adopted recommendations to amend various provisions of the Constitution, including those relating to the establishment and operation of state police services separate from the federal police. The passage places Gombe among the states whose legislatures have endorsed the proposed constitutional changes to establish state police as part of efforts to address Nigeria’s security challenges. Commenting on the bill, the Speaker of the House, Abubakar Muhammad Luggerewo, said members unanimously supported the proposed legal framework for establishing state police, noting that it would strengthen security in the country. He commended the lawmakers for their commitment and resilience. Barr. Hauwa Abdullahi and Barr. Babadidi J. Mele served as secretaries to the committee. We’ve got the edge. https://www.myjoyonline.com/ministry-of-.body: The Ministry of Education is creating direct reporting channels, including a hotline, to allow students, parents, teachers and community members to report sexual abuse in schools without having to go through head teachers or other local authorities who may be implicated. Deputy Education Minister Dr Clement Apaak disclosed this on JoyNews’ News Night on Thursday, October 22, 2026, saying the allegations involving the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) had exposed weaknesses in the existing reporting structure. “In the wake of this issue, we became aware that there was a challenge within the reporting structure as far as GES is concerned,” he said. Dr Apaak said the proposed channels would provide an alternative route for complaints to reach the Ministry of Education, enabling authorities to respond to allegations more promptly. “We believe that if we were to provide a bypass that would allow victims, parents of victims, teaching and non-teaching staff in the schools where some of these despicable occurrences take place, or even community members and leaders, it will make it easier for such complaints to get to the ministry so that we can act tenaciously,” he said. Dr Apaak stressed that a hotline was one of several reporting options under consideration, acknowledging that students are generally not permitted to carry mobile phones in school. “The concept of the hotline is one among many other options,” he said. He cited the Obuasi SHTS case as an example of how complaints could remain unresolved when people who become aware of alleged abuse cannot secure an effective response through existing channels. “From the documentary, we saw pieces of evidence to suggest that other teachers, a housemistress, and even parents had become aware, and because the structure did not allow them to get the needed response in terms of action, this dragged on,” he said. The Deputy Minister said the delay may have created opportunities for the alleged abuse to continue and affect other students. “That may have then given an opportunity to the accused individual to even engage in this conduct and perpetrate this crime against other female students,” he said. The proposed reporting channels follow allegations of sexual abuse involving the suspended headmaster of Obuasi SHTS, Zakaria Abdulai. An investigative documentary by journalist Manasseh Azure Awuni examined allegations involving multiple students and raised questions about whether concerns brought to the attention of some school authorities and parents received an adequate response. The case has prompted calls for stronger safeguarding measures and more effective systems for reporting suspected abuse in schools. The proposed channels are intended to allow complaints to reach education authorities directly, particularly where school-level officials may be implicated or fail to act. Dr Apaak did not provide a timeline for the introduction of the new reporting options
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ministry-of-.title_zh: 奥布阿西SHTS案件发生后，教育部设立性侵投诉直接报告渠道
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ministry-of-.body_zh: 教育部正在建立直接举报渠道，包括设立热线电话，让学生、家长、教师和社区成员可以直接举报校园性侵，而无需经过可能涉案的校长或其他地方 authorities。2026年10月22日，教育部副部长克莱门特·阿帕克博士在 JoyNews 的《夜间新闻》节目中透露了此事。他说，涉及奥布亚西高级技术学校（SHTS）校长的指控暴露了现有举报机制的薄弱之处。他说：“在这一事件发生后，我们意识到，就GES而言，举报机制存在一个问题。”阿帕克博士表示，拟议中的渠道将为投诉直接传达至教育部提供另一条途径，使有关部门能够更迅速地回应指控。他说：“我们认为，如果设置一条旁路举报渠道，让受害者、受害者的家长、发生这些卑劣事件的学校的教职员工，甚至社区成员和社区领袖，都能更方便地向教育部反映投诉，我们就可以坚决采取行动。”阿帕克博士强调，热线电话只是目前正在考虑的多种举报方式之一，并承认学校通常不允许学生携带手机。他说：“热线电话只是众多选项中的一个。”他以奥布亚西SHTS案件为例，说明当知情者无法通过现有渠道获得有效回应时，投诉可能长期得不到解决。他说：“从纪录片中，我们看到了一些证据，表明其他教师、一名宿舍女管理员，甚至一些家长早已知情，但由于现有机制无法让他们获得所需的行动回应，这件事便一直拖着。”副部长表示，拖延可能为涉嫌的虐待行为继续发生并影响其他学生创造了机会。他说：“这样一来，可能就给了被指控者机会，让他们继续实施这种行为，对其他女学生犯下罪行。”拟议中的直接举报渠道是在奥布亚西SHTS被停职校长扎卡里亚·阿卜杜拉伊涉嫌性侵学生的指控之后提出的。记者曼纳塞·阿祖尔·阿武尼制作的一部调查纪录片审查了涉及多名学生的指控，并质疑向部分学校管理人员和家长反映的情况是否得到了充分回应。此案引发了加强保护措施和完善校园疑似虐待行为举报制度的呼声。拟议中的举报渠道旨在让投诉直接传达给教育主管部门，尤其是在学校层面官员可能涉案或未能采取行动的情况下。阿帕克博士没有就推出这些新举报方式的时间表作出说明

https://punchng.com/police-arrest-man-ov.body: The Federal Capital Territory Police Command has arrested a man accused of impersonating a permanent secretary attached to the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation after intercepting a Lexus SUV with a concealed number plate bearing the inscription “PRESIDENCY”. The command disclosed this in a statement shared on its Facebook page on Thursday, saying the vehicle was intercepted at about 8 pm on October 20 in Maitama, Abuja. The statement was signed by the command’s Public Relations Officer, Josephine Adeh. According to the police, preliminary investigations revealed that the number plate bore the registration number 10B218 FG, but the documents presented for its registration were forged. The police said the suspect claimed to be the legitimate holder of the number plate, but further investigations allegedly uncovered that he was impersonating a permanent secretary attached to the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sena.summary_zh: 拟议中的大学预计将扩大科学和技术教育的可及性，推动本土研究与创新，并培养技术人才，以支持工业化和技术进步。参议院议长 Godswill Akpabio 在宣布听证会开始时表示，拟议机构不仅应根据设立本身的优势进行评估，还应考虑是否拥有可持续的资金、足够的设施和有效的管理。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sena.body: Layer 1 — Bill seeks to boost science education, skilled manpower Akpabio stresses sustainable funding, research and infrastructure ABUJA — The Senate has held a public hearing on a bill seeking to establish the Federal University of Science and Technology, Korokorosei, in Bayelsa State, as part of efforts to expand science education, strengthen research and address Nigeria’s skilled manpower needs. The hearing was organised on Thursday by the Senate Committee on Tertiary Institutions and TETFund, chaired by Senator Muntari Dandutse (APC, Katsina South). The proposed university is expected to expand access to science and technology education, promote indigenous research and innovation, and train skilled professionals to support industrialisation and technological advancement. Declaring the hearing open, Senate President Godswill Akpabio said the proposed institution should be assessed not only on the merits of its establishment but also on the availability of sustainable funding, adequate facilities and effective administration. Akpabio, who was represented by the Deputy Minority Whip, Senator Ibrahim Mustapha, said Nigeria needed institutions capable of translating research into industrial production, reducing dependence on imported technologies and equipping young people with skills to compete globally. He described human potential as the Niger Delta’s greatest resource, saying the proposed university could help address environmental degradation and develop solutions to challenges facing the region’s riverine communities. Akpabio identified cleaner energy, environmental protection, agriculture and fisheries as areas where the institution could make significant contributions through research and innovation. He said the university should produce graduates whose knowledge and innovations would support national development. The Senate president cautioned, however, that expanding the number of universities should not be the sole objective of higher education policy, stressing that access must be matched by academic excellence, adequate funding and long-term sustainability. He urged stakeholders to examine the bill critically and make recommendations that would assist the National Assembly in reaching an informed decision in the national interest. Earlier, Dandutse said the public hearing provided an inclusive platform for stakeholders to contribute to the proposed legislation. He said the committee would scrutinise the proposed university’s governance structure, funding arrangements, academic focus, staffing requirements, infrastructure and compliance with existing laws governing tertiary education. The committee chairman added that particular attention would be paid to the institution’s long-term viability to ensure that, if approved, it delivered meaningful benefits to students and the country. The bill’s sponsor, Senator Benson Konbowei (Bayelsa Central), said the proposed university would help address shortages of skilled manpower, particularly in science, technology and other specialised fields. Konbowei argued that Nigeria needed to train more professionals locally rather than rely on foreign sources to meet critical technological and industrial manpower requirements. He said establishing the institution in the Niger Delta would give young people greater opportunities to study science-related courses and acquire skills relevant to their communities and the wider country. The lawmaker thanked the Senate leadership and committee members for considering the proposal, describing it as an opportunity to strengthen science and technology education in the region. Also speaking, Mr Timidi Wariowei, technical adviser to Bayelsa State Governor Douye Diri, said Korokorosei, in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area, had existing infrastructure that could support the proposed university. He listed a secondary school with several buildings, a health facility, hotels and a landing jetty among the facilities available in the riverine community. Wariowei added that road construction towards the community was ongoing, expressing optimism that improved accessibility would support the development of the proposed institution. He also said the state government had established technical colleges across its eight local government areas to develop practical skills in science and technology. According to him, the proposed university could provide graduates of those colleges with opportunities for further education, advanced training and specialised knowledge. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/sena.body_zh: 第一层——参议院法案寻求促进科学教育和 skilled manpower；阿卡比奥强调可持续资金、研究与基础设施。阿布贾——参议院举行公开听证会，审议一项拟在巴耶尔萨州设立科罗科罗塞联邦科技大学 的法案，以扩大科学教育、加强研究并应对尼日利亚的技术人才需求。听证会于周四举行，由参议院高等教育机构及TETFund委员会组织，委员会主席为卡塔萨州南区参议员蒙塔里·丹杜塞（全体进步大会党）。拟议大学有望扩大科学和技术教育的入学渠道，推动本土研究与创新，并培养技术专业人才，以支持工业化和技术进步。参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿卡比奥宣布听证会开幕时表示，对拟议机构的评估不应只看设立该机构的合理性，还应考虑能否获得可持续资金、充足设施和有效管理。阿卡比奥由少数党副党鞭、易卜拉欣·穆斯塔法参议员代表出席。他表示，尼日利亚需要能够将研究成果转化为工业生产、减少对进口技术依赖，并使年轻人获得技能、参与全球竞争的机构。他把人力资源称为尼日尔三角洲最大的财富，并表示，拟议大学有助于应对环境退化和为当地沿河社区面临的挑战开发解决方案。阿卡比奥指出，清洁能源、环境保护、农业和渔业将是该校通过研究与创新作出重大贡献的领域。他说，该大学应培养拥有知识和创新能力的毕业生，以支持国家发展。不过，参议院议长提醒，增加大学数量不应成为高等教育政策的唯一目标，并强调教育机会必须与学术卓越、充足资金和长期可持续性相匹配。他敦促各方认真审议该法案，并提出有助于国民议会基于国家利益作出明智决定 的建议。此前，丹杜塞表示，公开听证会为利益相关方参与拟议立法提供了包容性平台。他说，委员会将审查拟议大学的治理结构、资金安排、学术重点、人员配置、基础设施，以及其遵守现行高等教育法律的情况。委员会主席补充说，将特别关注该机构的长期生存能力，以确保该大学一旦获批，便能为学生和国家带来切实利益。法案发起人、巴耶尔萨州中部选区参议员本森·孔博韦表示，拟议大学将有助于缓解技术人才短缺，尤其是在科学、技术和其他专业领域。孔博韦认为，尼日利亚需要在国内培养更多专业人员，而不是依赖外国人才来满足关键技术和工业领域的人力需求。他说，在尼日尔三角洲设立该大学，将为年轻人提供更多学习科学相关课程、获取与所在社区及全国相关技能的机会。这位议员感谢参议院领导层和委员会成员考虑该提案，并称这是加强该地区科学和技术教育的机会。巴耶尔萨州州长杜耶·迪里的技术顾问蒂米迪·瓦里奥韦先生也出席听证会。他说，位于南伊贾奥地方政府区域的科罗科罗塞已有可支持拟议大学建设的基础设施。他列举了这个沿河社区现有的设施，包括一所拥有数栋建筑的中学、一处医疗设施、酒店和一个登陆码头。瓦里奥韦补充说，通往该社区的道路正在施工，并对改善交通条件将支持拟议机构发展表示乐观。他还表示，州政府已在全州8个地方政府区域设立技术学院，以培养科学和技术领域的实用技能。据他介绍，拟议大学将为这些学院的毕业生提供接受继续教育、 advanced training和获得专业知识的机会。本文所述评论仅代表发言者观点，不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的意见。
